review_text: This is easily one of my favorite spots! The food and coffee are consistently high quality, but what really sets it apart is the atmosphere. It's incredibly cohesive for both deep-work sessions and Bible studies. I love that the space is filled with encouraging Bible verses, it's such a thoughtful touch. The staff is friendly, the facilities are spotless, and the internet is reliable. Truly a peaceful and productive environment!

There are some good reasons to go here, maybe not 10,000, but still some good ones. It's clean, comfortable, spacious, well decorated, great views from outside(5th floor), good food, good coffee, helpful friendly staff, free WiFi and clean CR. Went here on a Saturday morning around 10 for coffee and breakfast. We ordered the Durian Cappuccino, White Chocolate Macadamia Latte, Bacon and Egg, Pork Tocino with Egg and a Chocolate Almond Muffin. The Durian Cappuccino was uniquely bold and flavorful while the White Chocolate Macadamia Latte was smooth lightly sweetened. Both meals were well prepared and delicious and the muffin really topped off the meal being sweet and moist. This was really a good experience and worth giving a try. Enjoy!
The staffs are welcoming and the atmosphere is great. Perfect for college students and group works. Also, as an introvert, it's a perfect place to be alone because you have your own space.
Seriously loved this cafe! It's so cute and peaceful, perfect for hanging out with friends. The food was delicious, and that strawberry drink? To die for! Highly recommend.

This place is a really good spot for studying, especially for students who need a quiet and comfortable environment to focus on their schoolwork. The Wi-Fi connection is strong, stable, and fast, which makes it very convenient for online classes, research, and completing assignments without interruptions. The atmosphere is relaxing and not too noisy, so it is easy to concentrate for long hours.
It is a cozy place with fast Wi-Fi, making it very ideal for studying. The male and female restrooms are also separate, and the drinks taste great!❤️
I Feel the peace and pwede maka muni muni :)
Absolutely loved this café! Everything was fresh, the drinks were amazing, and the service was exceptional. 10/10!
I hope the number of servers increases. There are many customers but only a few are serving.
Great bread, would absolutely try again. The price is also very affordable for such a great quality bread.

If you're looking for a cozy spot to relax and enjoy some quality time, 121 Cafe is your go-to destination. Nestled in a convenient location, this charming cafe offers a perfect blend of ambiance, delightful food, and exceptional service. Recommended!!!
Pagka lamiay sa ensaimada! back to back customer here! Never failed to satisfy my cravings. Maayo ang customer service ni Owner, very approachable and friendly. Thank you po!
Best snack time place ☺️☺️☺️. Satisfied customer. For reference please look at the picture. Hehe ❤️❤️❤️
Bang for the buck! Sure gyud nga high quality and wa gi tipid ilang ingredients. Now I must visit this spot.

The food you order here is so delicious and worth it, especially the Cinnamon Bread and Tuna Sandwich, I'll forget your name. But of course, satisfied customers here. Their orders are very affordable.
Solid, pocket-friendly, and TASTEFUL! Must Try, TUNA SANDWHICH and CINNAMON BUN!!
Great little cafe with a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. The coffee was really good, and I loved how comfortable the place felt. Definitely a spot I'd come back to again!
Great coffee, great service, and a great atmosphere. Will definitely be back.
Their food and drinks are delicious and it's a nice place for a date and it's cheap, hehe
We tried the Vietnamese Latte and the Dirty Matcha Latte. They were really good!
loved the smooth spanish latte and the unique blueberry cinnamon. both are a must-try! 🧡
I love their coffee. 💕 The place is so aesthetic and cozy.
Asked barista for order suggestion and recommendation was on point with what I wanted to try ✨
Coffee that actually hits!! Love their sea salt spanish latte 💯 …
The Classic Cream Cheese Scroll is 10 out 10. It's really really good ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
the kind of CAFFEINE KICK that actually gets you through the day!
I love their Matcha and coffee
Must try!! 👍🏻 …

tried this new coffee shop in the late afternoon and it wasn't too busy. the staff were very accommodating and gave great recommendations for their drinks and pastries. i got the ichiban matcha (7/10), which had a gentle bold and grassy aftertaste, though it was a bit sweeter than i expected even with balanced sweetness. sea salt spanish latte (9/10) because it wasn't overly sweet and had a well-balanced flavor. i also enjoyed their biscoff scroll (9/10) since it wasn't too sweet. the café has a clean, cozy atmosphere with a nice vibe, making it a great spot to relax.

First time visiting and I really liked the place. The café is cozy, clean, and has a relaxing atmosphere. I ordered the iced sea salt Spanish latte. It wasn't bad, but it leaned more on the sweet side than I expected, so I couldn't really taste the coffee as much. Overall, it was still a pleasant visit, and I'm looking forward to trying their other coffee drinks next time.
Coffee and Matcha options are good, well crafted. Place offers good place to stay for a while and have good conversations with friends.
Mont Blanc was really good! A must-try in the menu.
Currently obsessed with mont blanc!! 😍 …
Sea Salt Latte is soooo good!!! Been ordering it for 3x already
Their matcha is accommodating and delicious!

The coffee is super delicious. My personal fave is the seasalt spanish latte!! Not one of the cafes that is purely aesthetic. At 444, the cafe is aesthetic, the coffee is even more delicious. Highly recommend you guys try out their coffee.
Good cinnamon rolls
Great coffee & pasta! Very welcoming ambiance too! Really worth the visit!
If pink's your fave color, then this cafe is for you 😉 their menu is budget friendly too.
I love the ambience. The place is clean and the customer service is great ❤️
The place is nice and clean. Food is great. Drinks are even better.
The best and sikwate with puto maya Nice place Nice their service

Worst tasting coffee ☹️ ordered their version of spanish latte and you can barely drink it. Wasted my money. Better go to a different branch until they learn how to properly make their coffee. I've tried other branches and they were okay, far from the one I tried here. They have few tables for dine in but the seats were itchy.

Excellent customer service! The staff were friendly, attentive, and made my order with care. My drink was perfectly made—fresh, flavorful, and just the way I wanted it. You can really tell they put effort into both the service and the quality of their drinks. Highly recommended! Thanks sir Clint!
Great customer service, the staff are accommodating and kind. Thank you sir Clint!
The smell of coffee and the taste of cappuccino are sooooo
It's worth the price😭😭 the staff are so kind😋
solidity 👌🏻👌🏻💚

This is a very cool and unique coffee shop. It’s not an obvious find and you might walk right by it if you are not looking for it. Open the door and go up the stairs. There were only a few other people there when we went. It’s small, clean and comfortable. We ordered coffee and cookies and enjoyed both. Staff were friendly and helpful and the CR was clean. Give them a try!

really ambient place but limited space lang, went on a holiday so had the place to myself. got their matcha cloud w/oat milk which was good, although on the sweeter side and could barely taste the umami notes :,) baristas were very accommodating tho!

March 9, 2026. Around 6:35pm. About two to four customers in there. Got the ₱150 Hojicha Affogato and ₱150 12oz ish Iced Strawberry milk with pink salt cream. The hojichagato in cup was a choice because I wanted the sticker and it was also bit unique for downtown desserts as it is usually matchagato. The iced strawberry drink was nice, the salted cream just dissolves to enhance the strawberry flavor. Thanks to the baristas for accommodating us and requests to have it served that way. Will try the other branch another time.

This newly opened café absolutely deserves five stars. It just hits the spot. I had the hojicha latte and loved it. The space is intimate, so it can get a little busy and lively, but that’s part of its charm. It feels vibrant and warm. Whether you’re coming in solo or with friends, it’s a great place to spend an afternoon. The baristas are genuinely kind and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better.
The entrance is a small door with a glass triangle. You climb up the stairs and the place is to your right. A quaint cafe, the coffee is good. I think thats all you need to be a good cafe.

If you are short on time but refuse to compromise on coffee quality, this spot is an absolute must-visit. The shop itself is quite small with very limited seating, so it is definitely designed for a fast, high-turnover crowd rather than a long study session. However, when the product and service are this exceptional, you don't need to stay long to know it's a masterpiece. This is officially my new favorite morning pit stop!
Love every coffee that I ordered. Friendly staff too!!

From CDO to do cafe hopping in Davao! New branch, super cute and small — but when we went, it was suuuper crowded 😅 They accept cash and GCash, which is super convenient. The staff and barista are so kind and accommodating, love that! 🥰 Tried: • Spanish Latte – 130 PHP, 8/10 💖 • Tely Matcha Latte – 250 PHP, 9/10 🍵 • Hojicha Latte – 240 PHP, 8/10 🌿 Such a cute little cafe, perfect for quick stops and coffee vibes!
Saurr good ang matcha!! And very helpful din ang baristas if ur indecisive like me😅

Got a little confused with the pricing. I visited about a month ago & ordered hot mocha for P160. ~Then came back today for the same drink and was charged P190. Was told it’s an additional P30 to ‘upsize’ the drink. But it’s the same cup from my first visit so which is which? ~it honestly affected my visit today. I love the taste of their mocha though although it’s not as hot as I expected it to be.

Overall, the experience was good! The cafe was intimate, about 15 sqm, and not crowded when we visited at 3 PM. I only tried their matcha 🍵, so I can't comment on other drinks. I would go back for some alone time.

Chill bar vibes, but the caffeine is right. Tucked right at the heart of the city. Need a matcha caffeine fix? Try the Opalite or Matcha Cloud. If your caffeine load can handle it, go for it. If not, go for their signature Pink Salt Latte.

Very clean place with calming ambience! They serve solid coffee and have lunch and dessert options at a very reasonable price. Not sure why other reviews are subjectively good but give so few stars?? Would recommend 👍
A new place now! In bormaheco bldg. Fronting durian hotel.
Must try!
Average cafe.
Great place, staff is so friendly and accommodating, they carried my baby so I could eat properly.

A cute coffee shop adjacent to a carwash center. It's about seven tables plus one bar type.The food is served hot and tasty. Price is okay compared to other coffee shops in the city. The staff are are nice. It's a nice place to relax, have lunch and get your car cleaned.

While waiting for your car to be washed, you can sit, relax, and dine here! ✅ Airconditioned ✅ Offers waffle, paste, iced and hot drinks ✅ I love their carbonara pasta, classic waffle, and hot matcha ✅ Cozy place ✅ Friendly staff

I have been working around the area for three years now and I finally got to try this cafe. A humble and homegrown coffee shop within the same property as a carwash so you can have coffee and snacks while waiting. Items are very affordable. I had a good serving of passionfruit tea while the sweet potato fries was good for two people. I'd prefer they put salt on the fries than sugar but this did not affect the general flavor as I am a fan of kamote fries. Good ambience and affordable. Will come back when I have money for a quick snack.

This mini café is an answered prayer. When we normally go for a carwash, we don't have a place to wait. Acacia Lane Coffee Shop serves good coffee, good food and other beverages while waiting for your car to be done being washed. It's my 3rd time here and will definitely go back here again.

good place to eat and relax after visiting the nearby China Embassy. The barista is very pleasant and always smiles when taking orders. The coffee and food are good, and they also offer plant-based milk for coffee.

My experience at the coffee shop was average; the coffee was so-so, but the prices were reasonable. What really stood out about this place is its unique offering – a combination of a coffee shop and a car wash. It's the perfect spot for car owners who want to enjoy a cup of coffee while getting their cars cleaned. It's definitely a convenient option for those in the area.
Great food, great service and great ambiance! Always love lounging here while waiting for my car to be cleaned❤️
I am here for the car wash station beside. Good food. Quiet.
Attached to an auto shop, excellent coffee and service from an independent cafe.
Cafe latte cold was so good
Very friendly staff.
Stress free

Looking for a cozy coffee shop? Try Acacia Lane Coffee Shop! ☕️ They serve great coffee, delicious meals, tasty snacks, and refreshing coolers. The ambiance is cozy, the staff are warm and friendly, and they even have a car wash—so you can relax with a good meal or drink while waiting for your car to be cleaned. Definitely worth a visit! 🌿🚗
The employees are quiet, not rude, and the aglio olio with egg malasado is delicious.

A few doors near Taste of Home and right beside the stairs going to the second floor on one side. Tiny shop with the usual budget-friendly coffee variants and some pastries. At first I thought cornflakes (cereal) were swimming inside on top of some ice. Turns out they were caramel puffs (not even that sweet). Place opens earlier than most coffee shops so that's a PLUS for me.

Nice little coffee shop in Matina Town Square on the first floor. It was clean and comfortable and had some cool jazzy R & B music playing. I was greeted by the staff and ordered the Long Black (hot) and a Revel Bar. The coffee was bold and a little bitter, but it did pair well with the Revel Bar and I did enjoy them both. There is seating both inside and outside. I'd go again if in the area.

As you can see, I took a lot of photos in this coffee shop. The cafe can only occupy at least around 10 persons (inside) and few seats outside. We ordered ✅Caramel Puff Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ✅Smores Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ✅Crème Brulee Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ✅Spanish Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Each sip reveals a symphony of flavors, perfectly harmonized, and just a divine balance of richness and smoothness makes these coffees unforgettable! The ambiance is giving retro but intrend vibe. Opens Mon-Thur 7:30am-9pm Fri-Sat 7:30am-10pm Sun 10am-8pm
Chill vibe inside the cafe but has limited seating capacity. Must try their Smores latte. They didn't have any food menu at the time I was there they had brownies on display which was at Php 45.

they have the best spanish latte highkey. and my go-to coffee shop since i study at mmcm, so it's pretty neat. best thing about the place is their vinyl player and their lamp. place looks totally dope with their oldies furniture as well 💯
Place is small but vv cozy especially around closing time. Barista is accommodating. Drinks are 💯! a bit pricey but totally worth it.
Went here for a quick escape from a hot, bustling hi-way commute … *same as keepsakes
I love the interior and the atmosphere, but their créme brulée latte was sour
Nice
Good service

I think I found a new favorite!! Finally got to try this café, and now I understand the hype! The food was really good, and the drinks too!! Everything tasted great, and every bite was worth every peso. The staff were super friendly and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The place itself is cozy, clean, and has a nice vibe that makes you want to stay longer. Definitely one of the cafés I'll keep coming back to. If you haven't been here yet, you should give it a try!

I want to share my experience at Aloha Kakou Neighborhood Café. You can find it right across SM Ecoland, beside LTO. The place is really nice —very Hawaiian-inspired and not noisy at all, which makes it perfect for working or studying. They also have free Wi-Fi and outlets, so it's convenient. The food is honestly so good—you'll keep craving it because the flavors are unique. I especially love their Hawaiian Pizzatilla. It's different from the usual—slightly sweet and very smooth to eat. Their Matcha Frappe is also really good. The taste is well-balanced, not too sweet, and just right. It's also a great place if you want to build something, since it's quiet and feels like no one will disturb you. Plus, kudos to their staff—they're all very kind and welcoming. You should definitely try it. I swear, you won't regret coming here

The whole dining experience was really nice. The waitress was really friendly and helpful it didn't feel like they were rushing you order or suggesting something expensive. The ambiance was nice and we stayed there to work which took around 4hrs, no one was rushing us and they had wifi and plugs available. It's refreshing to finally have some place that feels calm and no passive aggressive staff.

Very chill calm place. Have outlets and wifi if you're planning to study. Staff are accommodating. We stayed for around 4 hrs since their opening and it didn't feel like we were being rushed. Food and drink is also good. We were taking pics with my friend around the cafe and they even offered us props which was cute

A charming cafe located along Quimpo Boulevard. It offers a spacious parking area and a cozy, beautifully designed space. The Hawaiian inspired theme adds a refreshing touch, with tables decorated with flowers. The food and coffee are delicious, making it a great spot to study or work. Free Wi-Fi is also available for customers.
Been to this cafe twice, waitress was super sweet🥹🥹 Reccomend the tiramisu latte! Chicken fingers w fries were juicy, also highly recommend their pasta. Underrated cafe🥹🤍

Love the customer service!! Nice and Kate are superb - very accommodating. Nice always smile whenever you ask help from her, which is very nice (no pun intended). Great wifi too, meeting with a client was smooth.

Aloha Kakou Neighborhood Cafe is such a gem! The owner and staff are always warm, friendly, and genuinely helpful, which makes every visit feel welcoming. The food is consistently delicious — always fresh, flavorful, and served at just the right portions. Prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality and generous serving sizes. Whether you're here for coffee, a meal, or just to relax, it's the perfect spot. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a cozy café with amazing food and even better people! 🌺☕🍴

Nice ambiance with very aesthetic, Instagrammable vibes. We only tried their drinks since we were full from dinner—affordable and delicious! The staff were very friendly, the place was clean, and even their CR was unique. Truly a must-try spot

Experience a tropical vibe cafe where taste and tranquility meet! Though we were not able to try their food as we went there it is almost their closing hours and their kitchen cut off orders is at 9pm but their coffee is just right to your expectation. The interior is nice, cozy and welcoming. Most of all, the place is great to make chit chat with friends. Some are staying for hours to work or study.

Really enjoyed the off the beaten path coffee shop cafe. Cool Hawaiian vibe deco and music. We went in for coffee and stayed for lunch. They don't start serving food until 10:30 which was okay because we were the only ones in there on a Saturday morning and enjoyed our coffee Reveal Bar and chatting until it was time to order our food. We had a Caramel Latte, Iced Matcha Espresso Latte, Reveal Bar, Aloha Pork Ribs and Huli-Huli Chicken. Everything was excellent. Coffees were smooth and flavorful and mildly sweet. Both entrees were as good as they looked. Staff were friendly, free WiFi and bathroom was clean. Overall great experience!
Aside from their delicious food and coffees. They're GREAT FOR EXCLUSIVE EVENTS FOR SMALL GROUPS AS WELL. PLACE CAN BE RENTED FOR ₱8000 (consumable) for 4hours. Good for 10-20 pax.

Staff takes longer time to serve our order especially that its not busy hours. They would laugh out about the follow up of our order which dissappointing we dine 5:45 the other order came almost 7pm tho the male server seems nice and approachable I wasnt sure why it took so long in the kitchen for the pizza to be serve almost 1hr the dough is not that thick to cost too much cooking time.

The nook where this seemly cafe is nestled has substantial parking for the whole building. Adore the peace and quiet. First visit —- the crabfat aglio olio needs a little boost... Iced cucumber tasted just right. Courteous but understaffed personnel. Need to ask for utensils and water….Only a visible lone person working the counter, drinks prep, and serving….Second trip — dark mocha latte was perfect (not surprisingly sweet)…Tuna melt sandwich and kani wrap salad was nicely plated but pricey for its small size. Left full….Surely would love to sample other dishes soon…..
Love the vibe of this Cafe. Sarap ng Beef Pepper Steak and their Seasalt Caramel Latte. Nice and Accommodating Staff. Def coming back.
Great place to work. Food and coffee is great. Few tables lang may plug so agahan if bet magwork.
The decor was very simple but chic and the service was great , my food tasted amazing.
Food was top notch, relatively cheap. However serving time was too long (>20mins), despite the place not being too busy the night we visited.

Aloha Kakou has such a nice comfortable vibe. I love the matcha green tea frappe, beef tapa, and aloha fried chicken. Perfect meals to have when studying for a big test. Perfect place to bring a friend to study or just have a chat.
Accommodating staff. Good food. Loved the ambiance of the place.
A new food outlet for diners across SM City Davao. Plenty of parking slots.
Good service and the food is delicious. And the ambiance is so beautiful. I recommend it to those who want to relax and study.
Really good burger and good value for money. Nice fresh contemporary interior. Small and friendly place, great new find.
The time is misleading. We went there by 8:31 am on a weekday but was stopped because apparantly, their opening hours is at 11 am. So disappointing.
Good food, good drinks, good staff, fair prices. Will be back!
Hawaiian feels
Good food and ambiance.

Went here with my friends and the experience was good! The staff were accommodating, food is good, and the ambiance of the place is so cozy. Suitable for studying, working, and even just for hangouts. This will definitely be added to the list of our go-to cafes. Overall, great experience! Will surely go back here c:

Had an amazing dining experience! The food was served hot and tasted incredible and the prices were reasonable. Cafe was clean, and the ambiance was relaxing and instagramable. Overall, a wonderful place to enjoy a meal with family and friends. Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
clean, nice and cozy place, very good food❤️

Had a really great experience from their staff, they were so friendly and accommodating, the food was also good and the place was so nice for any type of activity that you wanna do, be it for studying, working, or just hanging out with friends, recommended spot for gen-Zs like me

I'm so confused. We dropped by at 6:30pm on a Sunday, and could not get anyone to take our orders so we left after 30 mins. I kept ringing the bell and even called out to the Ate that was manning the kitchen (or authorized staff area visible from the counter) but she never paid any attention. Maybe she couldn't hear me? But it was dead empty and the music was playing quite softly. Beautiful place though, and the menu looked great.
Really enjoyed this off the beaten path coffee shop. Cool Hawaiian vibe deco and music 🌺
Good food, hood ambiance, great staff!

Very cute café. Hawaiian vibes with great hawaiian foods. My personal fave is the Volcano tuna Musubi, so flavorful and i love the spiciness. For the coffee, I personally love the Biscoff latte, it was so good that it will make you crave for it. Overall, it was a nice experience. They have a lot of food and drink option, they have pasta and rice meal, coffee, non-coffee and matcha. The staffs are so friendly and attentive. Makes me wanna come back and i will definitely come back. Great job Aloha Kakou.
Nice
This place is definitely worth the visit! 😍 I'm so glad I gave this place a try.
Highly recommended! Great place to chill and study:) I also recommend their hot lattes superb!
Guys, this is great if you like aesthetic ambience and lots of food to choose from. There's even free wifi.
Good breakfast at Aloha Kakou along ecoland ra

Annipie sits right in the middle of the mall, making it a cozy and convenient spot to rest and chill after a long day of malling—something we actually don't have much of in Manila, so we decided to try some of their interesting menu items. As a palabok lover, I can't say theirs is anything amazing or standout; it's an okay merienda if you just want something light while enjoying your coffee. Same goes for the matcha and the coffee drinks—nothing exceptionally good or wow-factor, but decent enough. Their cinnamon bread also leans more like a soft pandesal–briochy bun topped with cream cinnamon sauce and chocolate chips rather than the usual cinnamon roll type. What we did like is that both the palabok noodles and the sardine pasta were cooked al dente, which is always appreciated. And service-wise, the staff were warm, attentive, and quick to respond to requests. Overall, Annipie isn't somewhere I'd specifically recommend for the food itself, but it is a pleasant place to sit down for a while, rest your feet, and catch up with friends over a simple snack and coffee.

This was a suggested of a colleague at work and I didn't regret going there. I order pork hickory belly and pink lemonade slushies. The pork belly was tender and it sauce is not too overpowering. The pink lemonade slushie helped me cool down in a thursday warm night :)

This is a nice café/bakery in Abreeza mall to relax while shopping. They have a big selection of pastries and cakes in their menu, but, unfortunately, many items are unavailable. The thing was the choices we had were all available in the former of whole, but not slices. It seems like they take the route of this method so that the clients may feel forced to spend more and get the whole piece. This method is rather outdated in the catering industry! Consider that most of the time, the tables are taken, so you may need to wait for a while to be seated.

We went to #AnniePieBakeryCafe in @iloveabreezamall and I am not disappointed to say the least. I ordered Roast Beef for dinner and Pistachio Latte for palate cleansing. Both tastes heavenly. My friend had Carbonara and Cappuccino. We both had a Revel Bar for dessert. Anniepie Bakery Cafe is highly recommended.
The staff were very friendly and nice. I ordered the pork adobo and it was really good, and the price is reasonably comparable with the location in the mall. Highly recommended.
A great place to stop for a coffee w some of the most delicious cinnamon rolls in town. However, their rice meals, sandwiches and pastas are nicely prepared as well.
At Anniepie, the family had a delightful cake and some tasty snacks, while I opted for a refreshing americano. Everyone seemed thoroughly satisfied with their meal.

I am a cinnamon lover especially on pastries and Annipie is by far one of the best I tasted. Whats more interesting is that its purely Mindanaoan and I was able to bring it here in Cebu for my kids. I guess I have another reason to visit and experience Davao more.

Looking for a place to eat and Annipie Bakery Cafe in Abreeza Mall caught my attention and I gave it a try. Service and food were both great and the price seemed fair for being in the mall. I had the Roast Beef in Mushroom Sauce and an iced Matcha Tea and for desert I tried the Blondie Brownie. I'll return and try something else off the menu.

When you're in Davao, Annipie is a must-try! 😉 This is the best local cinnamon rolls and pastry shop in town! I think this is a homegrown shop. I'm really satisfied with their cinnamon rolls, brownies, pastas, and iced drinks. Good for the sweet tooth since they're all sugary, but you must watch out if you're diabetic. Aside from snacks, they also serve meals. Hence, it is crowded during lunch and dinner time. They accept cash, debit/credit cards, and QR payments. Great for techy young adults! I will certainly always consider dining in here when I'm at Abreeza. You should check it out here, too!
I usually buy brownies and cakes here. Though they have a nice little place here for dine in, it's a little cramped but there are a lot of seats.

Food is so good here. Spanish caldereta & spicy binagoongan is my forever fave. And their pasta dishes are so good as well. Must try!! However, its just a bit pricey plus the serving is so small. But despite that, I still kept coming back.

Between 3:30 to 4:30 pm my husband and I dined in Anniepie, we ordered, and they serve first the coffee thats not hot, we waited for the cake, and asked the lady who attended us, she relayed it to her partner, he served us our coffee, and minutes later, at least 8 mins. passed we asked for the cake, and I said how come our coffee is served firstly but the cake did not follow, ? The longer we wait, the coffee will be cold?The gentleman reheated my coffee. Maybe nextime the coffee and cake should be served together thus to avoid getting it cold.
My coffee order was forgotten, was served late 20 mins. I ordered a simple bread, 10 minutes to serve it. Time to pay my bill, OMG still takes so long, to think I only I ordered 2 items..
Palabok for 40 minutes estimated time? Might as well remove it in your menu. It was not even a full house.

Coffee was good that goes well with their much-raved cinnamon rolls.Waitstaff were friendly and warm. Attentive to customers' needs. Cozy place to hang-out with family and friends for a coffee break after too much shopping, walking or if you just want to while away time or need to meet-up someone in this mall. There might be other food fare aside from their cinnamons, other pastries are an option, too. It's at their 3rd Level Center portion. You wouldn't miss it. Highly recommended.
Good location, yummy pies. Just no wifi for the missing star
The blueberry cinnamon roll is great but their coffees are very meh. I ordered an Iced Caramel and it didn't taste like coffee at all.
Normally a nice coffee shop, but often you can't buy from the menu card. Sorry, not available, you'll often hear. Today no sandwiches available at all! Really disappointed.
I love their Bolognese!
Food's good but drinks are so bad as they use syrups for flavoring everything.
I should say that food is a must try, but service is close to poor, almost everytime I visit they run out of cold and hot drinks.. Learn how to manage your inventory. 🤭
Cozy
yummy and affordable, very cozzy
Seafood marinara not like other branches of Annipie. not recommended
I love me some cinnamon rolls.
THEY PLACE GOSPELS BEFORE CUSTOMERS!!

Craving something comforting tonight, so I ordered palabok from Annipie through Grab and thankfully, it didn't disappoint. The palabok arrived warm, flavorful, and satisfying. The sauce was rich and savory with generous toppings that made every bite enjoyable. Serving size was just right for a cozy comfort meal at home, and the packaging was secure too, kaya maayos talaga pagdating. Simple cravings, simple joys. Sometimes a good bowl of palabok is enough to brighten the day. #PitikNiLolie #PalabokCravings #DavaoFoodie #GrabFoodPH #ComfortFoodMoments

This is by far a must-try when in davao. Super sarap talaga nung classic lang. especially if you're not into super sweet cinnamon and yung butter na sakto lang, this is for you. Their coffee is so good too. We stayed in Davao for three days, and for three days also we had our caffeine fix and cinnamon here. Nag uwi pa dito sa Manila 🤣 thank you annipie! Great cinnamon bread!

Nice place for coffee and pasta. Their signature creamy carbonara is consistent. It has a lot of bacon bits and the serving size is enough for a lunchmeal. The furniture and the look of the shop also looks modern. Love this rising local brand. Keep it up Anniepie!
My go-to seafood marinara in town. It has lots of seafood in it. Super sulit. Always coming back.

This has been the WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE! Walay other customers pero it took them more than 20 minutes to prepare my salty caramel. Not to mention, sige rag chitchat ilang mga employees. And yes, it took sometime para ibalik ang change, so we left na lang. NEVER AGAIN!!!

ordered their cake for to go. they said their terminal for card wasnt working so they can only accept cash or gcash transactions. a bummer. the cake was good though. wanted to try out their pasta. maybe next time.

I only took a quick to-go coffee from this shop but ambiance inside seems appealing and clean. Service for to-go was average Coffee - size is small but taste was authentic and superb and worth its price, will definitely go back Staff - very attentive and friendly
One of our fave restau for meryenda ❤️

Cinnamon bun is a perfect pair for unsweetened brewed coffee. Though I find Annie Pie cinnamon rolls too sweet the good thing about this particular stall is that its location is perfect if you just want to relax and see people around walking or waiting for someone. Nothing much to tell. The price is great for the combo cinnamon bun and a cup of coffee (100php), which will cost you morethan 100php if you go to starbucks and krypykremes.

Anniepie is Davao city's equivalent to Cinnabon for less, like really less. They offer a lot of twist to the beloved cinnamon bun, but my favorite is the one with cream cheese on top, yum! It is also a very good "pasalubong" option to bring from Davao.
Late Review Oct 15, 2020 The Red Velvet cake was the best, Cake was Smooth and easy to consume, the Cream tasted amazing and the flavor balanced everything.
i always love their food. the palabok, the pasta, and their rice meals.
When you crave for cinnamon buns, you can't go wrong with anniepie. Offers you varieties at reasonable prices.

Poor Service, Cashier is Not Focus in taking order !! Waited an Hour for order that is not available!! asked the waiters several times for the order but was given the availability information after an hour!! Most of the Menu is also unavailable.
Great place for your bakery needs. Their cinnamon is good and also with their desserts. Great service.
Rude staff as they gave us our bill without asking for it pa coz they wanted us to leave. Decent cinnamon roll tho.
I love their brownies!

I love Annipie's food specially carbonara but the service here, in such a small restaurant is a mess. I asked for a reservation since the tables are full but 2 different customers came and they have them seated first even though I was just standing right in front of them. Very disrespectful. Their servers looks like they don't like their job. When they took the order, they were frowning and disinterested. Their best branch in terms of service I think is DGT.

They have stock sans rival. Their posting is 900+ whole, 100 + per slice, but they don't sell per slice. Just remove the per slice price, When we tried sm lanang and sm ecoland, Same. They don't sell per slice even though they have stock, how can we try your cakes if you sell them whole, How can we Endorse others w/o trying per slice.

If you're looking for a peaceful escape from the city, this farm restaurant is absolutely worth the drive. Nestled amidst lush greenery, with plants and trees all around, the ambiance is everything you could hope for—relaxing, cozy, and refreshing. The restaurant itself feels warm and inviting, making it a perfect spot to unwind. The food is delicious, satisfying, and surprisingly affordable, making the experience even better. Whether you're after fresh air, a beautiful setting, or a hearty meal, this place has it all.

Had a wonderful dining experience at Annipie The Farm. The food was delicious, the staff were friendly and accommodating, and the overall ambiance of the place was calm, peaceful, and relaxing. It's a great spot to slow down, enjoy a good meal, and appreciate the beautiful surroundings. Would definitely visit again.

This is our go to spot whenever we are in Tugbok or Calinan. I always order their suman paired with sikwate for a light snack, and it never disappoints. The atmosphere feels refreshing and very different from the usual downtown cafes, which makes the visit more relaxing. The staff are friendly, welcoming, and always pleasant to interact with.

I'm loving this place. Give it a shot ^ preferably during the day the view is breathtaking. I hope they will serve buko on a regular basis it would be so much fun to drink cold buko while enjoying the nature view.
More menu choices than your typical Annipie. It's got a forest vibe. Sudlonon pod sya. Perfect for a quick break from the city

Went here for lunch since our office is based in Mintal area, and I did not realize how far the location is from the main road! When we got there, the area was pretty serene and had this laid back vibe. The interior of the cafe was also very lovely. It's definitely a good place to go if you're looking for a relatively isolated and peaceful cafe. In terms of their food, everything that we ordered tasted good! Everybody who ordered said their meals were to their liking. If you don't mind traveling for a while, I would recommend this place.

Annipie @ The Farm live up to its name, farm settings on the entrance. this is one of family favourite lunch after sunday mass 🙏🏻 Highly recommended for anyone looking for a different ambiance restaurant with great food and even better vibes!

Went there around 2 pm on a holiday and it was very cozy and homey, the staff was very welcoming and attentive. Food wise usually I don't like cinnamon however, the blueberry cinnamon changed my perspective it complements well. However, the salty caramel drink was too sweet for our liking but the caramel was very rich. The pistachio White milk was very good and they did not skimp on the pistachio bits on the drink. Over all my experience was very amazing other staff from outside the cafe is very kind they answered our queries about what other produce they sell.

Location is bit far, and part of the road is narrow, but worth the trip. The farm looks serene, with nice vast landscapes and picnic areas. The restaurant structure is good, as well as the visual arts. The food choices are many and prices are reasonable. Service was top notch, courteous and attentive staff. Overall experience was great, highly recommended especially those who like something new and different than the city restaurants. I like the pavilion-like structure, which is the restaurant itself.

We arrived during the opening hour and we were the first customers so it's understandable why the service was a bit slow. The food was good and decently sized. Get the mushroom crisps! Nice to munch on. Loved the "old house" vibe of the resto and the wide garden.

Great place to visit. Big menu. Classic Annipie sweets such as cakes, cinnamon rolls, etc. Great coffee! Good service 👍🏽 great decorations and views to down the hills. Big garden around with lots of different flowers and trees. Kids playground. Outdoor sitting area. Romantic mood guaranteed! Peaceful and refreshing ...just Lovely! Took a lot for takeaway gifts. PS. Road construction around... drive carefully!

Annipie the Farm is a relaxing place relatively away from the city. We stayed at one of their tables in their open space since we had a dog with us. We love the natural and simple vibe of the place. Tables are separated well to encourage social distancing between groups and give ample privacy. They offer their usual menu options with very few farm exclusive items such as tamales and suman. I hope they add more farm exclusive items soon to attract more people. Nonetheless, food was good. Cinnamon rolls were delicious as usual. Service time may take a while since the place can be crowded, especially during weekends. I recommend reserving ahead to secure a table. Well recommended place.

If you are looking for a garden/farm set up then this place is for you. Has playground for kids. Priority booking for dine in but also caters walk in for open cottages/tables. Wide parking area. Accommodating personnel of course. Finally, high recommendations on their service and food. Their coffee shakes are actually better than Starbucks. Try them. You wont be disappointed. Recommended to friends and will visit again soon.

A great place to unwind and enjoy the nature away from bustling traffic in Davao City. Annipie is known to be the first cinnamon destination ever before other brands came in the Philippines. The farm has a very refreshing location. Perfect for couple dates or family dining. Outside the cafe is a playground, growing plants and fruits and more al fresco seating gazebos.

The place is nice and serene. The food is good but small servings. Pistachio cake is the best!! I also like the nachos salad. The seafood marina is not that good, hard calamari plus not so much seafood. The only downside of this place is that the signage they put along the road is not that clear. Google maps is accurate though but sometimes you get confused if this is the right way since there are no establishments around the area. Also negative side of it is that there are no signal around the area of the restaurant. They do have free wifi though. However if you need to call or text someone important, it is really hard especially if you get lost. I hope Annipie will put more signage especially around the highway area for easy direction. Overall, I will still recommend this place. It's nice and cozy. Will definitely go back and try their other menu items.

Although the The Farm is a bit distant from the National Highway, the food is worth it. The ambiance is good and is of good service to customers. Rice meals are a big thumbs-up. Good for family gatherings, among others. They also cater walk-ins, which is really commendable.

Coming in from the main Davao-Bukidnon highway, the road going to the place could be a challenge for some due one way traffic brought by on-going road widening and construction (edited Dec 2021). I guess it was not really a problem - we saw some cars, sedans and the like at the parking lot. Try to call or message first for reservations if you want to order food in advance and/or secure tables inside the restaurant. I just found out that the place is a smaller part of a 9-hectare family property. The landscape and amenities are so well-maintained. For your little ones, there is a mini playground for them to play in. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Comfort rooms are clean. Wi-fi is fast (tip: skip texting/calling your Bf or Gf, for Nature's sake- there's no signal here). You may opt to dine al fresco style, there are lots of tables at the right wing of the restaurant. We even saw some walk-in customers who were cool enough to not bother eating on a 'banig' (which the will restaurant provide) under a shade. Food is as always good especially when shared with loved ones and friends. If you're lucky on your visit, you get to sample some free native Durians as owners do their periodic harvests. Best to come in during weekdays since the weekends are expected to be packed with visitors.

From Ma-a going there, it will take you 35 minutes to get to the place. But before going, book a reservation first thru their FB page. There's a number of people during weekends so if you want to have the place all quiet and serene go there on weekdays. PLACE: the place was spacious and clean. However, when you go inside the cafe you will see a lot of FLIES. The waiter said they were trying to get rid of the flies but because they are near a piggery the flies just keep coming back. FOOD: we ordered binagoongan, tamales and suman, carbonara, palabok, the other one i forgot its name, garlic buttered chicken, brewed coffee and cinammon. I personally like the food better at Annie Pie Diversion Road (near the airport) especially their binagoongan and cinammon. Their cinammon was warm or reheated unlike in Tugbok it wasn't. Their carbonara was good! The tamales was new for us. The palabok was not that good. Cecils and Jollibee's palabok were way better. SERVICE: A lot of staffs were just staying at the cashier's area. Nobody was really attentive. Only one male staff was doing his job well. This is my personal experience. Still nice to try going there and check the place to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city life.

I've been hearing about this place from friends. The well-loved pastry shop owners opened their farm to the public. It's another alfresco dining that sprouts out in the city. I know it's a weekend and yes, the place despite its distance from the city, is flocked by Dabawenyos. You can either go here via Mintal, via Skyline or via Magtuod way. Ask Google or the locals! Basta sudlunon sya 😅 The place are teeming with people (which makes me paranoid these days) and better to go here early in the morning and on weekdays. Food is great but since it's swamped, orders take some time to be served. And be prepared with the langaw (flies) that abound! Fret not, the servers will put a candle for you. Customer service is on point. However, just surprised that they do not use the DQR system here.

Quite a drive going there but such a cozy place. They offer wifi so it's a good place to work in. Food is always delicious by Annipie, I definitely recommend the cakes and hot meals. Super good service and you can pet the dogs outside. They have a huge garden front as well that's nice to explore.

Only gripes are that the parking area could be a little more sedan friendly, and the flies inside the restaurant were also kind of bothersome. Edit (29 Dec 2024): Crispy palabok tasted good. +1 to atmosphere; flies were eliminated.

The place is a bit isolated. It looks like it is the only restaurant in the area. Still, your dining experience will be worth it. I always love the food of Anni Pie. It is our family's go to comfort food.
Far from the bustling district of downtown, a nice place to catch a breeze and rewind. The winds brushing against you, the frsh air and some freshly baked pastries.
Nice place! Cozy and excellent food to eat.

Location is quite far from the main city and is not accessible yet if you commute with jeepneys, though taxis are on point. So maybe you can just ride with a Mintal-route jeepney and hop off and take a taxi ride somewhere near the Mintal gym, if that make sense. Anyhow, if you happen to have your own vehicle you can reach the place via Langub Road from Maa or the road coming from Bangkal or Ulas, even from Puan. It's a shame that I was not able to take a lot of photos because I was not feeling it due to my "hangry" arrival,haha. Anger because of hunger.Lol. The place seems not in Davao City as it is peaceful and feels like you are in a province, well of course this is on top of their mouth-watering food menu offered. Service is great, warm smiles from the staff. I love their cinnamon bread and the pasta-oh-lala. Well I wanna go back to enjoy other recipes and take a lot of photos. When I went there, part of the road was under construction so just be patient.

The only thing that needs to improve is the lighting at the entryway during nighttime. It's so dark. Probably because the place is at best during daytime. Aside from that, the food was so good! Hickory porkchop literally melts in your mouth, I don't know how they achieved a very soft and tender porkchop, it blows my mind. Roasted beef was so good too. It's just not what I expect it to be, I thought it's like a steak, but it was rather served like a beef alfredo. It's delicious tho. Strawberry slush is like a watermelon slush or it's just me. The cheesecake de leche, I think, is just a dense leche flan, probably the densest leche flan I've had. No signages of where to park so I gues you can park anywhere.
Great short-getaway from the city. Good food
Over rated place. Nothing extra ordinary. Food is pricey compared to its taste and quality.
Good place to relax. As always the cinnamon amd their food is good
Value for money & great dinning experience. Very nice ambiance too🥰 …

No wow factor for me...We went here out of curiosity. I guess if they will improve the place it will be a plus factor.

A very relaxing place with their restaurant overlooking the mountains. Food is good. Coffee is also good. Cakes are delicious. The place is very rural. Thus the air is fresh. A nice place to go if you want to leave the hustle of the city

The food was great. The White Mocha was exceptional! The carbonara was umami to the fullest. We could have ordered more food except on the day we were there (Sunday) it takes forever for the dishes to arrive. Maybe because it's a bit crowded.
Really good food and place. With playground and farm feel.
relaxing ambiance 😊 pet friendly 🐶 delish 🍞 …

Very charming place. A lil bit off tbe grid but worth the visit.

a good destination for a short joy ride on a lazy weekday afternoon . if u plan to come by dusk, don't forget to bring your citronella lotion. and stay a little while after meal...you too might enjoy the garden.
We were the first customers for the day. The staffs were very friendly and accomodating. They have welcomed us warmly. However, there were limited options for food and some are not available.
If you want something off road, cool air breeze and cozy place but still around the city. This place is perfect for you and your family to chill, have some coffee and have some good food.

Garden setting, sorrounded with nature, very nice ambiance. Food is good and reasonably priced; it took a while to get served, I was about to get hangry. But it was all good.
Went here a couple of times in the last 2 years. Great destination for a long drive away from the city to chill.
Good food good place and ambiance 🤩 …
A place to go when you want peace and quiet day with family. Fresh air, green sorroundings and delicious cinnamon rolls.
Good place for a dinner, lunch or breakfast tho menu is no breakfast but dinner and cakes, nice surroundings and a quiet place
This is just a relaxing wonderful place to just sit for while savoring the atmosphere and food. The staff was great also.
The place looks great, fresh air, not so far from the city. Food is good.
Meals are ok, small servings. Give room for their sansrivals, the best in the city!

Food was alright as well as the drinks. It has a very nice decor and feels very cozy. The staff are very accommodating and helpful. I purchased one of the coffees on sale from the pantry and they served me hot water to taste my purchase.

Went here for a quick snack from the airport. My first time in Davao. I ordered a panini tuna which took so long to be served, about 20 mins. It had so little tuna in it, the least tuna ive had in any tuna sandwich. Photo below is 1 of 2 slices.

We went to Anniepie for breakfast expecting a relaxing start to the day, but unfortunately, it was a disappointing experience from beginning to end. We were seated for over 15 minutes without anyone coming to take our order or even acknowledge us. When we asked for water, we were told they couldn't provide any because their water tank had broken. The service was painfully slow, and when the food finally arrived, it did not make up for the wait. Sadly, both the service and the quality of the food fell far below what we had experienced before. It's frustrating to see a place we once enjoyed decline to this extent. Based on this visit, I can no longer recommend it.

The food tastes good but serving size is a bit smaller than the usual. The place looks really nice and spacious. What we do not like is the lack of training for servers. They are all over the place, busy but not active listeners to customers. We asked for water but it took a long time and a lot of follow ups before the glass of water got to our table. I suggest they train their servers well to be able to complement their beautiful restaurant.

We came on a monday at about 10 AM. There was a fair bit of crowd, I guess the proximity to the airport gives it an advantage. Having said that, I hope the management makes huge improvements on the food and the quality of service given that this is one of the first/last places a tourist could visit in Davao City. First and last impressions are everything. The food is so-so. Portions were small and were not prepared to standard. I ordered the breakfast platter and the sausages looked petrified and the texture was like rubber - clearly microwaved! The eggs were not cooked as per request - we had asked for the yolk to be runny. The dishes came in staggered fashion. My family was done with their meals before the breakfast platter was delivered to our table. And we probably followed up with the servers 3x, only to be waved off, ignored, and lied to. The staff in this place seem to think they owe the paying customers a favor. Left very disappointed and went to the airport annoyed instead of happy. Do better, Annipie Airport View.

The interior feel of this place is homey and clean…. Free WIFI….Brace yourselves for the meager serving of each plated dish good for one (yes, ONE CHILD). The tanginess of the Seafood Marinara was all right. (I can only count with one hand the seafood pieces)….The thin slice of bread that went with it was soggy and heavily drenched in butter (I almost passed out)…Too much dressing and croutons— it's a shame to even call it a Caesar Salad….Luckily, the sour Cool Cucumber fruity slush washed down the unsatisfied taste in my mouth….The inattentiveness and noise of the staff at 1 p.m. still would push me to try other foods but honestly, NOT in my top choices of places to eat… Not really fond of Cinnamon bread but the Assorted Bars are affordably tasty to bring home….
Hands down! What a great bakery and cafe. Amazing selection of cinnamon rolls, delicious coffee and well decorated interior. Highly recommend to check out in Davao.

We had dinner here and were pleasantly surprised how good the food was. The staff were extremely friendly and accommodating and the restaurant has a nice green feel with plants around. Next morning had breakfast there and was very nice.

Annipie is a must place to visit for food lovers. They have a variety of drinks and food to choose from. The comfort room is clean, though the parking limited. Security personnel will assist you, they are visible in the area. This place os near to Davao Airport, so of you are waiting for your flight and you don't want to get inside the busy airport yet, consider Annipie. It is also close to some hotels.

Had breakfast and lunch here last May 14, 2023. What we ordered: Breakfast - Anniepie Breakfast Platter, Pancit Palabok (big serving, it's actually good for two), Smoked Bacon (daming bacon, napa-order ng extra rice ang kasama ko 😆), hot chocolate drink (tasted like swiss miss with marshmallow which I liked, but my friend wanted to taste tablea so he was a little disappointed), Pistachio sans rival cake to-go (I wish I could take some home pero hassle sa flight 🥲) Lunch - Pulled pork quesadilla, Annie's Carbonara (we wanted to order another one if not for the lack of time) Food was great, place was very clean and aesthetic, servers were helpful, and the location is ideal. Pistachio sans rival cake is a must-try!
Really cozy and aesthetic place to work and eat. They adequate food choices and the food tastes great. Service is accommodating and friendly. Thank you!
Great bakery and refresh parlour. Very clean and excellent ambience. I highly recommend this place to must have seen it and taste their delicious variety of cakes and pastries

Annipie is still go to place to me, they maintain the good service, they upgraded their menu and the cakes. its a must try. And the cinnamon 😝😝 Still the best place. specially on this location. It's quite and great ambiance. …

For starters, the food looks NOTHING like the pictures on the menu and was not fresh AT ALL (especially on the breakfast platter). Everything served was microwave cooked INCLUDING the egg?? And despite this lazy "effort", we had to wait for this mediocre meal for 30 minutes despite constant follow ups. Staff members were also disrespectful and lazy whenever we requested for our order to be followed up.
Food: taste was ok. However, the quantity was really really small. Not worth!! Service: soso. Nothing special. Atmosphere: nice and cozy
Their flavored iced tea can be requested to be served hot. It's worth a try. It's refreshing!!!
Food was good. Service was slow during the lunch hour. Took 30 minutes for someone to start clearing our table. I think the staff were overwhelmed by a full restaurant.
I like the peach mango fruity slush, ok din yung Annipie's Breakfast Platter and cinnamon rolls.
Great place to chill and relax while waiting for your scheduled flight. Also great for table meetings and good ambience to talk with friends.
The food was delicious. Both rice meal and desserts. They also served plant-base meal.

1 stars because of the overcharging. Inside is nice and clean and inviting. Service is poor. Food was fair. Breakfast was good, bacon, sausages, and cinnamon roll were cold. Sandwiches were ordinary and skimpy. Cake was dry. My girlfriend and I visited 5/21/25 for breakfast & lunch to go. When we came in we were motioned to choose a table. After about 5 – 10 minutes of waiting and another group coming in I got up and asked if we needed to order at the counter. I was told that someone would be with us soon. After waiting a bit longer, my girlfriend waived down a guy to take our order. He seemed like he didn't want to be there. In fact the whole staff seemed apathetic. Our order included silog breakfasts, espresso drinks, 2 sandwiches to go, and 2 pieces of cake to go. They had a regular and large size for the espresso drinks. No volume was shown, so I asked if the large was about 500 ml and I was told it was. I specifically asked if the drink was that large because I wanted a large drink that I could drink at breakfast and take with me if I didn't finish it. I also asked how many shots for a large Americano and I was told only 1. So, I asked for a total of 4 shots. I did not ask for how much each extra shot cost and this was a mistake. There were no extra shots in my girlfriend's drink. Instead of 500 ml drinks we got tall narrow mugs which were maybe 300 ml. My girlfriend's drink was 190 pesos and mine without the extra 3 shots was 130 pesos. This is where the craziness and overcharging begins. After we ate and got our orders to go, I asked for our bill. The 3 extra shots were 95 pesos each!!! That is $1.71 for each shot at the current full exchange rate and would be $1.90 at 50 pesos to the dollar. 285 pesos for only shots! I asked the waiter why was the price so high for the shots? I was told it was the regular price for extra shots. He then got the Mgr (I guess). I tried to explain to her that even a high end restaurant wouldn't charge so much and that I typically pay 35 cents (20+ pesos) to 75 cents (32+ pesos) for each extra shot. It made no difference. I did not experience overcharging my whole month in the Philipinnes until now. There's no excuse for it! Another thing my girlfriend noticed was that the drinks tasted like they were made with instant coffee. This was what I noticed, too, but I didn't want to say anything. This was her own assessment and I agree. So, we got 2 instant coffee "espresso" drinks for a total of 475 pesos. What a deal! I paid the bill instead of arguing further and we left. Annipie's is a ripoff! I buy fresh coffee beans and grind my coffee each morning. I am also a very good cook. I am fully aware of what food costs and how food should taste. I am also taking home with 1 kg of fresh medium roast arabica coffee beans grown near Mt. Apo. The service at Annipies is poor, they serve instant coffee instead of espresso, and overcharge wherever they think that they can get away with it. Hopefully, none of this happened because I am a foreigner and sufferred the white man tax. It looks like that might be the case, though. SHAME ON YOU ANNIPIES!

I was sitting there for 10min and nobody bothers to take my order. I have to go to the counter to ask for service. Breakfast platter is served without providing a knife or ketchup..cinnamon bread is not heated up.. Sausages, bacon and eggs are not warmed up... Terrible...

I went here because I needed to wait for my parents delayed flight for about 3 hours. I love their ultimate cinnamon. Not too sweet & chewy bread. Definitely would go back esp when I have to pick up someone at the airport.

We had a libre-ni-sis family lunch on Black Saturday. The sun is high but it didn't stop us in getting there. Parking is not a problem, not a single bit since Airport View compound itself has a lot of it. Albeit the heavy door to open, you get to feel cooler temperature inside. The ambience is good- with high ceiling and ample lighting. Inside, there are a lot of tables and chairs, whether it's for two or a group of ten! Should you wish to go al-fresco, no problemo as they too have sets of tables with chairs outside. Plantitas and titos, you'll love this place as potted plants abound, both in and out. Books are also part of the interior design. Food and concoctions are delicious and priced just right. I must admit, I was so full I didn't have the gastro-confidence no more for a dessert. A plateful serving of their caldereta meal had me at hello. Service water is not a thing here (for sanitary purposes), but you can order some bottled water or bring your own instead. There's also a small stall at one of its corners called Farm To Table Pantry. They sell a wide array of items from potted plants, vegetables to locally-made gourmet coffee, chocolates, perfumes, honey, tableya, skin care, beauty products, novelty items, wooven bags and more. The staff were great. The gang loved the place and so am I. Just like Arnold S. said in a movie, "I'll be back."

review_text: There is absolutely no value for money here. Almost 200 for a Frappuccino style ice blended drink and it is served in an 8 oz cup with 25% whipped cream... Pancit was barely enough for 2 even with rice added. But if you are not to particularly concerned about these things, it is a good place to chill for a while between trips to and from Davao Ecoland Bus Terminal, just a short walk it's a clean comfortable spot with a decent menu.

The iced matcha drink was disappointing—its pale color already showed it was low quality. Even after thorough mixing, powder still settled at the bottom and couldn't blend in. Unfortunately, the drink feels overpriced for what it delivers. We also ordered the Annipie breakfast and tocino, but both tasted like they had just been reheated, lacking freshness. Definitely not worth trying. On a positive note, the café itself is cozy and clean, but sadly, the food and drinks don't justify the price.

I had been to the Annipie in Abreeza Mall and it was a much better experience food wise. Our main course portions were very small and my Chicken Cordon Bleu was very dry. The Pork Binagoongan was flavorful, but a very small serving. Also tried the Cool Cucumber Slush and it checked all the boxes; very good! On the positive side, the staff were helpful, friendly and courteous and the place was very clean.

Yes, they serve great cakes & cinnamons but did you know that they also offer other comfort food that are awesome tasting as well? Check out their unforgetable crispy palabok and their heavenly lomi that should leave you asking for more. Whole place is instagram-worthy so that makes it even more worth a visit or two. Or three.

All the foods on the menu are sumptuous. Carbonara is a must-try for pasta lovers. They have rice meals, sandwiches, pastas, pizzas, comfort foods, cakes, brownies, cinnamons and many more. Their coffees are also delightful. Parking space in front of the restaurant is available. They can cater to small birthday or family celebrations. They accept reservations. This is a must-try place if you are within the vicinity. They have clean facilities aside from the fact that the staff are courteous. The ambiance is likewise cozy.

I recommend ordering their Annipie breakfast platter. I love the cinnamon bun -- the cinnamon taste is not overpowering other flavors of the bread. Spanish latte and cafe mocha is also good -- worth the price ❤️

Annipie is one of Davao City's most underrated restaurants. Many of their dishes can easily become homegrown staples because they taste like home and taste sooo good. Make sure to try Adobo Cream Pasta, Three Cheese Pizzatilla, Garlic Butter Chicken, and Cool Cucumber Shake. Don't forget to enjoy their Classic Cinnamon Roll (which can easily beat Cinnabon in terms of taste and price), as well as their wide array of cakes. Cheesecake De Leche is my absolute favorite, especially when paired up with brewed coffee. Design-wise, the restaurant is impeccably styled with wooden panel walls, faux grass ceiling, and clean architecture. The place is perfect for group meals or some alone time over a piece of cake.

Annipie has surely crafted their pastries elegantly and flawlessly brewing their coffee. Always a great choice as a "go-to" bakery especially for a sweet tooth person. A flavors that mingle and dance, creating a perfect harmony on the taste buds. They also have meals on their menu. We had a great time visiting the cafe. The staff are friendly too. The ambiance is cozy. Making it more welcoming.

Many food options are available. I was able to try their palabok, nachos with bacon and cheese, cinnamon buns, latte, and hot matcha. Their cinammon buns are highly recommended, especially the cream cheese flavored ones. Service was efficient and they open early in the morning during weekdays, just in time for breakfast at 7am. They have numerous seats available, and toilet is provided inside the resto.

Limited parking space at the front was cramped. I wouldn't be surprised if my vehicle had a ding (at the right) while we were already dining inside. Too tight getting in and out of the vehicle door. Late lunch but the food was out really quick. Too hungry to savor what we ordered: Seafood Marinara, Kiwi Crush, Cappuccino, Pansit Palabok, and a square of brownie. Company-owned or a franchise? Dunno, but I can only compare this with the one at Airport View. Soupy pasta and serving size was for one person. Is this normal? The exact same pasta at Airport View was dry and smaller in size. I wonder if the other branches are at odds also with the menu. Well, I just expected a bit of similarity between both branches. (And that's just two I've tried). Prices are reasonable. Counter staff not attentive past the busy lunch hour. Not top notch but I would still go here to feed myself when I'm in the area.

My family and I had a late lunch here. We tried the palabok and pasta, and everything was very delicious. The revel bar, brownies, and cinnamon roll were really good. The place was clean and nice, and the staff were friendly. I'm also obsessed with their yuca plant. I highly recommend this place.

The food is really expensive for what you get. The fries especially, they just had powder sprinkled over them. I could've gotten the same thing at potato corner for less. Felt sort of cheated walking out the restaurant.

This coffee shop may be off the beaten path, but it is a good find. The inside is bigger than the review pics show and can seat around 35 people, but there were only 2 other people there when we arrived on Sunday around noon. Some food menu items were not available, so we decided on coffee and pastry. A hot vanilla latte and a mocha latte and the pastry was the Croffle. Our coffee's were rich, smooth and lightly sweetened. I was expecting the Croffle (we shared it) to be rich and heavy, but it was light and went well with our coffee. Our server was friendly and helpful. The place was clean and comfortable, WiFi is available and the bathroom was clean. You will be happy you gave Apo Cafe a try!

Trust me, the Spanish Latte Cold Brew is a must try. Also liked their cream puff. It was a quick stop but worth it. Will definitely check out other items on the menu next time. Service was also great, despite a busy time. Keep it up

Staff are always in a rush even during slow hours. 3 out of the 4 times I ordered in person (3 dine-in, 1 take-out) the one who took my order seemed like they were in a rush. my first 2 visits, i encountered the same barista. Talked fast with a monotonous unwelcoming tone. 3rd time was a different guy. he was the most neutral, like what you'd expect from cafes. 4th and most recent visit, this was the most annoying of them all. I was ready to say my usual order, their famous spanish cold brew 16oz. When the lady behind the counter asked for my order, i said "isa pong spanish cold brew s—" then she interrupted me by saying "size po?" even tho i was about to say it. and then when i said "sixtee—" she cut me AGAIN by saying "for here or to go". After taking my order, i was told to wait for a bit for the card payment (she took orders but queued the payments) so i decided to sit down. When she called me, i stood up next to the people in line because i was only going to pay and they were still making their order. the barista then told me "one line lang po sir". me, embarrassed, went to the back of the line. the barista then looked at me and said "dito lang po sir for payment" referring to the front of the line. even the other customers looked confused with her directions. drink is good but its not worth the terrible service

Spanish cold brew is my go to but somewhat the milk has changed? I dont know if others would agree with me. Last year was so good that I had to order it several times via grab but had a little bit of pause this year's caffeine in take. The taste changed when I ordered dine in a day ago.

I'm at a loss for words to convey how exceptional their Spanish Cold Brew beverage is. If you're in search of it, this cafe is the ultimate destination. Despite its cozy size, it's a bustling spot, frequented by many daily. The owners are incredibly involved and hospitable, and their team follows suit. They also use high-quality local coffee beans. Don't hesitate to grab your atCurbside drink and savor it with their exquisite pastries!

The place is a bit far off from the busy streets as it's located in a residential area. When we got there, there was no signage in sight to tell you that you're at the cafe. The cafe is really small inside as It can only accommodate 2 people. As for their alfresco seating, it can also only accommodate approximately five maybe six people so that's something to consider when you want to get something to drink here. In terms of their drinks, I ordered their vegan horchata since I wanted to know what horchata tastes like and as for my boyfriend, he ordered their chocolate milk. Horchata is a bit of an acquired taste, but I personally liked it. It tastes kind of like soy milk. As for the chocolate milk, I also liked it since the sweetness was balanced out by the bitter flavor of chocolate. Will try to order their coffees next time. Lastly, I recommend getting there milk cake. It's my favorite from their line of pastries! Overall, would still recommend.

Found inside an open subdivision, you can drive past this unassuming park-drop-go cafe without a clue….Signage is discreet. (Oh wait, there's no signage, only sun shades)….The couple of Grab/Food Panda riders crossing in front helped me in a way. The Spanish Cold Brew vividly reminds me of a similar Saint Brunch latte (from Saint Brunch)….Others I sampled are the Sea Salt Cold Brew, Cream Puff, and Milk Cake— all surpassed my expectations. Truly a local pride!
Coffee and food is great. I love their Spanish cold brew. But the place is too crowded. Mostly with students as it's near a school. Not good if you want to work or just wanna have some quiet time.
The best coffee in Davao for casual drinkers! I always bring first-time visitors to try their Cold Brew Spanish Latte, and it leaves them wanting more every single time.
Best iced coffee in the city with their Spanish cold brew. The place is quite small to dine in but the quality of their drinks is superb.

@atcurbside is a delightful surprise that I got to experience during one of my rides in my hometown. The street is quite serendipitous for me as it was where I had spent most of my childhood years, and you bet this place now holds a special spot in my heart. Verdict 🍰All of their pastries are incredibly delicious, and I'm not even a cake person! I love their Mango Charlotte and Milk Cake. You'd think they're super sweet, but are actually balanced in taste and serving size. (But tbh, I could eat a whole Milk Cake by myself) ☕I've only ever tried their Spanish Cold Brew Latte (for the coffee-based drinks) and as they put it, it's a good introductory caffeinated drink for people who are new to coffee. It is quite refreshing and has enough caffeine to get me through the day. 🍵Their homemade tea is just as refreshing. Cleanses your palate well while enjoying all the cakes and quesadillas. 🍕Their beef quesadilla is not heavily marinated with powdered mixes and spices, it tastes just right. I love how each bite doesn't come with any guilt. 🍨Their affogato is a perfect cold dessert, with the nuttiness of the coffee blending well with their ice cream. I am a fan. Apart from the location and food, the owners (who run the entire place), are accommodating and friendly. I chanced upon their pop-up in December 2021, but they were already closing then, so I ended up buying their portafilter and steaming pitcher keychains instead. :D

It's a restaurant and a coffee shop at the same time where you can dine with family or study with your friends/classmates (while drinking coffee). The establishment isn't remote as it is located at the Downtown area and can be found easily in front of the Grand Menseng Hotel (Magallanes). I wanna highlight the servers who were very kind and accommodating. They even played a happy birthday song in speakers for my Mom (she felt shy at first) but something that we really appreciated. They also have a private/exclusive room for private celebration featuring a huge group. Another highly recommended restaurant in Davao! 🤍✨

The food is okay, enough to satisfy your hunger if that's the goal, but it's not something I'd go out of my way for. The same goes for the coffee. The pricing matches the portions and service. The staff is also just okay. They're not particularly friendly or polite, but at least they're not rude. The layout is a bit inconvenient as well, the pickup areas for food and coffee are separate. You can also see staff frequently passing through the main area. One thing I noticed is that they don't issue receipts, which is really odd. They also don't accept card payments. We're almost in 2026, cash feels very antediluvian, bank transfers are too much of a hassle, and QR payments aren't as convenient as a simple tap or swipe with a credit card.

I had a wonderful experience at Barok Cafe & Resto. The food is impressive, especially considering the reasonable prices. I particularly enjoyed the pasta, chicken wings, and fries—each dish was flavorful and satisfying. Their coffee and pastries are also noteworthy, making it a great spot for both full meals and light snacks. What made this place even more special is that I celebrated my son's 9th birthday here, upon his personal request. He really loves the food, especially the flavored wings and fries, which are perfect for kids and definitely a hit with him. It made the celebration more meaningful, knowing he truly enjoys dining here. The restaurant is clean and cozy, with a comfortable ambiance that's perfect for casual dining or special occasions. And the fact that Barok Cafe & Resto operates 24 hours is a rare find in Davao City—such a convenient option when looking for good food any time of day. I'm genuinely glad to have discovered this place. If you're looking for quality food, a kid-friendly menu, a relaxing atmosphere, and round-the-clock service, I highly recommend giving this restaurant a try.

We have been here to Barok Cafe two times and have been very satisfied each time. Friendly and helpful staff, clean cafe and great food and coffee. Some items on the menu were not available, but there were still plenty of good options. We both had pork Sisig and it was prepared well and tasted great. We also tried hot and iced Spanish lattes and salted Carmel and Carmel macchiato lattes. Overall very pleased with our experiences here. Update: we have tried their baby back ribs several times now and probably the best I have ever had. We come here once a week and leave happy each time.

I don't usually leave harsh reviews, but this experience deserves an honest warning. This restaurant operates on a self-service system, which is perfectly fine in theory. But what makes the experience incredibly frustrating is that they have a surprisingly large number of staff members who are mostly just standing around doing nothing. Despite clearly seeing customers juggling multiple orders, no one offers even the smallest bit of help. No assistance with service water, no initiative to check on orders—nothing. What really pushed this from mildly inconvenient to completely unacceptable was the drink service. We ordered a simple canned Coke. A canned drink that is literally sitting in their fridge. Somehow, it still took 20 minutes after our food was already served before we got it. And to make things worse, we had to personally follow up just to get a canned soda. This wasn't a one-time mistake either. The exact same thing happened on every visit we've had here (mostly invites so I had no choice) Waiting that long for something that requires zero preparation is honestly baffling, especially in a place with so many staff members present but seemingly unwilling to help. If you're going to run a self-service restaurant, at least make sure the basics—like handing out a canned drink—don't take longer than preparing the actual meal. Not to mention, their food is extremely salty. The pasta poorly overcooked. Extremely disappointing experience. Did not live up to their hype at all!

Customer service was below expectations—we were not greeted warmly, and we even had to clean our own table before sitting down. The atmosphere inside was loud and chaotic, making it difficult to enjoy the meal or hold a conversation. Overall, the cleanliness and service standards need serious improvement.
