This chic, contemporary establishment perfectly complements the neighborhood's serene ambiance. Part artisanal café, part upscale bistro, it boasts an impressively curated menu that I've detailed below. As is typical with any buzzworthy opening, the local community has arrived in droves—the energy was absolutely electric and the house was packed.

The café looks really nice and is very aesthetically pleasing. The staff are friendly, but it can feel a bit awkward when multiple people greet you at the same time. The food still needs some improvement. The pasta lacks flavor, but the coffee and shakes are good. The waiting time was also quite long—it took almost an hour even though there weren't many customers. Overall, it has potential. I'd rate it 7/10 and would still recommend trying it.

We recently visited this café and while the place itself is really beautiful and aesthetically pleasing, the overall experience was honestly disappointing. The service was extremely slow nd we waited around 30 minutes only to find out that our order hadn't even been prepared or possibly wasn't listed properly. When we followed up, it still took a long time, and when we tried to cancel, we were told to wait "just 5 more minutes." pero super tagal pa rin. When the order finally arrived, it got worse, ksi may parang basag na plastic sa cream, which was honestly alarming since it could've been accidentally eaten. We really liked the ambiance, but the service and food safety issues definitely need serious improvement.

First off, place is aesthetically pleasing. Food is okay, advantage ang menu na some options are not commonly found anywhere else. But the service, my goodness, it was sooo slow. I thought because at first kasi understaffed lang, but I went during a Sunday noon, it wasn't very crowded. But magbibigay lang ng menu para makastart na ako pili, it took about 5-10 mins trying to get the attention of the waiter (isa lang siya when I first got inside). In hindsight, that should've been my first red flag. Then, later on nung nadagdagan na ng wait staff and more customers dined in, ganun pa rin ang speed, di nagbago. Matagal nabigay ang food. Pati magbill out and magpabalot ng food to be taken home, matagal rin. From dining area, to kitchen, to cashiering, matagal talaga lahat. I dunno what needs more training, speedier cooking, more observant waiting staff, more customer service, faster bill out?? I'm aware that they just started this year in March, so they're still trying to build a system, but if only services would've been faster, I would've enjoyed my time much, much better. Perhaps, start assigning the wait staff clear areas of responsibility and memorize table numbers. At least diyan, we can start there.

It's called Café Club. A small café with friendly service. I asked for a proper cup because, as a coffee lover, I never drink coffee or cappuccino from plastic or paper-plastic hybrid cups. But they only have plastic. It's not just bad taste, it's downright criminal for the environment. Nobody who loves coffee wants to drink it from a plastic cup. Perhaps people don't realize that paper cups are also made of 40% plastic and, like almost all disposable cups, can't be recycled. They end up in the ocean or in waste incineration plants, producing toxic fumes. With more than 60 billion disposable cups and sachets in the Philippines alone, that's the largest share of any country in the world. And the bad taste is an added bonus.

review_text: It's our second time here. ⭐️ 1 star for service — not because the staff weren't attentive or helpful, but because of the poor basic service. We had to ask for service water before it was given, when it should be standard procedure to serve water while customers are waiting for their orders, right? We also asked for any kind of hot sauce — not available. And worst of all, when we requested for table napkins, they said none were available! Imagine dining without napkins? So disappointing. I ordered the Aglio Olio, and the toasted bread on the side was literally soaked in oil instead of being toasted. Definitely not a pleasant dining experience.

The food is great, and I really enjoyed it. However, some of the drinks had a slightly odd taste, maybe it's the beans, though it could just be my personal preference. The atmosphere overall is decent. That said, I'd like to point out a few concerns. This morning, some of the staff were quite noisy, which was noticeable since many of the customers were students trying to study or work. A few even had to move seats because they couldn't focus due to the noise. I also observed that tables were not being cleared promptly. Used plates and glasses were left on tables for a while, making the place look messy and affecting the overall ambiance. Another issue I experienced was at the cashier. They kept asking for the exact amount when paying. While I understand the need for smaller bills or coins, it was frustrating because I was unable to provide the exact amount at the time. Because of this, I ended up not ordering additional food, which was disappointing. Overall, the food is good, but I hope these areas, especially staff behavior, table maintenance, and payment flexibility can be improved to enhance the customer experience.

Great little coffee shop. It's on a narrow side street but not hard to find. Dropped by on a Tuesday morning around 9 and I was the only customer although a couple people came in while I was there. I was greeted upon entry and the place was clean. They roast coffee right there in a separate room with big windows to watch. I wanted something cold so I ordered the Summer. This drink was fantastic! Espresso, sliced apples, lemon and a splash of passion fruit. I could have easily drank a few of these, but probably not a good idea! Haha! CR was clean and a great experience here!

Good thing they have air conditioning now! I love the new renovations they did — the place feels more comfortable and refreshing. Their matcha could use a bit of improvement, but I absolutely love their coffee and pastries.

Heard about this place because of the opening of Uniqlo Davao. Walked here from the Acacia or Ponciano area. Second customer. Got the iced 12oz Summer Innovator and the iced 12oz Matcha Milk from the Kid at Heart menu. There was no stock of pastries so we just took out our Wildflour cranberry walnut loaf slices. The Summer drink was interesting but I just wished it was citrus sweet like adding a satsuma. The matcha milk was okay and great that it had no clumps. It was ready to serve anyways. Overall, the prices were fair but do update your menu whenever food or drinks are out of stock.

Fourth Street Cafe has established itself as a peaceful, minimalist haven in Davao City, offering a Nordic-inspired aesthetic that feels both modern and comfortable. While it appears they've shifted their focus away from a full menu of short orders, this has only sharpened their dedication to what they do best: coffee and pastries. Their coffee truly stands out. The cafe boasts a top-tier Sanremo Cafe Racer espresso machine, a clear sign of their commitment to quality. The baristas know their craft, and it shows in every cup. A personal favorite is the Summer Innovators—a unique and delicious blend of two shots of espresso, water, crisp apple slices, and a vibrant lemon-passionfruit mixture. It's an incredibly refreshing and inventive take on a classic espresso drink, perfect for the local climate. Beyond the expertly crafted beverages, the cafe supports local coffee culture by offering a selection of locally sourced Davao beans alongside some Colombian varieties. This allows customers to not only enjoy a great cup in the moment but also take a piece of the cafe experience home. If you're looking for a quiet spot to enjoy a meticulously prepared coffee and a satisfying pastry in a beautifully designed space, Fourth Street Cafe is the place to be.

It's not at all common to find a coffee place here that opens early. And when you do, like this shop —- surely you will love the soft and moist banana muffin, summer (black cold brew w/ apple slices), choco chip muffin, and honey oat latte. Narrow street, clean place, affordable rates and quick service. Be sure to hop in as early as 7 a.m. to get your fill.

First of all, thank God for a coffeeshop that opens before 9am. The place is very good if you come here before lunch time as the place is alfresco. I probably wouldn't recommend coming here during lunchtime though as the heat from the outside radiates inside. Their aesthetic is very clean and minimalistic, which is also translated to their coffee menu as I have a hard time ordering their coffee because of the unusual labeling. In terms of the functionality of the space, it's a bit uncomfortable because of the seats. They don't really have backrests so if your just planning for a quick coffee stop, or if your planning to kill time alone while waiting for your friends or family, then this is the place to go. As for their coffee, I ordered their white coffee which I liked as it had the strong coffee flavor which was not overpowered by the milk. My boyfriend ordered their mocha, which was also good. A perfect blend of coffee and chocolate. Would recommend!
Shop was renovating/expanding its service area when we visited so it smelled of paint. For a coffee shop, the banana muffin was a standout.

We were in Davao last February 2023 and this was listed as one of the brunch places nearby. Unfortunately, when we got there, we were informed that they no longer serve food. Instead, we just tried their Spanish Latte and Hot Chocolate. We got to chat with who I presume is the owner and he mentioned that they are a specialty coffee shop. I liked their Spanish Latte, although I would've loved it more if it were a bit stronger. The vibe of the coffee shop is very clean and minimalist. It's perfect to have your morning coffee. They also have a small outdoor area if you want to have more privacy. It's conducive for dates and studying. I would suggest for them to bring back their food items and maybe some desserts to pair with their coffee. And also maybe they need more fans, especially during the summer. Overall, this is one of the top coffee shops that I've tried in Davao who serve well-made coffee.

One of the best specialty coffee shops to visit in Davao City! It's not just about the aesthetics, the real highlight is their coffee. Unlike places where overly sweet and milky drinks overpower the coffee, here, you truly get to taste and appreciate the coffee itself. Whether you're looking for a cozy spot to relax or just grabbing a quick cup on the go, this place is perfect. The baristas are friendly, and the owner is just as welcoming. They've also recently introduced a selection of pastries—muffins, croissants, kouign-amann, and more, perfectly complementing their coffee. Definitely a must-visit!

Heard great things on google, and they are all correct. The barista takes his time to make sure everything comes out well. Beans are sourced locally, and I got the iced mocha for 100 pesos. They have clean water on tap, which I appreciated after my workout. The mocha was delicious and well-balanced. So glad I made the trip out here, and you should too!

Delicious 8oz coffee. I wished they had better comfortable chairs. I don't know if they renovated, but the place is smaller than previous sight photos listed here. There is just a U-bench, and 2 stools for sitting. No free wifi.
Coffees great, they allow me to bring food from outside.

Absolutely thrilled to have discovered 4th Street Cafe in Davao City! This gem opens its doors as early as 6:30 am, making it the perfect spot for early risers like myself. The dedication to serving exceptional coffee is evident in every cup. The minimalist design of the cafe creates a soothing atmosphere that's perfect for savoring every sip. Please note, they specialize exclusively in coffee, ensuring that every brew is perfected to perfection. The barista's craft is truly remarkable, reminiscent of the coffee experiences I've had in Melbourne (Australia). If you're searching for a place with great coffee and a cozy ambiance, look no further than 4th Cafe!

I am amazed with this cafe's concept. No tables. Just benches. It's refreshing to think that people buying coffee here just lounge at benches. You can either catch a conversation with a random person in the cafe or just sit quietly over a cup of affogato. Their coffee is really good, by the way.
God bless cafes with plant-based milk options. I can enjoy matcha again 🥹 Plus the menu items are very affordable 💖

tbh was taken aback when i saw that it was open air because it was really a warm day however worth it naman because the price is really affordable ( maybe because they dont have aircon). 5/5 for the coffee, very aromatic and unique! Their spanish latte accentuates the Mt Apo beans they used and does not cover the coffee with the " condense" flavor. The baristas were also very kind and accomodating. would definitely come back if i return to davao, totally worth it. coffee lovers out there, do try and taste the difference :)

There's a place and they make good on their promise: we pour happiness. Located in a quiet street on Narra, this coffee spot is one we keep coming back to. Their 0104 is a fave and packs quite a punch with 4 shots of espresso. Feel like getting something fruity but still with coffee? Get yourself "summer" ~ it's like a mocktail but coffee. Looking for something to cap off a heavy meal, something sweet but still with coffee? Get an affogato, it's the perfect drink/snack (whichever you prefer).

THEY POUR HAPPINESS AT 4TH STREET CAFE. Learn 'coffee science' and the art of preparing specialty coffee at Fourth Street Cafe with the owner himself JB Herrera. It's a great learning experience with fun-filled environment! Thanks to JB and to the award-winning barista Mr. John Rey Plaza. We enjoyed and learned so much about coffee — from farming to roasting to brewing and to pouring happiness in every cup! ☺️☕💯👌 #weekend #DavaoCity

Fourth Street coffees are a must-try for any coffee lover! ☕️ My partner and I have tried several of their options like Black, Mocha, DME, and 0104 and they were all delicious. We also got to try their Christmas Special (Matcha Latte with vanilla ice cream) and it was amazing! 📍 The café has a minimalist design that makes it perfect for early morning and late-night visits, providing a peaceful and calm atmosphere. They don't mess around with frills, just good, straightforward coffee. 👨🏻 🍳 The staff is also very friendly and helpful. On our first visit, we didn't know what to order and the barista took the time to explain the different drinks and recommend something that would suit our taste. 🏷 The price point is also great value for such good coffee. Overall, Fourth Street never disappoints. It's definitely a must-visit!

Our favorite coffee in Davao (so far!) Love the minimalist approach, the friendly baristas and the cafe's airy & relaxing atmosphere. Most affordable coffee (for us) but the taste exceeds the price! Opens at 10 and meters away from Kaos. This spot used to be Grind Coffee. I went down to grab some affordable and tasty drinks. Too bad no pastries in sight. Parking was obstructed too with a sign so I was there really quick.

Not a good experience, the cashier told me when I ask for a coffee from the coffee machine at 2 am that only 3 in 1 coffee is available. I've been going to Glasshouse since my college days, and I used to really like this place. But lately, the customer service has been disappointing. This is actually a late review but I don't want to miss it. It is one of the most beautiful coffee shops I've been to. Glasshouse Coffee is near Tola. The ambiance was so nice. The playlist they had was calming. Their bagel was good and their carrot cake, too. We love their brownies and cookies and we took it home since we weren't able to finish it. We really love the place and I'd like to come back again to try more from their menu. I already forgot if they have an internet connection but because of the serenity of the place, it's a good spot to be alone or to study.

At this moment I feel like I am inside an aquarium. It's cool but I feel the need to surface for oxygen. The flat white is small. The carrot cake is good and sweet. The aircon is cold. But 330p for a tiny coffee and a piece of cake? This is the developing Philippines. What will happen in the next 5 or 10 years???

Overall a good coffee shop experience, even greater thank normal because they have the roastery inside the shop, spreading the aroma of freshly roasted coffee inside. The staff was knowledgable about their beans and was able to recommend one that fits my preference of chocolatey and earthy without the floral fruity notes, dark roast of course, and paired it with caramel to bring out the coffee that I wanted. The atmosphere, to me, was really nice, and the concept of a glass house with wooden structures made it feel like I was in a Korean Hanok or okd japanese houses
Love the place. Great coffee. But no WiFi and many many mosquitoes. I understand you prefer people to stay to chat and read but sometimes we have another needs, like open laptop and do random stuff.

Glasshouse Coffee is my go-to coffee shop in Davao City. I always order Iced Americano, paired it with plain croissant. I usually go here to pass time whenever I run some errands in the city or relax before mountain climbing the next day. The location is a reminder of how green spaces make things even better. They have a small menu since they have a small kitchen. They serve some cakes to pair up with your beverage. Ambiance and coffee is really good. It amuses me that they are using vinyl record/cassettes for music. The reservation is organized too, to avoid being crowded. If I may suggest, snacks like pastry, bread, sandwiches or pastas can be added on the menu to complement the coffee.
Great coffee place! The claim of being a "specialty coffee shop" is legit and I love the shop already. It's so peaceful in here. I will definitely come back once I'm in Davao again.

I like the place. It's quite relaxing. The plants are giving the fresh and peaceful vibe. The only problem is, I find it hard to locate the address on google map as there is no sign board along the highway.

What a coffee gem in Davao. The cafe is surrounded by a lush garden--trees and plants blooming. The wooden interiors give off a calming vibe. Bold coffee and just the right creaminess. Carrot cake was scrumptious, sarap ng cream cheese! The lady who served me was very very kind and accommodating, assisting me with water and where the comfort room is. Worked here for 3 hours. No wifi but great data signal. Quiet and peaceful pa!

This is my second visit after a long time. I ordered a non-coffee double chocolate drink and chocolate chip cookies. For those who want to bring their work here, they don't have wifi so it's better to have your own consumable data.

Savoring life's simple pleasures, like a perfect cup of coffee of Glasshouse. The place is quiet but nice. It's just best for small group of people since the place is not too big. The shop can remove the unused space instead for others can occupy.

Cozy environment, Small furnitures and Low Ceiling clearance. Don't expect to give you WiFi password, when it's clearly have WiFi available.

One of the best carrot cakes we've ever tasted and best paired with hot choco. A hidden gem of great value finds. You're only limited to a couple of seats though and it's best if you don't bring your vehicle unless you want to park your car in the resto. Would definitely come back.
The ambiance was really great even though the place was small. The coffee and the snacks are of superb quality. I've been wanting to go back just to taste their concoctions again.

This Coffeeshop is very small inside a glass cube... Yeah this is a positive... Once u enter u can get 105% Coffee Aroma pumping! That itself would say the quality of coffee bean they use... Excellent coffee, this place is a million times better than mainstream coffee shops. First time that I did not need sugar with my coffee. Artisanship at it's finest. And hospitable staff, too. Will recommend to my friends.

Serving is quite small but is perfectly warm and delicious. P.S. do try their hot choco and matcha green tea ❤
A nice place to work or study. Nice ambience. Serves good coffee and their cookies were good. May saksakan if you need to plug-in some devices.

Good One Cafe and Yogurt is hard to miss with its all-pink facade. The interior is spacious, making it a nice spot to hang out. However, parking is quite limited, especially since the cafe shares the space with a gym under the same owner. It can get tight during peak hours. The cafe clearly attracts a social media crowd. During our visit, a number of content creators were filming, and the occasional camera flashes were a bit distracting. Understandable given the cafe's aesthetic, but worth noting if you're looking for a quiet hangout. The yogurt is self-serve at P0.95 per gram, with a good range of toppings. They also offer a variety of matcha drinks. Mine was decent for the price, and I liked that you can customize the sweetness level. However, it did take a while for our drinks to be served, which slightly affected the experience. Bonus points for issuing a sales invoice; something not all cafes consistently do.
It was a cozy yet aesthetic cafe and my first matcha experience did not disappoint. It had a weird taste at first but I managed to almost finish it. Hopefully they have strong wifi inside next time

For these service, signal is bad for cashless transactions. And they have different cashiers for cafe and yogurt. I ordered yogurt and coffee but had to go outside, place my coffee order which I already paid in the yogurt section, then waited inside, go out again to pick up my order. It would have been better if it were more streamlined.
Coffee was good. Got there in the afternoon and we're the only customer there. It's a bit far from the main road, but you can ride and tricycle.

I've always been guessing what kind of establishment this was right beside a gym. The tinted glass didn't help one bit. Parking lot's a bummer. The set-up was the same with Frogurt…Choose, fill, then weigh…. The place was neatly splashed in pink. The vast toppings selection was something you can mutter "oh" or "hmmm" under your breath. My yogurt was covered in butterscotch cubes, dried strawberries, choco chips, ube syrup, with 2 Kitkat wafer sticks to seal the deal…..Matcha and coffee drink images looked encouraging. Till next time…

Green Coffee is honestly one of my favorite spots to hang out or get some work done. The place is cozy and relaxing, and the location along Diversion Road makes it feel like a nice escape from the busy city. I especially love the alfresco area—the greenery and outdoor setting make it such a pleasant place to sit, whether you're working remotely or catching up with friends. The coffee is consistently good, and the pastries are absolutely divine. It's the kind of place where you can easily spend hours enjoying the atmosphere, a good cup of coffee, and great food. The only downside during my visits has been the service. The staff didn't come across as very friendly or welcoming, which is a bit disappointing considering how wonderful the place itself is. A warmer and more attentive approach from the team would really elevate the whole experience. Overall, still a great café for the ambiance, coffee, and pastries—I just hope the customer service improves to match how amazing the place is. ☕🌿

The place is spacious, clean, with wifi available & polite staff! Parking is not a problem. The building is almost surrounded with parking spaces. No issues with insects or lizards unless you occupy a table outside the building, as what I heard from the others.🙄 It is just normal for open spaces, to encounter things like that. 🤔😃 There are plenty of tables outside the building. So, just stay inside the building if you are afraid of lizards or insects. I think it is seldom. I enjoy my coffee and time in this place while waiting for my XYL.😃😄

I went to Green Coffee Diversion Road at 3:22 AM, well before their advertised closing time of 4:00 AM. As soon as we arrived, the staff suddenly turned off the lights to make us leave and told us they were already closed. This was very disappointing because they clearly advertise that they are open until 4 AM. The staff seemed to already be cleaning the place and looked unwilling to make the drinks we ordered, almost like they just didn't want to serve customers anymore. The staff was rude and unaccommodating, and there was no effort to honor their posted business hours. If you advertise that you close at 4 AM, customers should still be able to order at 3:22 AM. Very poor customer service and a frustrating experience. I hope management addresses this because it reflects badly on the establishment.

Loved how the place was so spacious and bright, great for meetings and gatherings. Unfortunately, coffee was too sweet and food choices were limited to pastries. Hope they would expand their menu to cater to more varied customers.
Very clean and spacious! But there is times I can't study properly due to being distracted to noisy people but that's aight since it's public and literally for everyone. Drinks is good :3

I just wish they have more breads and soon add pasta plates to their menu. (Menu hasn't changed for as long as I can remember.)

The staffs are ok, couldnt have been better if they can greet you more warmer 😊 All in all, a nice coffee to conduct business, meeting friends and substitute for overcrowd coffee places. Green Coffee is one of the largest coffee shops I have experienced in Davao City. The way it is designed makes it feel cozy and the noise level is good for a meeting or intimate conversation. The coffee is very full flavored and the warm chocolate drink was equally delicious. The cakes and dessert were wonderful my friends told me. Definitely a coffee shop to experience here. Free Wifi was very strong. There were 6 people in our group. We will come back again for sure.😁 God Bless!!✝️❤️🙏

The staff was cleaning beside me nonstop — every few seconds — and even kept moving the chair near me just to make noise. It honestly felt intentional. I go to Starbucks often and never experienced this kind of rudeness. I've been to three different Green Coffee branches, and they all seem to have the same unwelcoming vibe. This was the third time, and it'll be my last. I'm the kind of customer who orders a lot whenever I stay long in a café — I even do that in other coffee shops, not just Starbucks — and I don't even use their Wi-Fi. On October 28, my family and I decided to visit the Green Coffee Ecoland branch at around 9:30 pm. My wife, our three kids, and I were looking forward to enjoying a relaxing evening with some coffee. Unfortunately, the experience turned out to be far from what we expected, largely due to a disturbing cleaning practice by the staff. At around 11:30 pm, the staff began cleaning the shop using what seemed to be a high concentration of Zonrox. Almost immediately, we were hit with a powerful, harsh odor that left us feeling uncomfortable and short of breath. I felt like I was almost suffocating from the fumes, and the smell lingered well after we left the coffee shop. Even two hours later, both my wife and I were still experiencing the effects of the fumes, which included lightheadedness and respiratory irritation. It's alarming that such a strong cleaning product was used indoors while customers were still present. Zonrox, which contains bleach, can be highly irritating if inhaled and potentially harmful, especially in enclosed spaces without adequate ventilation. The fumes can cause symptoms like coughing, sore throat, and even headaches or nausea if exposure is prolonged. For children, this could be particularly risky. Additionally, the floors became slippery from the cleaning, making it quite unsafe. At one point, I nearly slipped on the wet floor—a dangerous situation that could have resulted in injury. It was disappointing to have to leave before closing time because the smell and unsafe conditions were too overwhelming to stay any longer. To the management at Green Coffee Ecoland, I would strongly recommend reassessing the timing and methods of cleaning practices. Using such harsh chemicals while customers are present is not only uncomfortable but poses potential health risks. I hope this feedback helps improve future experiences for other patrons and that appropriate adjustments are made to ensure safety and comfort in the shop.

Located right at Davao's famous market - Bankerohan, this Coffee Store sells coffee beans starting at 50 grams and can be gound down to its powdered version. With 7 bean varities, you can surely find your next favorite here. The seven beans include Robusta, Arabica, Barako, Hazelnut, Mt. Apo, House Blend and the Bankerohan Blend. While waiting for our beans to be packed, we tried the already brewed house blend which is priced at P20 per cup and it was delicious. Package increments: 50g, 100g, 250g, 500g and 1 kilo Price per bean variety: Robusta: 35, 65, 140, 255 and 490 Barako: 40, 65, 135, 245 and 450 Hazelnut: 40, 70, 140, 260 and 480 House Blend: 45, 70, 145, 265 and 495 Bankerohan Blend: 60, 100, 205, 375 and 700 Arabica: 65, 100, 215, 395 and 735 Mt. Apo: 75, 140, 315, 585 and 1,090. The store is open daily and is slowly becoming famous in Tiktok with recommendations to pair it with the neighboring bulalo and palabok stores.

They offer affordable and high-quality coffee beans, and you can even request to have them ground for a small fee. I also appreciate that they sell in small quantities, which is perfect if you just want to try different beans. I recommend messaging their Facebook page first to check which varieties are available before visiting.

I AM FURIOUS. I called ahead and was told they close at 4 PM. So I rushed, booked a ride, traveled 20 minutes, and arrived there ten minutes before 4 PM, only to be told they stop serving at 3:30. Customer service is absolutely unacceptable. I went there in the morning. I stood there looking at what beans to try next (this is my second time). There were people in front of me. So I just waited. There piles of coffee already packed so I thought the people in front of me nearly had their order ready. So I asked if I can order. It turns out that the beans they were preparing was not for the people in front of me. It was for another order. The people in front of me still didn't have their order prepared. They saw me standing there. They could have at least had the courtesy that they had a lot of orders prior to me. So I told them I would just come back a little later. I got food and did a little shopping from the market. Then I came back about a little more than an hour later. I then asked if I could buy beans. But they were eating. They told me to come back in 30 mins. Ok, I understand that they were on break but they could have at least served me as I was only going to get one bag of grounded beans. It doesn't take 5 minutes to get up, get beans, get a plastic bag and prep the grinding machine. They can just let it run. I really want to try their other beans. But this really put me off going back. All it would have taken is engaging with costumers and informing them of the situation. Saying hello wouldn't hurt either. Not just letting them stand there. If this happened to tourists, this is not a good look. Will not recommend to my family and friends anymore.

The space is all concrete which isn't good for acoustics so it can seem loud from chatter and hard to hear the music from the Marshall Bluetooth. Overall we had a good experience here. CR was clean and no WiFi.

Got lucky on a Sunday morning after an airport drop. Was in the door greeted by enthusiastic male staff. Another branch with not much parking space. The BEST SEASALT CREAM LATTE I have tasted is from this cafe. True enough you get to enjoy this drink sipping straight from a glass. (So, ditch the straw). Truffle Alfredo was rich and creamy while the Chicken Poppers was temptingly tender as well. Food was out rather quickly. Rates matched serving sizes.

Their food was good, nothing special about them though. We ordered the beef stroganoff with mashed potatoes and lasagna and the lasagna was a little bit too sweet for my liking. I was also not a fan of their mashed potatoes, it lacked seasoning and it still had chunks of potatoes. I prefer mine mashed smoothly and creamy but if you prefer it with chunks then you'll probably like it. The beef was really tender though. Their regular matcha latte was not available, they only had uji matcha latte which was a bit pricier than the regular but it was really creamy.

The place may be small, but it definitely has a unique sense of style. I was pleasantly surprised to find that the quirky-looking chair was actually very comfortable! As for the food and drinks, I ordered the iced Spanish latte, fries, and a sandwich — everything was superb! The staff were all friendly and welcoming, which added to the cozy vibe of the cafe. One thing I really appreciated was how conscious they are about maintaining a pleasant atmosphere. They've taken measures to ensure that the space doesn't reek of frying oil while cooking, which shows how thoughtful they are about the overall customer experience. Highly recommend this cafe!

So satisfied with my coffee and cookie cravings 🫶🏻🫶🏻 ordered their Chocolate chunk cookies (not so sure with the name) and Iced Spanish Latte 💯💯💯💯 worth every penny. First time in Habitat and as a coffee lover, I will add Habitat on my best coffee shop list 🫶🏻 (4 lang sa service, bc I waited for almost 30 mins just for the ☕️ 🍪) worth it naman
the place is bigger compared to their first branch. food was good and serving only took 15 minutes. i just hope they offer bigger servings that match their prices, especially for the drinks.

Came from a very disappointing breakfast and we wanted to re-do the start of the day with great coffee. We had our 2nd breakfast here and they did not disappoint. Superb food and coffee! Loved the hot mocha, wish they also had dark mocha. Overall highly recommended.
had it with my friends, AND THE FOOD IS BOMBBBBB AND OMG THE HIRONO DISPLAY IS THE BEST THING EVER. NOT TO MENTION THE GOOD PLAYLIST. the owner of the cafe is a real one for playing frank ocean
Loved the food, the place had a really cozy ambiance that everyone will definitely enjoy, and they also have really good coffee 👍🏻✨
Their coffee is great, strong and bold. I particularly like their sea salt latte. And their kimchi rice is to die for.
Got takeout from Habitat Coffee. Service and coffee was good

Review: I've noticed a consistent issue with overpaying for items I didn't order or unexpected extra charges. For example, I often see discrepancies where I'm supposed to pay a certain amount but end up paying 100 pesos more than that. Recently, I placed an order on the Grab app worth 1,300 pesos. After my payment went through, they cancelled the order for no reason. It's been almost two weeks now, and I still haven't received a refund. This is unacceptable and highly inconvenient.

Habitat is my once or twice a week "pit stop" to break my routine. I go for their Tocino rice meal or their Roast Pork with grilled veggies and always paired with their Spanish Latte. Then i will drown in my thoughts for an hour or two. Or until i have to move my vehicle because the one parked behind me wants to get out so its to go 😅

I love love this place! I went to their Tionko branch a while back, and I fell in love with the serene and intimate atmosphere of it. Now, I finally got to visit this branch, and the brighter and welcoming atmosphere was much more evident! I tried their Spanish Latte and Beef Bolognese, and it was sooo good! They did not PLAAY with their serving! I also had some cake for dessert, and it was the perfect sweet ending. Can't wait to come back and try more stuff!

Oh my gyattt!!!! food good, interior good, music sooooo good (like actually good music eg. Jeff bernat, Luke chiang, etc…), coffee good, everything GOOOD. Pero the workers are too nice sometimes. Cause when I to there last time, some kids were playing with the Smiski displays and the workers just let it happen (which I know isn't that serious in general) but like it lowkey pissed me off and the mom was just letting it happen. I'm not saying like they should scold them, more like the workers should be tuff sometimes Yk? Anyways so yeah, I love habitat.
student friendly, accommodating staff..! everything here is yumyum
comfort cafe 🥹 ty for the good service and drinks
we had a terrible experience at this location last day, staff0/10
Great option for breakfast/brunch sesh
Nice bright interior. Good na open at 7am. good time for coffee before working :)
Ambience is good and chill, Place was cozy, food and drinks are great! good place to chill
One of the best coffeeshops in town! Food is absolutely delicious! 😋
Their peach blush soda was ok. Nothing to write home about.
Solves my morning caffeine fix as this branch opens early!!
mouthwatering coffee
This is becoming one of my favorites. I love their spanish latte and pastries. And oh, try their kimchi rice with beef. To die for!

Honestly good coffee, very honest and straight forward with the menu. I guess the vibe of bauhaus is just over saturated for me but overall good place for a solo coffee date. Will definitely come back
went for a quick stopover before heading home. the place was quaint and has low lights. beverages were good and priced okay.

₱179 pesos for a really small iced seasalt latte. I can't justify the taste and size for the price. I expected more because of the reviews. I guess this is just another aesthetic coffee shop in Davao na di lami.
Good coffee but no wifi 🥺
Sorry but the place is a bit dark or maybe that's really their theme in the store hehe
I LOVE THE AMBIANCE AND THE COFFEES R SO YUM YUM W THE BROWNIES! 💓💓 also the owner is beautiful 🫢 of course also the social media manager 😍

It's our first time here but you are very rude to the baristas. Unprofessional. They still close at 10pm and we were rushed at 9:25. I asked a barista for a manager. lol Looya has friendly staff. Tsk the interior and vibe is very nice. Thank you

Food is Good.. A bit pricey but it's justifiable.. Must try their rice toppings.. Delicious.. You can also have coffee after to enjoy the stay for a while because the place is cute like a canteen or kitchen setup of an office in a towering building. 🏢🙏
The place has a similar vibe with a diner and it is cool in the area. There are available sockets for charging. Coffee is great..they have a good selection of meals. Parking is also convenient.

Had a really great experience at this cafe. The food was surprisingly good for its reasonable price. I highly recommend meatballs spaghetti. Serving portion was generous and the taste was superb. Their drinks were also worth trying, especially hojicha matcha and spanish latte. Ambiance is perfect for studying or getting work done since the place is spacious and doesn't feel crowded. Staff are welcoming, greeted me with smiles the moment I came in. Overall, I highly recommend if you're looking for cozy cafe with good food, drinks, and atmosphere. The only downside is that the location might be a bit hard to find for first-time visitors, but it's definitely worth it once you do. 100/10

Good coffee and pastry selection. Cozy ambiance with friendly staff. Serving time was relatively fast, too. Some meals can still be improved, but be warned of their Huuuuge servings. Lol For what seemed like a neighborhood cafe they have all sorts of cashless payments here. :)

Everything is perfect. No complaints at all. The food tastes as great as it looks. The plating is pleasing to the eyes. The flavours of the dish is well balanced. Nothing overpowering. We had the cajun shrimp and meatball spag pasta for our main meal. Pasta is al dente and the serving size is generous for the price. Me and my partner really enjoyed their pasta, we even ordered more for takeout! We also had dragon fruit cheesecake for dessert. The cheesecake is really good. You can tell they use quality ingredients, the same goes for their drinks. They are very knowledgeable of their drinks and food, clearly displaying culinary skills. I highly recommend. The place is far but it is honestly worth it. Would definitely go back here! It is truly a happy valley.
definitely made us 'happy'! got the matcha and ube lattes ( not too sweet, tita-approved!) chicken & waffles was big, juicy, crisp. quiet spot, lots of room. staff were kind. cute cup labels!

Behind one of the main highways and under an apartelle, this cafe has enough parking at the front. It gets crowded in the afternoons so the first visit was a takeout of the Migrant's and Strawberry Matcha which were both tasteful. When I dined in the following week, it was a peachy midday with the Cajun Shrimp pasta and Ube Latte. Only setback would have to be the sun getting through the glass.

I don't have any photos of the food, but it was great especially the Fat Boy Burger is the best! The coffee was great also. The only downside is their opening hours; you have to check their page regularly to stay updated.
Lots of pour over choices. Good place to hang out. Clean and quiet. Big serving of chicken and waffles.
We tried their smores latte, gochujang sandwich, and strawberry matcha - all we're good. Definitely going back
The barista/staff were very welcoming. Their food servings are huge, "sulit" for the price, and tasted good!

Foods are average to above average. Kinda self service, you get your ordered food & beverages from the counter after paying. Sometimes staff will deliver the food to your table. Not a big deal for me but can be for other people with disabilities, elderly, or pregnant women. The ambience is excellent, quiet, and cozy. Great place to study or work. They have sockets near tables (better to bring an extension wire). So far, when we get to dine here, only 2 to 3 tables are occupied by customers. Highly recommend this place for study and/or work.

Although this coffee shop is out of my way, the barista made me feel right at home! If you're interested in having a unique learning experience with coffee, you have to try the migrant coffee or the dirty coffee—my personal favorite in all of Davao! I highly recommend visiting this place!
Had my dose of Iced Spanish Latte at Happy Valley Cafe. Imma be back for more!

Stopped for a coffee with a friend and we were impressed at the added brewed coffee bar and new foods menu! The baked goods were freshly made and the staff always friendly and the coffee was delicious as always!

I actually like their food, lami ang matcha kay mafeel nako ang matcha. Pasta's also good, al dente sya and tama ra iyang pagka al dente for me, di parehas sakong natry dati na it was too stiff haha Would come back here again because their cakes look too good. For a fairly new café, their food is really good so I'm looking forward on how they will be in the future.
Their matcha is also pretty great! I havent yet to try their food but Ive been wanting to. Heard the gojuchang chicken is good
Nice ambience. Good food
Ambiance is what I love. It's good for some chit chat with a friend.
Hoping they serve rice meals soon.
Very cozy and the focus is not just on aesthetics, the food and drinks are also legit delicious 💯
The food & coffee are super delicious! Even the owner is awesome!!

Looking for the perfect halal restaurant for your special occasion? ✨ Experience delicious halal dishes, a beautiful ambiance, and a cozy atmosphere that makes every celebration extra memorable. Sulit na sulit — from the food to the service and overall dining experience! Perfect for family gatherings, and special moments with loved ones. 💛🍽️

We have visited Haron's Café twice already. The food was good and the ambiance was great, which makes it a nice place to spend time. However, both times we noticed the same issue. The staff were talking loudly and it was very distracting. It would be better if they were more professional and kept their voices down so guests can fully enjoy the relaxing atmosphere.

i don't know i just love the food serving size is good too! you cant say that its just a cafe since they have lots on their menu and its great cause of their hours, and i just love going back to this place.

Having read good reviews from at least a year back to as far as three (3) years ago, well I EXPECTED the same but….First, it took minutes for the one lone busy staff behind the counter to approach my table to get my order. Second, the serving size of the Greek Chicken Salad was way too short of my expectations. Ingredients and taste did not match the price of P310 (it did come with a plate of pita wrap triangles). Additional dressing came later as well….Third, the Cold Spanish Latte was okay for me because it was unsweetened. Fourth, I stood up to ask for utensils. Fifth, a fly was hovering above while I was eating…. Sixth, my debit card payment with their Maya POS terminal machine after three (3) attempts did not go through and so I resorted to GCash instead. That time between 11 a.m. to 12:29 p.m., we were only four dining customers. Take-away food was not that appetizing😞.

Nice little cafe/restaurant with extensive menu. I have a mutton shank rice bowl (comes with a free iced tea), an Americano and a Halo Halo soecial(pinoy version ice kacang with ice-cream) for a total of 618peso. The mutton shank is a must try. Free wifi, and there are power points for you electronic device. Highly recommended.
New here in Davao City, it was a nice experience dining in this cafe. Wide variety of food selection even for me as a diabetic person. The place itself was nice and quiet. Thr price were also fair.

The best food I've had in Davao City during my visit. The ambiance is relaxing. The food is delicious and decent portion size. Price is better compared to overrated restaurants in Davao. Staff was great and friendly. Came back with family to eat again and will be eating here again before I leave. This place is underrated and a gem. A must to eat here.

This restaurant is located right by the main mamay Road. The inside decor is relaxing; their pastries are to die for.and the food is simple and splendid. The ambiance is so welcoming. You dine while you have nice music playing in the background. The bathroom is clean. You can wash your hand. In this Japanese style island, one word of caution they only accept Gcash or cash. Overall, this is a nice restaurant. I like it.

We needed a place to meet with my classmates, it was a last minute decision and it's a good thing there's a Cafe open for 24 hours ❤️ The place and ambiance is great especially the food! I didn't expect the portion of what I ordered since I'm a light eater, but overall it tastes good! Will definitely visit the place again ❤️

Light background music, lighting and store fixtures compliment to the cosiness of the place. Parking is ample. They have real friendly staff, a nice spot to have a loooong chat over coffee, you may not need to worry because they're open 24/7. They have a variety choices of Halal food and beverages and serve lots of options of cakes, coffee, milk tea, pasta, breakfast meals, even Pinoy dishes and kakanin. Dining tables abound- above and ground levels. They also have two 2-seater tables just outside the store, should you wish an al-fresco dining style. Food was served in a timely manner and its presentation was nice. Just a heads-up: chairs in each table are not well-setup for social distancing. I think they have the usual seating capacity and this was taken in April 2021. But if it does not bother you, then that is okay (as it didn't to us either). Overall, it was a really nice experience.😊

I love the overall design. I suggest to put up a blind near the air-conditioning where the light shines in. Masilaw man gud hehe. Everything was good. I specifically love the breakfast, the chicken tocino! Would recommend! 😍

I can't recommend this place kase nag papabayad na sila if mag chacharge ka ng phone or laptop even if your order is reasonable. Aside from that, they are quite pricey and it's understandable because they are delicious, but is it worth paying if you just charge?
It was a great restaurant! The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great as well. I highly recommend this place for eating, chill, party and drinking coffee!
I love this place, the vibes is out of the country, royalty vibes. Also, the stuff is very friendly. The food is quite great but the price is expensive.
It's Haram so they don't serve pork. What?! No pork???!!! Correct. But no matter because food was good regardless. And they still had bacon!!! Beef bacon so it made up for the no pork.
Take out is not convenient. My Durian Chocolate Drinks spilled inside the plastic though it still tasted good. They are open till 3:00 am though.

Haron's Cafe saved the day with its 24-hour operation – a haven for remote workers like me. During a walk, we spontaneously dropped in for coffee and bread. The ambiance was top-notch, creating a perfect setting for a quick bite.
Went here because this is one of the few coffee shops/store in Damosa na open ghapon past 9pm on a weekday. They have indoor and outdoor dining available.
First time eating here, good atmosphere, well staffed and very good food. I especially enjoyed the beef quesadilla.
Ask for medium rare and this is what I've got. It has funny taste and somewhat itchy on the tongue. Cheesy spaghetti hmmm k. Love the strawberry drink tho
Halal friendly restaurant. Great atmosphere. Food is served at good portions. Hasn't disappointed me so far, and will continue to come back in the future.

I ordered a Strawberry Smoothie (Large) and found a piece of plastic inside one of the cups. I was really disappointed because the drink tastes good — that's why I ordered again. Please check the packaging or preparation process carefully next time. I hope this doesn't happen again.
Great food selection at affordable prices. You can check their online menu ahead of time before ordering.

Went to dine in this place after flying from Manila and arrived around 1am in this place which is surprusingly open for business and is located along one of the main roads which are typical establishment location in Davao City. Tried beef tapa and also beef steaks meals which are delicious. Staff are very friendly. Highly recommended.
Love their bangus steak, nice place to hang out with friends and having conversation over coffee with good music. Definitely come again!
Breakfast meal❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Hot Dark Chocolate drink❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Meals are delicious, portion size is great and worth the price👌 They are open 24/7. …

We came in for coffee at 6am. Coffee was great. Pastry we ordered taste good. Ambiance is super nice.

The atmosphere was the best. The service needs improvement, only one busy staff, despite seeing few doing not so important tasks. The food however, despite the good taste, I was a little bit disappointed by so many non-availability of its breakfast menu. I went there for breakfast because they have a great menu but ended up eating food for lunch and dinner because almost all breakfast menus are not available.

We went here for breakfast and we had a great time. Really satisfied with their service and food. The atmosphere was nice and kudos to the kuya waiter who is really kind accommodating. They are open for 24 hrs and all the food we had tasted good with big servings.. 💕❤ love everything in this cafe. Will surely come back. ❤
Sarap! Sulit! Nice place and there's a lot of choices in the menu.
You need to go there to open the menu 🤣 But swear, their Shrimp and Chicken Dishes are faves and must try . grrrrrrrr …

Highly recommended. Best customer service experience. Food service is fast and on the dot. Clean restrooms. Separate restrooms for male and the other for female. With washing area near counter. All staffs are friendly and accommodating. They are all well-trained.

The place has a great ambiance. Kind of rustic, boho, and earthy style. The cafe has lots of tables available for guests. They have rooms for meetings or small gatherings. They also have table on the second floor for a more intimate date. They have a wide variety of foods to choose from breakfast, lunch, dinner or after dinner snack or drinks. We just had drinks since we already had dinner when we got there. I had wintermelon milk tea and my husband had durian frappe. Both were delicious. I highly recommend this place. And would probably go back here!

Place has nice ambience to it. Food is also great but they only serve halal dishes so pork lovers might find it a bit lacking. But not to worry as their chicken, seafood and beef dishes are worth it. Give it a try and you wont regret it.
It's a halal restaurant offering delicious food choices. Highly recommended for others. A business meeting room is available.

They have a lot of choices on food and beverages. They offer eat all you can on weekends and has acoustic band which is great if you dont want too much noise. They have function rooms that can be used for meetings. I personally like their beef selection and of course the coffee and pastries.

poor service, late orders, we ordered hot coffee and we got not so hot almost cold, serve more than 30 minutes. no time management. simple request of client was not granted like asking sugar and tissue but we havent get one until we leave the shop
The fried chicken and Bisaya Chicken Soup thumbs up
The place and ambiance looks very nice . We only had a good cappuccino and americano.

The service is horrible. Waited 20 minutes fot the waitress to take my order but she never came. After waiting, a group of about 7 people came in and their order was taken immediately . I left after paying an outrageous 115php for 1 coffee.
This place is open 24/7 and their prices are reasonable. They have good food. Not fine dining good but good enough.
Good cafe nice ambience but it's the second time I have smelt a foul smell inside that made our visit a short one. Something needs to be done.
They do have a wide selection. Spanish Latte I had was a bit sweet, however the breads are good
For me, 9pm - 10pm is the best place to dine and chill.. i love the teas and pizza..

I ordered two cakes from them over the phone, and everything went smoothly! The customer service was top-notch, friendly, responsive, and easy to work with. Highly recommended!
We ordered their Chicken Adobo sa Gata and Beef Picadillo, and both tasted sooo good! 💗 Overall, this is such a great place to eat especially if you crave homey dishes! 🍴
How I wish beef quesadilla is available 24 hours as well..the best beef quesadilla I've ever had so far. But I did not like the American breakfast, it tasted like a Filipino breakfast 😅

Went to this café around 12 midnight and ordered two takeout drinks. While I was paying, a rat climbed onto my arm. I was shocked and panicked, so I immediately said, "hala , ilaga!" The staff simply responded, "Hala, ilaga po." I think the situation could have been handled much better. A simple apology, offering alcohol or sanitizer to clean my hands, or showing a bit more concern would have made a big difference. None of that happened. I didn't make a scene because I didn't want to cause too much drama, but a little kindness and empathy go a long way.

My daughters bestfriend is the niece of the owner of this place and I'm a friend of both of my daughters bestfriends parents I have came here 2 times to eat, mainly because I live abroad I have came here with my wife's side of the family once once with just my wife and 3 of my wonderful daughters everytime I was there I was greeted by the owner and the food is amazing there my broth and sister in-law and there children are regulars there, sometimes their grandchildren go ther when there in town, all I have to say it's a great place to eat if you had a long day, to catch up with friends or just because it's nice

So this is my honest review..because I usually enjoy the Farmer's Breakfast here, but lately.... I've noticed the included orange fresh juice is often missing unless I ask about it, and I understand sometimes its not available.. but it would be better if they proactively offered an alternative juice right away like they did before. During my last visit yesterday, I was only offered watermelon juice even though I noticed oranges available at the counter, which was confusing. Also, the mocha hazelnut drink frappe I had yesterday was also overly sweet compared to before and tasted more like vanilla than mocha. The avocado served also didn't seem fresh as it had dark spots. I hope they improve consistency and quality of their food and communication with customers.
It's a halal restaurant. I ordered a burger which was average, and chicken with rice which was delicious. The problem is that they take a very long time with the order.
Coffee and cake on a rainy night with Gee7 Fam while waiting for our boss💕👏🏻
A good coffee shop, its main feature is that it's open 24/7 and offers an open buffet on Saturdays... It also has a private meeting room.
Their food is delicious, especially the chicken salted egg, and the serving is big. 🫶
The most beautiful coffee shop in Dafawa city... open 24 hours
Good, quiet cafe and restaurant + free internet
How salty is the chicken?

Tried Headspace mid week around 9 am and I was the only one there. The place looked clean, spacious and some contemporary progressive jazz was playing. I was greeted by the barista, looked over the drink menu and ordered the Iced Coconut Cream Latte. I hung out and drank my drink and although I enjoyed it, I typically prefer less sweet and a bit more bold. I didn't ask about WiFi and the CR was clean.
Great coffee and staff. Pastry is pretty good, tried their Strawberry Croissant and Headspace Spanish Oat. Did not disappoint.

Been loving their Komori Latté lately. It's near AdDU so you expect packs of college students studying there but I usually like going before duty in the afternoon or if I want to stay longer, around 10pm as it's usually more quiet in those hours. If you like hot drinks, you're in luck because their baristas are skillful in those—steaming is one of the best and I really like how beautiful the latté art turns out every time.
I only tried one flavor the Spanish Oat and it made me think to try other brews as well. Their place looks calm and strong - same as how they blend their coffee. Definitely worth coming back!
I love their matcha — it's not too sweet, just the way I like it. The space is quite big and definitely made for students who want to study. It's a great spot for some peaceful, focused time.

Close by 9pm. Open on Sundays. Near Ateneo Jacinto and Harley's Boulevard Cafe Really comfortable place to hangout with friends with and drink great tasting coffee. Just be there at a time where its less crowded by college students. Their by-season choice of coffee beans makes it fun and exciting as I got to taste their "Brazil Cerrado" beans used in my drink. If you want to try quality coffee, this is the one. Definitely a place to look out for.

Here is a coffee place when I wasn't looking for one….I did a complete 360 when I drove past this spot….The Great Spanish was sanely delicious…But the Coconut Espresso was something that needs more pondering. (I couldn't quite get the taste)….Was not enticed with the revel bars and ensaymadas on display…Till next stop, hopefully….

Their Spanish Oat Latte is a must-try - it's creamy, flavorful, and just the right amount of sweetness. I wish they had more variety on the menu, but the quiet atmosphere and friendly staff make it an ideal choice for a quick coffee break or casual catch-up.

dropped by this place to have a quick coffee. Decent place to grab hot or cold drinks. I guess they really don't have a lot of food items offered, as i only saw 3 pastries that time. Overall great experience.

Cozy and minimalist coffee shop located just near ateneo. As the other reviews mentioned, their Spanish oat latte is really good and I would say is a must try. The barista is friendly, you order through an iPad (which is a nice touch by the way)

I ordered their spanish oat latté. It was easily one of the best spanish lattés over oatmilk that I've tried in the city. Their prices are very affordable too compared to other coffee shops despite all their expensive-looking equipment. It wouldn't surprise me if they will increase their prices soon.

A bit noisy; the speakers are on full blast playing pop songs and the sound echoes around. The people who go here also like to talk a lot and at a volume that competes with the music. They also don't serve food here, just coffee.
After trying most coffee shops in Davao, this is by far the best coffee in Davao.
Great value for money. Good coffee. Fast turnover. No fuss. Basics done well.
love looking at the green walls and archways. had a coconut coffee drink for the davao coffee crawl it was interesting
Wonderful experience enjoying their coffee's there. Nice place too
Loved the atmosphere warm and just comfy✨
Best coffee I've had in davao during my visit
Not worth the hype

A great outdoor dining spot right in the city! The ambiance is relaxing, with a cool and welcoming vibe that's perfect for breakfast or a casual meal. The food was delicious, and while the breakfast prices are on the higher side, they're reasonable for the quality and overall experience. It's also pet-friendly, which is a huge plus. Parking is limited, with space for only about five cars inside, so it's best to arrive early. Overall, a fantastic place—10/10!

This is a nice outdoor café to chill at. I ordered the dirty and it was good. They also have a food truck—we tried the tapa (really good!) and the breakfast steak which was just okay, especially considering it was the most expensive item on the menu. The vibe is relaxed, and when we went around 9 AM, the temperature was cool and comfortable. Overall, a great spot to hang out and enjoy a slow morning.
My husband and I love this coffee place. Really good coffee and friendly barista. It's one of the very few places that opens early at 6am. The place is kept very clean. Way to go Hid'n Coffee.

Service was great, kind, friendly and welcoming, coffee was great the nutty latte had to order 2, food was also great, beef tapa how it should be, the bangus was delicious and the pancakes fluffy and crispy at the same time, that revel ube bar yummm! Definitely recommend

Dining here in the early morning is really worth a try. Their beverage is really tasty, and it's not pricey. Also, they are very accommodating, though they only have a few staff available. However, I don't recommend the place in the late mornings as it gets humid and hot in the area.
Such a delightful spot! I just had a great coffee here. The outside seating is incredibly comfortable. Love the excellent music selection too. Altogether a fantastic, relaxing vibe! Highly recommend.

An awesome find. Now I understand why people recommend this place. The vibe is great. The food is great. We were all stuffed after eating. The coffee is good. There are also small stalls that sell random stuff and trinkets. Definitely a must go if ever you're near the area. They're also conveniently located behind Abreeza.

Great spot for food and coffee! I loved that they have tuyo on the menu—one of my favorite breakfast dishes. The service was excellent, and one of the owners even gave us a slice of cake since it was his birthday yesterday. I'll definitely come back whenever I'm in Davao.

Definitely among the best coffee shops in Davao City, especially with its laid back open garden atmosphere and its excellent coffee concoctions. I would definitely recommend their Himalayan Salt Latte and Flat White, as well as their PH-origin beans for pour over. Over the weekend, they sometimes invite pop-ups as well. In my recent trip to Davao, I visited this coffee shop at least 6 times.

The first time I visited, I brought my grandma, mom and aunts and they all enjoyed it. Loved the garden feels, though others might find it hot or difficult to eat cause of the low table (though they provide a high tray naman)🪴 Great coffee from Hid'n ☕️ + great breakfast from Before Weekend. 🥞 What more can you ask for? Will be back for sure!
The dirty coffee was excellent! The location is also very quiet, making it a great place for anyone who wants to relax and unwind. Highly recommended.
Our fave go-to bfast spot on a gloomy Sunday morning. Their tapsilog is a must try. ++ pet friendly really a plus. Just the wait time usuall takes longer (up to 45mins to an hour) esp on weekends

Nestled quitely along the busy street of N. Torres is the @hidncoffeedvo 🍵 A trendy coffeeshop with its food truck concept, the place offers a cozy setting for meet ups and bonding time with loved ones. I ordered a calming Matcha Latte, safe to say it was really good. We dropped by around 7pm-ish on a Friday night, a bit disappointed that all their pasta, sandwich, and cookies were sold out...must be that good. 😋 📍Palm Village, Nicasio Torres St, Obrero, Davao City 🔆 Opens at 6am, closes at 9pm. ☕️ A regular Matcha Latte and Cappuccino costs P250 in total.

The place is great! Very refreshing mahangin and alot of greens to see. Plus the ice caramel is soo good. Recommended talaga! We ordered the filipino platter as well masarap din naman. I only gave 4 stars since medyo mainit na sya when wen there around 730 am. So we hope to have more protection sa sun hehe. But overall very nice place!!

alfresco dining thats open conveniently for breakfast. has 2 stall selections. the other has good and various coffee selection while the othef mostly has food and group breakfast ones. the coffee portion was quite small and the toast isnt really served hot, it was a bit cold to touch but both still tasted fine.

I like their coffee nook concept ♡ the iced caramel and peanut butter chocolate cookie from Ana Banana's bakery that I ordered were also delicious. Also, my suggestion to come here is at around 4:00 PM because it's pretty to take pictures and it's not too hot to hang out with your friends etc. ☺️

Durian latte, anyone? If you're in Davao, you've got to check out Hid'n Coffee! This mobile café is a hidden gem serving a surprisingly balanced Durian Latte. The durian perfectly complements the coffee without being too strong—just the right amount of boldness. Definitely a must-try for anyone looking for something new in their coffee experience. Follow my IG: @coffeewithjayr, for more cafe recommendations
Really good coffee! I had 2 cups in one seating. It's that good! Will definitely recommend this place, and will drop by again once I go back to Davao.

Cute place. First time to go on Easter Sunday! Traveled to Davao and Planned to just try the coffee but figured out they had an Easter event for the kids, so we came back with the kids! Coffee was good, Before Weekend food was gooood tooo! Excited to go back soon! 💜
One of Davao's go-to for coffee. While people go gaga about Spanish Latte, I'd recommend their Iced Americano 👌🏼 They also have non-coffee options: Pink Milk, Milo Dino, and House Iced Tea.

Visited this place x number of times and I love love how the mood changes throughout the day. I mean, thanks Mother Earth! Order your favorite coffee and matcha, you wont regret it! :) Free parking, good drinks, cashless payment option, clean CR

We were brought here as part of the hospitality tour by our friends from Holodeck Productions and we really enjoyed our drinks! I got one of their iced peanut butter lattes and the flavors were well balanced, the nutty flavor didn't overpower the taste of the coffee. They also serve funky stuff like Durian Affogato. The place was also very breezy and comfy.
It's hid'n, so for the love of your palate, please find this place! Ordered a set meal that's good for four but devoured by two - it's not the serving size, but the taste!
Simple dining experience with superb customer service. I do hope they continue with the quality of service they offer as they grow and expand. Food is delicious. The drinka are mouth-watering.

The coffee was good, we ordered the matcha latte and the spanish latte. Both coffee was to our liking. Ambiance had a cozy feels to it with a decent amount of tables and chairs. Place was instagrammable with warm lighting at night. The only problem was the parking and one way entrance and exit.

This cute little hidden gem was such an awesome find! They have signature espresso drinks along with your usual cafe findings. Service was prompt and kind. We got the durian latte (a must if you like durian) and the milo espresso drink. Would definitely come back!

NOT RECOMMENDED, FLIES ARE EVERYWHERE WE ASKED FOR ADDITIONAL CANDLE BUT THEY SAID THEY CAN ONLY PROVIDE 1 CANDLE PER TABLE TOLD THEM WE WILL BE OCCUPYING 2 TABLES BUT THEY JUST IGNORED US. ITS OUR 3RD TIME HERE BUT DILI NA MAKAYA ANG LANGAW.
If you're searching for a quality coffee and great vibes this place is a most visit.
Stopped by here after an errand and got the Dirty Matcha Tea and hung out and did some reading. Drink was great, had WiFi, friendly staff and cool outdoor atmosphere.
i love their focaccia. drinks and food are affordable and delicious. place is quiet and really private. staff are very friendly.
Staff are awesome. Coffee priced reasonably and taste good. Place is instagramable! ❤️❤️❤️⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It's like having coffee in your garden. It's an open space so if it's hot, I might not visit here. But they open early at 6am. And they sell breakfast and coffee, so it's actually a great place for breakfast. I visited in a cloudy afternoon. So I was very comfortable with my iced milo coffee and a chorizo wrap. I would want to try their salmon next time, and their rice meals.

Very nice place actually. We had trouble finding it but when we reached there the place is very nice. Good service. Good food. Good people. Could've stayed longer if I hadn't had any other appointment.
This not so hidn spot serves good coffee and there's also an all-day breakfast in the same location. 🫰🏼
If you're a coffee and chill vibe connoisseur, this is your place, these are your people. Outdoor food cart pod style, breakfast was good too. My go to spot in Davao.

Limited parking space. Limited coffee and pastry selection. The Iced Espressos are good though. I find the place too warm to hang out. Seeing their operating times have changed I might drop by again — to try the neighboring cart. The heat was just unbearable to stay longer.
Nice, quiet place for coffee and breakfast tucked in a literally "hid'n" area. The service and atmosphere was good, just wish there were more food and drinks available to choose from. 😊
Refreshing outdoor coffee experience. Poor parking space though.
Ordered iced tea, so refreshing!

love their coffee. I've tried their milo dinosaur, spanish latte, milo espresso and strawberry iced tea, and I love them all! the other food truck in their compound also offers breakfast items. perfect combination for brunch
My new favourite place to get espresso You should come See you there
Chill place... Good food... And there're some small shops as well that sell clothes or other stuff
Really perfect place hidden within the heart of northern part Davao poblacion. Amazing food matched with great coffee and very hospitable service.
this is outdoors under a shady tree. breakfast available, and no local coffees that i saw.
Cozy place. Relaxing. Excellent customer service. A good place to unwind.

This place gives you the experience of outdoor styles and experience out of the city it's just a walking distance at Abreeza Mall and Aeon Tower and Abreeza condos. This place resides at the very heart of the City Clean and peace Environment
No wonder it stays hidden... everybody thought we said Eden. Coffe is great. Place is nice and quiet. Not sure if its hidden or hidin' but you will definitely disappear.
Great coffee and cool and relaxing atmosphere. Salamat kaayo!
Best Coffe in Davao!!

Food and customer service is good the only lacking is the place...felt like abandoned park or something...needs more polishing here and there but overall nice escape spot for the bustling of the metro davao
Great out door cafe with lots of charm and good food
Most affordable plantbased mylk upgrade in the city. Lovely owners. Great place to hangout with friends.
Best place. Calm.chill.relax.great services and great crew. Great coffee. You can park your car
Good coffee place in the city center! 😍😍😍😍
Really like this place. Shadow to sit. Good food and drinks. And a parking spot.
One of the best in the Philippines. Excellent service, coffee and food.
Great vibe and great food
Cheap! I love their milocyrus hehe

parking here is too tight but the food here is worth it.
Everything is perfect here

2 restaurant share food and coffee. We had a great western breakfast. It was so much we could not eat it all, for nice price. sausage, bacon, eggs, pancake, mango. The coffee and passion fruit juice where also good, we will come back

Food and ambience was good. My only issue really was how understaffed it was. There was around 2-3 people at most. 1 tending to the coffee and 2 tending to the food. So they also clean the tables, manage parking, take, and prepare orders. Our family order came one at a time with an interval of 15-20 mins in between. Our coffee order was almost completely forgotten

Starting the day right with a cozy cafe vibe and the perfect breakfast. Highly recommend! Made better by great food and an even better cafe. This cafe knows how to do breakfast right. A warm cup, a tasty plate, and a cafe worth sharing about. Perfect breakfast spot! Breakfast that deserves a shout‑out. Loved the food, loved the place.
Great coffee.

The grounds are quiet and cool, with plenty of shade from the trees, making it a relaxing place. The durian coffee is on the sweeter side, but I think there are few places in Davao where you can drink it, so you should definitely try it. The fact that it opens at 6 AM is also a plus.

Hid'n coffee is a cafe I would recommend going to, Such a vibe!!! I love the iced matcha latté! for only P130 the price is really worth it, it's so delicious and you can really taste the true taste of matcha if there's a little bit of sweetness in the cream and you can still taste the matcha! This hidden gem café is a must visit in Davao. The price is so cheap and the location is just chill and easy to find. You'll definitely come back when you're here. Great service from the baristas! 🍵💚 It's so worth it to visit, the asthetic of the place is relaxing.
Comfortable seating area. The Spanish latte tastes average. The roasting could be better.
Lots of parking area. The americano and matcha are delicious.
The coffee is delicious, would you like to drink it here too?
Very cozy place. I like the venue concept. Variety food choices. Price is just right. Great service !!!

Update '25: boring. No music. Slow service. Slow kitchen. Taste reduced. There is only a shadow from the Hikaru from '23. We tried three time in a distance around 3 month. Always the same. Hikaru calls itself a "Cafe", but it is much more than this. Cafe, restaurant, Bar. Very good food from a rich menu, until now everything on stock (Do i miss "Sorry sir, it's not available"? No.). Different cold beer including imported and "my" Sm Light, Cocktails... good variety of cocktails! And they are mixed with passion and served well decorated! Also Live Music on Friday, Sat, Sunday. Sometimes outside, makes a nice bar feeling, sometimes inside, makes a Pub feeling. The new (and only?) Star on the Calinan Gastronomic night star! We only had one real good restaurant close to Calinan, 2, maybe 3 places more you can call a "restaurant" if you already experienced in good dining culture. Very nice decoration, very attentive Staff, Aircon is not too cold. We will become regular customers there. Five Stars would be the right for downtown Davao. For Calinan it should be 6*. Keep up the good work! PS: very cool: You have a Car wash beside! So while your car is cleaned, you can eat and drink while you are waiting. Most of the food and the beer is affordable (but not cheap...), cocktails & Steaks are more expensive. Quality needs price. You get a great return for your money!
You have to try their cheesy Bolognese and salted caramel latte. They're amazing!

Poor service. We waited almost an hour for a whole pizza, and it wasn't worth the wait. When we went there, many menu options were not available. I ordered the carbonara with garlic bread on the side. The picture showed a red sauce, but when it arrived, it had a white sauce and no garlic bread. I wouldn't recommend this place if you're a busy person or have high expectations.
New restaurant in Calinan with a cozy atmosphere, good food, with a bar and from Friday-Sunday evenings with a live band
Nice place to Dine in, Delicious foods with Good Ambience.
Very nice and good place with aircon 🩷

It was recently open. They have a decent affordable nice food. We enjoy the place and unique design of the restaurant. Great staff, great service, friendly chef and the owner too. I would love to come back And have some more yummy lecious food there.
. service crews were nice. The Atmosphere of the place is giving this cozy vibes. The theme is Something new to my eyes. Food is delicious.

The buffet is not buffet-ing (the spag is not good and there is a lot of flys going on the food 😭) sayang inyong 299 would not recommend eating in their buffet hopefully it would improve to make ur price worth 💗

The coffee is bad, not sure why there is a cafe in the name that serves bland coffee. Really disappointed because I was searching for a good coffee spot. >>>> I haven't tried the food the review is only for brewed coffee.
We really like the coffee. Spicy nachos were great. Will definitely come back to try other menu items.
