I experienced bad service from them. I went around 3:30PM to order take out food. When my niece and I arrived, there were no other customers, just us, and no service crew. We understood that maybe it wasn't "peak" time yet so there were no crews to be seen watching or waiting. When our order was taken, it took a long time to be served to think that we were the only customers during that time. It took about 1hr. before our order (pizza and carbonara) was served. If I hadn't followed up, they wouldn't have served it. I can't say they were busy because there were no Grab drivers coming and going to take online orders, and the crews were just playing around. :( :-/
It takes too long to serve the food and the crew has low rapport with the customers. Food is so-so. Price is expensive.

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: If you love coffee and reading books, this is the perfect spot for you. Glad they finally have a branch in Davao. The place is so coozy. A lot book to choose from that you can barrow while staying in the cafe. Their desserts are perfect pairs in their coffee.

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: Waiting for the café to open when staff came in just minutes before 9…Chairs were on top of tables as I ordered. Still three months in operation. Cute interior with lots of books on wall shelves. Staff made a mistake with my drink, was apologetic. I let it slide. Menu has slim pickings with moderate rates. Hope they add more.

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: I recently visited this coffee shop and had a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with comfortable seating and soft background music that made it a great place to relax or get some work done. The space was clean and well-organized, creating a cozy yet modern vibe. The staff were friendly and welcoming, taking the time to recommend drinks and ensuring orders were prepared quickly. I ordered a matcha and a pastry, and both were fresh and delicious. The coffee was rich and smooth, with a perfect balance of flavor and foam. Prices were reasonable for the quality offered, and the overall service exceeded my expectations. I would definitely return and recommend this spot to anyone looking for a comfortable place to enjoy great coffee.

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: The place is neat and cozy, it's situated along a busy road but inside it's comfortable and quiet. Good for socializing and studying. Their drinks and food taste good. Seasalt vanilla cream latte's my favorite drink. I also tried the newest addition to their menu which is the tuna sandwich and it's affordable and very filling. Definitely worth the visit!

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: I ordered Iced, Sea Salt Vanilla Cream Latte Butterscotch and it's so worth the price!🥰 The staffs are very kind and welcoming, & nice ambiance 👌🏻

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: I love this place! Coffee tastes premium. Place is very clean. Staff are very accommodating, kind, and polite. 😍 Definitely, one of the best places to unwind.

Worse coffee stand I've encounter. I tried to order multiple times but everytime there's always a delay or a mistake. Once ordered a Spanish Latte and they gave me a Matcha Latte (I don't even drink Matcha) and when I told then that wasn't what I ordered they just told me 'Mao ang na punch ma'am.' Like it was my mistake? Rude barista (the girl) and they look like they don't know how to make the beverages since they always look up for measurements. Wait time could exceed 30 mins EVEN IF NO ONE IS AROUND.

Food: Cafe latte was a very diluted, sweet coffee-flavored milk. Service: Server seemed uninterested to serve and mumbles answers. Atmosphere: Trash bin is too near the stall. Lots of flies where the drink is mixed.
So I ordered a matcha drink but was given Spanish matcha. Hey, there's not a single word, it's a waste of 120.
I don't like Milktea Generally but this made me think about it (I love it)
Kind and polite, thanks guys. I also tried the salted caramel. Recommended for chill time especially near the smoking area.

Chicken Quezo is what I ordered and it was delish. Kinda small in portion though. As for the coffee, I had cafe latte and I love it. Worth it for it's price. The service was a amazing, it took less than 5 minutes for my order to be completed. The cafe looks good too but kinda small so space is limited. If you're a reader, they have books on the cafe as well. The one I took a picture with is not included, that's the book I bought with me.

In Germany we would call it an "Imbiss", and some of the food reminds me on this... but only by the picture. Lychee Lemonade: Sweet, but ok to drink. Caramel Macchiato: Good, easy to drink, not bitter. Good Coffee! Crispy Chicken: This is chicken Skin, but you can't read it anywhere. We took it complete out for our Dog. It would be OK if they call it "Chicken Skin", but serving Skin only as "Crispy Chicken" is... very philippino. BTW: For Takeout in a food container they charge 15 Pesos, Takeout in Cellophane ("Doggy Bag" is for free. Sausage & Fries: The Picture reminds me on a "Curry Wurst", so i ordered. It was a Swiss Deli (i think) Hungaria Sausage, with not too bad French fries and ordinary Cetchup. Parmesan Chicken: A Convenient Chicken steak with some parmesan on it out of the fryer. We would not choose the Hour Cafe for a nice dining, but for having a good coffee and/or having a fast snack little bit about local Carenderia, it is good for a stop. The Ambience is nice, they could make much more out of this place by higher Food quality. The Waitress was friendly, the Aircon just right, not too cold, not too warm. Not disappointing, but also not amazing.

Coffee and soup at 10:30 a.m. seems preposterous, you would think — yeah, I know….This recently-opened tiny cafe has quite a number of starters, sandwiches, desserts aside from rice meals and beverages. What's interesting here is the Korean Series added to their menu. The Korean Ramen came out quick and the taste, moderate size and spiciness was just what I needed that early. And as always, you can never go wrong with a Caramel Macchiato to gulp down whatever time of day. Kind staff too. Will surely visit again!

They prioritize their online orders than the customers who are actually in the café. Sausage and fries took an hour to make. Hour café maybe means you have to wait an hour for an order that would supposedly take 5 minutes. Do better. Serve better.
Their coffees is great, like literally. Food 5/5 love it so much. Even their fries
Generally great service, the food is also nice. Could use some work on lattes but it's generally fine
Basic taste for the hot matcha. Simple carbonara. Free wifi. Accessible parking.
Great ambience to dine in with an amiable crew. The food is fair for the price but still needs improvement in the taste of some dishes and drinks. I'll try others on their menu next time.
Aesthetic, clean + delicious foods and friendly staffs. A must visit Café ☺️
Dimples makes a fantastic coffee

Went to Humbletable a few times already and it's always a good experience. I've tried some of their non-coffee drinks (forgot the names 😅) but they were really good. The roasted chicken was flavorful and well-balanced, not too overwhelming. Their matcha and hojicha were also good and definitely worth trying. I really like the vibe of this place. Quiet, cozy, and chill. It's a perfect spot for reading books or just relaxing. Will definitely come back!

Absolutely loved this café! The place has such a warm, cozy atmosphere that makes you want to stay for hours. It's beautifully designed, clean, and incredibly relaxing—perfect for catching up with friends or enjoying some quiet time with a cup of coffee. The welcoming ambiance made the whole experience even better. Definitely a spot I'll be coming back to!

their drinks did NOT disappoint!! the vibes of the place is also peaceful, perfect for slowing down and living life 🤍 their hidden speakeasy (ma by humble table) was still closed when we got there during the morning but we got to order pa rin ng drinks that they offer in ma 😸. their staffs are also mabait <3 (ps. they have sockets but they don't have wifi)

The place is very cute and cozy, nice for dates or with a friend group. I ordered their iced matcha latte and it was actually pretty decent. Pretty creamy, not too sweet. The staff themselves bring you the drink so after ordering you can just go back to your seat and wait. Prices are also okay!

The café has a very cozy and inviting ambiance inside, though the exterior may not be as appealing since it's located in a downtown urban-poor area. Formerly known as Humble Coffee, this spot retains a "hole-in-the-wall" charm. I tried their Bandung Twist (non-coffee), which was okay but overly sweet for my taste. The choco cookie was good but felt overpriced given its small size. Their egg sandwich with homemade spread was average—the bread would have been better served warm. Service time was also noticeably slow; despite there being only two groups of customers, it still took quite a while for my cookie order to reach me, even though it was already displayed at the counter near my seat. On the bright side, I appreciate that their drinks are Singaporean-inspired, as the barista shared. Overall, while the drinks have character, I think they can still improve on their food menu since it feels too limited and, true to the name, a bit too humble.

November 27, 2025. Arrived around 7:40pm. Dripping water from the roof to entrance. Headed straight for MA slow bar at second floor since it closes at 8pm. Decided on ₱260 Ryori matcha but did not ask for sweetener. Sweetener is automatically served. The experience was great even the matcharista told us how to taste the drink and enjoy it. The Ryori on its own understandably needed sweetener but the oat milk is enough with it. Stayed there until 8:30pm but immediately placed the Matcha and iced milk in insulated mug. Added back water to the Matcha bowl so it's not wasted. This is my third slow bar here in Davao and will come back when it is convenient.

The owner/manager was nice, but some of the staff were not very welcoming and made it feel like customers were an inconvenience. One staff member even suggested that we go somewhere else, probably because they thought our group was too big, even though we weren't even that big of a group and there was still one available table that could accommodate us. Since the cafe itself is quite small and there were already other customers inside, maybe it already felt overwhelming for them, but I don't think that should show to customers if they actively encourage people to visit and grow their business. Since we ordered a generous amount of different food items, I understand that mistakes can happen, but several of our orders were forgotten and we had to follow up multiple times. What was disappointing was the lack of coordination among staff and the fact that no one apologized for the missed orders. I followed up politely, but one staff member responded rudely, as if it was such a hassle to prepare an order they forgot in the first place. The place is also much smaller than how it appears on social media. They don't seem fully prepared to accommodate bigger groups despite actively encouraging people to visit. Parking is very limited and only fits around two cars lang. Overall, the actual experience did not match how the cafe is presented online. Sana they can do better.

This unique coffee shop is a must try! I've been here twice and will continue to visit the Humble Table. First time I got a Peach Tea Cider to go and it was very refreshing. The second time we stayed in and had coffee, Negra and Morena Lattes, and a brookie (brownie cookie). Both lattes were as we hoped; flavorful and lightly sweetened. Friendly staff, cozy and unique atmosphere, and excellent drinks and sweets.

i've been a fan of their Bandung drinks (pink drink) since they were just a hole-in-a-wall coffee shop. still the same taste since I first tried it. price is also reasonable. service is always good. accommodating and polite staff. space is a bit small if there are plenty of cafe goers because of limited seats. maybe because I went on a weekend afternoon. overall, I'd like to come back to try other drinks.

I was really looking forward to trying this coffee shop since it has high ratings on Google, but we were a bit disappointed with the drinks. We ordered a Spanish latte and a flat white, and both unfortunately tasted more like instant coffee than espresso-based drinks. The place itself is nice, but we were expecting better coffee given the reviews.

my fave coffee shop in davao! the ambiance is so homey. their staff always greets us with a smile, which makes it even more welcoming. my go-to drinks are the oat ceremonial matcha latte and kori kohi. the pastries are so good too—especially the caramel bar. always a comfort spot for me. 🤍🪴

The place there is so cozy and perfect to study and very instragrammable. Their staff was also very friendly which makes you feel more comfortable. Their prices is very reasonable also for the quality you get.

Such a cute hole in the wall cafe! The vibes and aesthetic were immaculate, the drinks were good, and they even have unique drinks that you won't find anywhere else. The problem with the place is the parking. They have limited parking outside the cafe, so you have to find parking elsewhere. Aside from this, the space inside is small so make sure to come early if you want to just hang around and chill with friends. Overall, would recommend and will definitely be coming back to try their other drinks!

Humble Table has a warm, nostalgic charm—like a scene out of a 1960s film, with floral teacups on the table, your grandma knitting while your grandpa reads his newspaper on a sunny afternoon. The coffee is excellent, especially the Spanish latte, smooth and creamy and sweet — just the way I like it. Service is always top-notch, especially when the owner is around, adding a personal touch that makes the experience even better. Best enjoyed in the quiet of the morning before the afternoon crowd rolls in. P.S. I heard the designer is super talented! Kudos! 🤭😝

Going here may be hellish for anyone with the narrow street it's on. The frontage was forgettable but the serene, rustic interior makes it a stop-worthy visit on anyone's list. The taste of the sandwich and softness of the bread was likably light for the tummy. Menu had few choices that were also affordable. Now the decision to go left or right leaving the café was plain confusion as I was parked back to a wall. Best to travel on foot reaching this place.

This place is gorgeous if not sexy as it is. If you're in Davao and wish to find neighborhood like experience, I think HT is for you. The place is quaint and mysterious. From the outside you'll wonder how such a gem locates itself in residential spaces. I find the experience unique, similar to indie shops I go to in the US, when you step inside it feels ordinary but when you go upstairs for a macha, oh man, it felt intimate and exclusive. I go here for experience and macha, no wifi inside and they close early around 8:30pm to 9pm. Good job to the team behind!

Cute, cozy coffee shop tucked away in a peaceful alley. The coffee is great and the staff is incredibly friendly. I was particularly impressed to see the owner checking on guests midway through their meal to make sure they were happy. Highly recommend this place.

From CDO to do cafe hopping in Davao! We went by car — the road is kinda small and parking was a bit tricky 😅 The cafe feels super homey, which I loved! The food was good, though the choices felt a bit limited for us. Their matcha is okay, but just a little sad the matcha bar upstairs was closed. Tried: • Matcha Latte – 240 PHP, 7/10 💖 • Bolognese Pasta – 280 PHP, 8/10 🍝 • Beef Caldereta – 240 PHP, 8/10 🥰 Perfect spot if you're looking for cozy, homey vibes!

Impressive find! Humble Table was surprisingly busy for a new spot. The aesthetic is truly Instagram worthy- offering a serene ambiance, perfect for those seeking a peaceful nook to relax and making it an ideal spot for socializing with friends and your significant other. Just a heads up: limited seating! Get there early if you plan to stay a while. :)

Excuse me while I have a deep philosophical moment with coffee. Finally! Third attempt on finding this coffee shop and it really deserve a standing ovation! We ordered one of their specials Kori Kohi, the "pink drink" refreshing cider and Meztiza. All are meticulously prepared making it a coffee to remember. The ambiance is cozy, and instagrammable. It may hard to locate at first, but it's really a well deserve visit when found.

I stumbled upon a charming new café today! While it was a bit tricky to find (no sign yet, I guess that's part of their opening charm), my search was definitely rewarded. I treated myself to their Oat Ceremonial Matcha, and honestly, it's one of the best I've had in Davao City. The matcha was vibrant and smooth, with a perfect balance of sweetness and earthy notes. The café itself has a cozy vibe, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a delicious drink. Definitely worth checking out!

That's really an enchanted island in Davao, the preciousness of the cups collection shown in the exposition that are also used to serve the drinks is really amazing and is already worth a visit. The interior is a well designed and realized contemporary concept. The entrance is recognizable for the presence of some plants that is a subtle indication of a well kept location, the closed door shows the room is cooled by ac (without being too cold). There's no sign because this is a hidden gem that will be unveiled only to who can see and appreciate little details. There's a humble coffee nearby that is the to-go extension of the same Management.

I came here because of a bad review I read. To prove it wrong, I ordered the chicken sandwich and the Crème Brûlée Iced drink. Unfortunately, my expectations weren't met. I had to finish the sandwich because I came hungry and many people can't even afford to eat three times a day. Respect for the food and the people who prepared it. Also, not much of food choices. The interior, however, was cozy.
The place has a cute and cozy ambiance. The food was great, but the portions were a bit small. Still, it was a nice experience visiting!

Sooo earthy vibes. Good for people who would love to stay away from the noise of the world. The place doesn't seem too noticeable outside BUT THATS THE POINT. I love it upstairs because Matcha is 😍. You can whisk and make your own drink too with the owner who is very friendly.
Elegant place with friendly staff and owner. Atmospheric background music and great coffee and cookie!

Fantastic host and experience at Humble Table and the "speakeasy" tea space Ma Tea. We had a really nice latte with our rice bowls and were invited to have a Matcha Tea at their Tea space which was an educational experience in an intimate space. Well done. The interior design was on point and made it feel very cozy. On food, the Dinakdakan rice bowl was awesome. I have no doubt in recommending this - this may be a highlight of your day/week/trip.
Very cozy place with amazing coffee! Must try the Bandung drink!
The owner serves the food herself. Asks questions and feedbacks about the products for future improvements. Accommodating, kind, and the coffee and food lives up to it's hype!!
Very cozy place. Feels like home

This is my first time reviewing a cafe shop, If you are a matcha-enthusiastic/lover, this is for you! Their ceremonial oat matcha is definitely a must-try! Their matcha is not that sweet, but it tastes authentic and umami. I have not tried their other matcha options but If I had the opportunity, I would like to taste it. This is also my go-to place if I ever have a budget.
Vintage homey feels, great coffee and cool baristas

Enjoyed a charming atmosphere at 𝖧𝗎𝗆𝖻𝗅𝖾 𝗍𝖺𝖻𝗅𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗂𝖼𝗁 𝗂 𝗁𝖺𝗏𝖾 𝗏𝗂𝗌𝗂𝗍𝖾𝖽 𝖿𝗈𝗋 𝖺 𝗊𝗎𝗂𝖼𝗄 𝖼𝗈𝖿𝖿𝖾𝖾 𝗀𝗋𝖺𝖻.The minimalistic design and warm vibes make it a perfect spot for a laid-back hangout. Their specialty coffee's are awesome.Looking forward to revisiting soon!"

Tried matcha, kohi and brookie. The drinks are great, highly recommended. The brookie was too sweet for my taste. Wish they had more salty or savory food options.
been here twice. the staff and the owner are the most accommodating i've ever come across. the food is good and i loved the drinks i've tried here. will definitely be back soon

absolutely amazing, will be back again
I liked the calm atmosphere, perhaps because there were no customers, and I especially liked the acidity of the coffee.
joined their f1 watch party and it was fine. the place was neat. food is decent and size is good for 2-3 person, drinks were just okay.

The food is great. The drinks is a new experience. Recommend for me is the BerriLatteCha a combination of Strawberry, Milk and Macha. The atmosphere is also great soothing and peaceful away from roadside where you can hear cars and motors.

The café has a beautiful and aesthetic ambiance, especially the outdoor seating, which is spacious and relaxing. However, the indoor area is quite limited, so I wouldn't recommend it for large groups of friends or families. As for the food, we ordered the Buffalo Chicken Pizza. We were expecting a traditional pizza with pizza dough, but it was made using a shawarma wrap instead, which made it very thin. While the flavor was good, it was a bit too salty for my taste. The serving time was also quite slow, and we had to wait longer than expected for our order. Overall, the café has a nice atmosphere and potential, but I hope they improve their food consistency and service speed to provide a better dining experience.

Checked out this place a few weeks ago, it had a nice vibe, and I ordered one of their soft drinks, so I went back recently and ate probably the best burger (chicken cane) in the Philippines! The internet is good, the restrooms are spotless, the customer service is nice as well.

Tucked within the quiet streets of Juna Subdivision, HWYL Cafe is a hidden gem that blends charm and chill vibes. We asked why they are named as such and apparently, "HWYL" is a Welsh word for enthusiasm. It offers both indoor and outdoor seating, perfect whether you're in the mood to unwind with coffee or enjoy a relaxed catch-up with friends al fresco. Their specialty are the carbonated drinks made from carbonated water. Service is quick, the staff are warm and friendly, and prices are very reasonable. It's also pet-friendly, which makes it an even bigger plus for fur parents looking for a cozy spot to hang out.
Had a great time with friends in this cafe! Loved the food and drinks!
Best place for me time and family time. Inhale positive energy on this place.
A hidden gem along the busiest place in Davao. With good food, service, and ambiance. Connectivity quality is good for freelancers. This place is a must visit.
Very good

Pretty place ✨ i really enjoyed what i ordered (matcha bloom and korean chicken burger) the chicken burger is actually pretty heavy and i really like the buns that they used, its nt the typical airy kind of bun, medjo heavy and buttery sya which made it taste so much better.
Went here last week, nice & peaceful cafe, & close to DGT. Must try some peachspresso and the truffle pasta. 🫶 Plus points for being non-pork. 🙌

This was our first visit, and unfortunately it did not meet expectations. We ordered the Chicken Chardana meal after being informed that it was a two-piece chicken serving; however, what was provided was chopped chicken meat instead. This inconsistency was misleading and unacceptable. Additionally, the rice portion was excessively large and poorly balanced in relation to the rest of the meal. The service time was also unreasonable, as our order took more than 30 minutes to be served. We also tried the Campfire Mocha, which is advertised as their best seller. The drink was disappointing, as it lacked any noticeable coffee flavor and tasted more like diluted cocoa. It was served in a plain plastic cup without any branding, which gave an unprofessional and low-quality impression. Overall, this café does not live up to the hype it receives online. I would not recommend this establishment, as the food and drinks do not justify the positive attention it gets from influencers.

It's our second time here @HyggeCoffee2 it was a great experience, the staff is very accommodating the food serves well and very delicious. It's the best place to enjoy, relax and bonding with your friends and love ones. #Hygge-it all🫣

I was finally able to give Hygge a try today on a Thursday morning around 9. Two occupied tables but still plenty of available tables and more seating available on the patio. The place was clean and I was greeted upon entering. There are some good and unique items on the menu so I ordered the iced Sweet Potato latte and a slice of the Caramel Sea Salt Cheesecake. I wasn't sure what to expect with the sweet potato latte, but it was very good with very subtle taste of sweet potato and just the right amount of cream. The cheese cake was light and also very good with the caramel and sea salt not over powering, but subtly infused in the cheese cake. Overall a very good experience for me. Free WiFi for two hours.

- The interior looks nice, but the place was quite crowded with students when we visited, making it noisy even though it was already late at night. - There were only two staff members at the counter, and one of them was handling both hot and iced drinks, so our orders took a while—understandable since the café was nearly full. - Unfortunately, the cashier missed one of our orders, even after repeating it back to us. - The choco butternut cake was dry and bland, as if it had been sitting out for over a week. - I did enjoy the chicken burger/sandwich—probably the highlight of our visit. - The drinks were just average.

Very accessible and good location area. Good portion of serving. The atmosphere is conducive to both professional and students. Staff has pleasing personality and good idea to have a buzzer for the order. Good luck always to this cafe business and hopefully this can be maintained to ensure a good progress. 😀👍
Lamiay kaau ilang foods, fave nku ilng seasalt caramel nga coffee and there garlic pepper beef is a must try when visiting Hygge Coffee. Thank you for the good service.

Place: This cafe has a lot of space/table since it has an extension inside. I went on a busy Sunday and there is always a table available. Nice atmosphere wise, you could definitely do what you wanted to do as the ambience is okay. Drinks/Food: Coffee and other non-coffee based beverages are actually good. Also very affordable compared to nearby coffee places. I didn't get to try their rice meals but the donut and sliced cakes are good as well. Service: Very good customer service, and I was actually shocked that they accept cards and other modes of payment. Overall, if you want to have some coffee, chill/study/work, this is a comfortable place to go.

We usually eat dinner here with my classmates after our 9 PM class since Hygge is open 24 hours. There are five of us, and we all ordered the same meal, soy garlic chicken. One of us noticed that the chicken was still raw inside, so we checked the rest of our orders since we all had the same order, and unfortunately, all of them were undercooked as well. We informed the staff politely and they told us they would fix it within 5 minutes. However, after following up multiple times, 5 minutes turned into 10, then eventually 20 minutes. One staff member even seemed irritated and said "para di na hilaw, ma'am." When the replacement finally arrived, the chicken was extremely OVERCOOKED, so BURN and BLACKENED that it honestly looked more like beef than chicken. It was really disappointing, especially since we frequently dine here. We understand mistakes can happen, but better food quality and customer service would definitely improve the experience.

Staff lacks focus, we ordered something else they gave two different orders. Blamed us for the wrong order said that we ordered something else. Did not even say sorry. Took them 45 minutes to heat up cookies that they forgot as well. Guy had to come out and ask us again.
4th time dining in this cafe, Glad I listened to my friend Arniel's recommendation—this café didn't disappoint.

i tried giving chances to this place countless of times, but i think tonight will be the last time that i'll be here. the first cafe that I've been to that only serves water if may dala kang tumbler (for some reason wala silang baso?!??! and they don't sell bottled water din). always poor and slow ang customer service. we had to wait long for our food for about an hour, or even more at times. this happened at least twice, and we won't be coming back here again. plus, murag tapulan kaayo ilahang staff

On a Sunday is an apt time to drop by. Very limited parking at the sides. Drinks are claimed at the counter where you first ordered. Then, cooked foods are retrieved at the opposite window. Rates are reasonable as students are mostly here, even on weekends. Amply short menu. Cafe has an extension room for additional space. Crispy chicken burger coupled with the Peach tea Bobba was swiftly served and gobbled up. Nothing fancy just the standard cafe to snatch a quick spoonful….
The place is so cozy, I really love the food and coffee . Budget friendly and the staff are all accommodating. Keep up the good work Gonna dine here again.
Ordered several times but the chicken is ALWAYS undercooked. The drinks arent good either, and the place is often noisy with loud students.

our fave go to study place! a bit sad they dont have their own wifi yet pero the place and the food make up for it. There are 3 spaces to choose from — depending on the time of the day, there can be a several free spaces to very few left. Still, bet namin mag go here because the food & drinks are worth it (cake & cookies too!)
Absolutely delicious! Every bite was packed with flavor. Perfectly cooked, well-seasoned, and super satisfying.

i've been coming here regularly to study, and it's honestly one of my favorite spots. the atmosphere is cozy and calm—perfect for getting work done. the staff are always kind and accommodating, and the food and drinks never disappoint. whether I'm here for a quick coffee or a long study session, it always feels like a comforting space. highly recommended! 🤍
11/10 overall a must try coffee shop jud , recommended foods and drinks super ka budget friendly plus the quality thumbs up jud❤️

Such a great spot! The coffee is delicious - smooth, not too bitter, and always hits the spot. The vibes are super chill, and the staff is really nice and easy to chat with. It's the kind of place where you can hang out for a while, get some work done, or just relax with a good cup of coffee. Also, their pastries? So good. Definitely one of my go-to places now.

Food was not good. I ordered beef salpicao and turns out it doesnt have the same taste with what I had at their acacia branch (near kisom). The place was also too HOT, I think their ACs are not functioning well. Place was noisy too and NOT conducive for studying and/or working. I hope you'll fix these
Very cozy. Garlic pepper beef is my all time fave. Very worth it. Delicious coffee also. 😍😍😍😍
Food options are affordable. The vibe is cozy. One con was probably the texture of the food, I'd rate the taste 8/10, though. Also, it's not wheelchair accessible. Overall, it's a 7.5/10 for me.
served me raw chicken, makita pa po ang blood. told me it was because of himalayan salt. researched it, himalayan salt can't affect the color or the meat. when pierced, it had a paperlike texture.

Great place when meeting with friends and clients. Had a great time and was full because of their foods. Thanks to the great staffs! Will come back again.
Service is very poor and slow. The product is a takeout and it should be given if its done. Actually same lng ng quality ng nasa 39 pesos sa gilid. Choose wisely

some foods and drinks are very affordable, worth it and delicious, cozy and nice ambiance, perfect for studying, thanks hygge!❤️

if you are picky about food THIS IS NOT FOR YOU low quality rice meal to be specific slimy and obviously not cleaned properly their chicken and meats. yes I get that their rice meals are cheap but even with other ingredients you save on food NOT JUST CLEANING CHICKEN AND MEATS PROPERLY. how much is vinegar and salt for cleaning meats ughh the food is not even finished and the chicken is still disgusting

I don't really know about you but this is my second home when I was still studying haha. The food servers and attendants are so kind. THE FOOD PRICE? Thank u hygge, until now that I graduated I always eat and drink here. There is wifi too :))

I asked for service water twice. Just because you don't give water because there are no glasses. Eh? Buy more glasses so you don't run out. It would have been nice if I just went in there to ask for water. Please provide more glasses, and might as well train your staff to do better customer service. Thank you!

Went there at around 10pm for late dinner and to continue work bc its a 24-hr cafe BUT the place is very dirty. The tables have no wipes and there is still trash from previous customers. It's okay to come clean but there is no trash bin, so we just moved it to another table that has trash. We were embarrassed to ask them because there seemed to be only 2 of them at the counter at that time and there were many customers. The coleslaw side is only 1 teaspoon small. Then our pasta is very watery, there is no pajuy bread unlike the photo posted here (same order) in other reviews. Then the worst part is that they ran out of wifi vouchers so we couldn't connect to their wifi so we just ate there and left. Also, the place is not conducive to studying at that time because one customer was loud because he had a vcall and he could have just minimized his voice as a courtesy to other customers but he didn't, he was busy in a debate meeting with his groupmates haha. I loved this cafe a year ago because I was studying my undergrad at 6am if I had quiz and exams at 8am in addu. Plus, some of the food was delicious at that time esp some tocino! I don't know what happened this time. Maybe they haven't maintained it? I was just disappointed. I understand that the cafe is open 24hrs but they should have maintained the cleanliness and quality of the food next time. Hoping you guys will improve next time! :)

It was really good and nice, i could go back and dine in everyday here because the coffee/foods was really great and i loved the taste of spanish latte, it is really good. btw that's my favorite coffee.😊

Looking at the other comments, they did have similar issues with mine. I pray for their future improvements... 🙂

I've actually been here a couple of times already before writing this review, and honestly I wouldn't highly recommend this coffee shop due to its slow food preparation process, where my friends and I usually have to wait for over 30 minutes for our meals (which happened earlier today). However, I'm writing this review in appreciation and gratitude for their staff on duty today. Story time: My friends and I went here to eat breakfast. We ordered our food and waited more than 30 minutes for the food and free WiFi coupon. By the time my food arrived (which was cornsilog), I ate it and it tasted sour, which didn't make sense at all since it's corned beef (How can corned beef be sour?). Even upon deciding to finish it, my friends called the attention of the server/chef and asked why the corned beef was sour (shout out to my friends!). The chef then apologized profusely and offered to prepare a fresh batch. After serving the fresh batch (upgraded my white rice to java rice), not only did he apologize once again, he also brought the staff in training (the one who cooked my first meal—the sour one) to apologize to me as well. I'm genuinely amazed with their service and accountability, which is why I wanted to write this review and let everyone who plans to visit here that despite the slow service, I hope you'll still choose to visit this place. 🫶🫶

Honestly, I had a terrible experience here. I ordered a coffee to take home, and when I opened it, it wasn't even full and it looked like they had put something in it mural paminta or ambut unsa na hugaw vanilla latte tapos Mao ng nawng! I can't believe this happened on my second order. I will definitely not be coming back.

I ordered a Spanish latte take-out... I was quite disappointed. For a mid-range priced coffee (150 pesos), the amount of drink inside was only %30 of the cup, not only that, it even has lots of ice inside and to think the amount of ice won't even fill the cup to the edge. 😅😂 Customer service was... Well... Slow and quite gloomy and to note that it wasn't a busy hour and there were less customers in the cafe at the time. Perhaps I'll try to be understanding that it may be a long day for the staff. Will visit again on another day and change my review if there are any improvements, for now there are a lot of things needed to improve. 😇

The place looks very nice and clean inside although it's a bit cramped especially if there ar a lot of people, but I liked the ambience there. It feels like a good place to meet up with friends and grab a quick cup of coffee. I ordered their hot matcha latte...it was too sweet for my liking, plus it came in a small cup. They don't have the option for a medium and large cup which is a bit disappointing. Will try to taste their coffee soon to see if it's any good. Update. Went to get a cup of coffee and it took them 15mins to serve me my drink. They either forgot about my order or idk. The management needs tot rain their staff better. Would not recommend this place if you're in a rush. Too bad, they're one of the few coffeeshops that opens up at 6am.

The place, coffee, and food are totally okay, the internet connection needs improvement because I notice that many students, especially those who hang out alone, need internet. It's a shame about the place knowing the connection they have, which is disappointing even though they only provide it for a limited time, but it's really slow.

Place is nice especially for students whose looking for a quiet place do study. Coffee and pastry are soso and affordable. Since we are not students we opted to use the table outside and there's a cute cat that's so clingy. overall the most laidback cafe i have ever visited
The atmosphere was very calm. And they didn't take long to give my order. Very fast service
The staff clearly needs more training. Service was a bit unorganized and communication could be improved. Mali2 ang order. Quality of the food is mid.

VERY POOR AND ODD CUSTOMER SERVICE! THE GIRL WITH AN OILY UNPRESENTABLE FACE AT YOUR KIOSK HAS A VERY UNWELCOMING VIBE! NA PARA BANG AYAW NIYA NA MAY BUMILI! WE WERE ASKED TO MAKE LIPAT TO ANOTHER TABLE WHILE EATING! VERY DISSAPOINTING! HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE! NEVER NA BABALIK! IMPROVE YOUR SERVICE! IMPROVE EVERYTHING!

Converge was down, so I needed a place open around 3am to work. I found this amazing place that was not only open but also incredibly comfortable to work in. Service really needs work. We also asked for the pudding to be packed for takeout, but it was served in a dine-in plate. It took another 10 minutes just to get it repacked. Small thing, but it adds up. The drinks themselves were a letdown. The matcha, priced at ₱250–₱295, came in a small cup that wasn't even filled to the top. Taste-wise, it wasn't anything special. The milk overpowered the matcha. There are definitely better and more reasonably priced options elsewhere in Davao. Also worth noting: they don't give receipts unless you ask, not even a simple POS slip. I really wanted to enjoy my visit, especially because of the great online presence the cafe has. But there's a noticeable gap between what's presented on social media and what customers actually experience. If you're going to build a brand with that much visibility, the in-store experience really needs to keep up.

We are relatively blessed in Toril to have quite a number of coffee shops to have opened up over the years, but they are mostly freezing cold boxes with loud obnoxious music, Inherent Coffee gets the coffee shop formula right - it's chill, it's got people in there working, there IS music, not exactly to my taste(for a coffee shop) and not as background as I would like it to be, but at least it's not super obnoxious, and the selection itself nothing really offensive, top 40 radio playlist. **update** the music vibe is much improved now with chill ambient music/beats. -feb 2026 The coffee and the food was great. The coffee rivals the best other coffee shops here in Toril (there are other good places to get good coffee, but worse than awful food, as is the case in Solace, or the general disco vibe in a refrigerator ambiance, overall, for me, sucks), the food was great, it even had some garnish on it, which is something a lot of people don't pay any attention to, and the chicken katsu that I had was nice and crispy but juicy and tender inside, very good, no complaints. The only thing that I can complain about is it was still too cold inside. I walked in and I had to walk right back out to go get my jacket which I happened to have because I was riding my motorcycle. It would not hurt anybody to just keep their air temperature at 27° - no one is uncomfortable at 27°. My only other minor complaint is that if you want to sit and have a meal and if you happen to bring a laptop too, to do work, the tables are very small, and can just barely accommodate any food on them; they're like tables really meant to just have a cup of coffee on. They do have some more tables outside on their balcony which then you can also enjoy the local air temperature, and it is shaded, but then you have to breathe the smog and suffer the street noise and the heat and humidity, but the place is open until 5:00 a.m.!!!!! which is super cool, so later at night the balcony could be a nice option. The location is very good, it's near the center of Toril on a pretty big road but not a major major roadway with lots of high-speed trucks roaring by. If you want a more chill location with also great food and coffee, Cafe Sierra is still the number one spot in Toril, a more living room vibe, while Inherent Coffee seems more professional and proper coffee shop. Overall glad to have this excellent new addition in Toril which I will gladly return to as long as I have a jacket to wear, but I wish they would adjust their air conditioning to a temperature where anyone can be comfortable with the clothing that we have to wear outside (while also saving BIG money on their electric bill).

#reysrestaurantreview J.A.S Caffeinated There are so many things to like about Caffeinated. a. The location is perfect. Accessible but not congested. b. Interior is not spectacular but not disgusting. Boring yes (God, plastic plants must be outlawed now). Plastic Plants are simply a sign of poverty of imagination. Gray walls with soft yellow hanging lights ? Really? But it will do. c. Service is good. Although the four staff have the tendency to conglomerate in the pantry and you need to shout to call their attention , but they are smiling and efficient except one whose default mode is frowning. No problem. Baka may MPD (may prosesong dinadaanan) d. Food is great and affordable. I tried four menus: grilled salmon is glorious, seafood marinara is okay, JAS Salad is fine, and sausage platter is a No NO. Don't order it. And three pieces of sausage is not a Platter. Go to Swiss Deli, they know what is Sausage Platter. My only beef? Their insistence that caramelized cheese cake is Creme Brulee. Excuse me. Those who know me are aware that there are only three desserts I can tolerate: banoffee is third, blueberry cheesecake is second and creme brulee is first. I have tasted creme brulee in a Parisienne deli, in Venice and all over the country. I KNOW what is creme brûlée.So don't me. Still, this is a great cafe, so I really recommend this when you are in Davao.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Went here at 10pm. Place looks cozy and nice. We sat outside. Service was good. Food could be better. The shakshuka doesn't taste like shakshuka at all. Doesn't have the necessary spice it needs. It just taste like pork and beans, too sweet. Creamy chicken lacks flavor too, I thought that was their best seller because my friend recommended it. Chicken was not crunchy and meat was a bit dry. She said it was good when they went there before at 3am. Maybe kitchen was overwhelmed because it was a bit busy. Try it yourself maybe it was just our experience. 3 cheese quesadilla/pizza my friend orderd, she said is really good and worth it. I'll try it next time. Probably will come back there for a morning coffee and chill since the place has a nice ambiance.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: One of the best place to go. Went here 7PM on a Monday. I was with my girlfriend. We just saw this from a review video on facebook. First, the Food is great but not the perfect type for 5 star but at least it is a 4 star. Second is the service is great and amazing. We were greeted, presented to our table, and given water. The staffs are easy to call on to, they also served the food earlier than usual. Third the atmosphere, this was one of the best place since the ambiance suits to whatever mood you may have, romantic or serious or chilling. Just amazing

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Service attendant was courteous. Food flavor was adequate except for the fish dish that had tough portions, may have been overcooked. review_text: The creamy beef is perfect. Worth the price and taste. The pork lechon kawali is barely a single serving for the price of 5-6 pax. The 190php rice bundle is not worth it. It's only worth 2-3. It would be better to order ala carte. The drinks are superb. Worth a second visit.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The serving time was surprisingly fast. Food was good I ordered pasta and was filling. Overall experience was great. Only concern was maybe there would be mosquitos due to the lake outside.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Ambiance: The place is really nice with a great layout. You have the choice between a cool air-conditioned indoor area or a breezy alfresco space. One tip: if you choose the alfresco, be prepared for some mosquitoes! Food: The food is good and definitely worth the price. While it didn't completely blow me away, everything was well-prepared and satisfying for a meal out. Service: Very positive experience with the crew. They are accommodating and attentive. Overall: A solid spot for a meal, especially if you enjoy garden-style dining. Just bring some repellent if you're sitting outside!

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Located on the lot of Garden Fresca. Lemon peach (sparkling water) and aglio olio pasta were savory. Plates I took home were just okay taste-wise (see photos). Rates were higher but each dish was generally for 3-4 pax. Ask the waiter for a wifi voucher which covers only 2 hours. More vouchers should be given for those who spent 3k above. Complainits: - air-conditioning was warm (FAN mode is more appropriate) - annoying flies hovering while eating - staff - noisy (chitchatting) - continuous coughing/sneezing of lady cashier - inattentive waiter with my takeout order instructions (had to wait for another hour) - frozen lettuce leaves hidden under on both the garden and waldorf salads - sucks that there's a service charge for debit card (3%) and P15 for gcash (gotyme) There you have it. I won't be coming back. However, I'm still hoping Management will improve on those stated above for the sake of future customers.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: It was a wonderful dining experience made special by the very accommodating staff.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: I wish I could give more stars! Impeccable customer service from chat to dine, excellent food and generous serving. Everyone was welcoming, even the security guard who accommodated us when we arrived. Servers had great smiles on their faces. Perhaps more lights on the river would be an upgrade since the atmosphere was cozy. Huge thanks to the social media manager who was very patient and recommended tasty foods despite some items not being available. My favorite dish was the pesto pasta and the mango quesadilla. It was such a promising dish, though I wish it was a pizza rather than a quesadilla. Not really a fan of quesadillas here in Davao. Hopefully soon, pizzas can take over the quesadillas because I could barely taste the cheese but I enjoyed it.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The serving took a long time. We waited for more than an hour. The food wasn't served all at once. They served it on a different time that you have to consume it first, and your companion will eat later than you did. This means you can not enjoy the food at the same time. My baby back ribs was served cold, and when I started savoring it. It was hard, and it seemed like it was a leftover that was heated. All in all, my experience was not good.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Nice restaurant in the metro. We came here for lunch and everything was delicious! Crispy pata, sinigang sa mangga and manggo quesidilla was all great! Service was very good too. Highly recommended when visiting davao

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Overall, JH Garden Cafe & Restaurant has raised the bar with its thoughtful improvements. The quality of the food, the impeccable service, and the peaceful ambiance all come together to create a truly unique experience. It's the kind of place that not only satisfies your appetite but also rejuvenates your spirit with its stunning lakeside views and cozy environment. If you find yourself in Davao, make sure to stop by – it's the perfect blend of nature, comfort, and great food in the heart of the city.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina

review_text: Whether you're meeting friends, enjoying a romantic dinner, or spending some quiet time alone, JH Garden Cafe & Restaurant provides the perfect setting. place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The food at JH Garden has seen a noticeable upgrade. Whether you're in the mood for a hearty meal, a light snack, or a refreshing drink, they deliver an unforgettable culinary experience every time.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The café's strong connection to nature is evident in every corner. Surrounded by lush plants and trees, JH Garden provides an environment that encourages relaxation and rejuvenation. The gentle breeze, the soothing sounds of nature, and the calming greenery help create an experience that's not just about food but about connecting with the peacefulness of the outdoors. It's the kind of place where you can escape the fast-paced city life and immerse yourself in a more relaxed, mindful environment.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: If you're looking for a place that offers the perfect combination of delicious food, top-notch service, and a peaceful ambiance, JH Garden Cafe & Restaurant in Matina, Davao City, is a must-visit. place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Coffee was really good. We all enjoyed our cups. Kudos to the graveyard shift barista. The quesadilla was yummy as well. Will definitely come back to try the other dishes.

review_text: I actually like it here. They have a delicious pizza and other foods. You can smell nature. You can feel calmness in the place. I must visit this place again soon.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: An Honest Review JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant in their MATINA BRANCH is open 24hrs EVERYDAY My husband and I went 4 AM on a Sunday to avoid the crowd and to experience an early breakfast with the sun rising. This experience was so amazing. I kid you not. Now let's talk about the food. Coffee was really good. I had Cappuccino and Hubby got Caramel Macchiato. CM was so so but Cappuccino was UHMMM 🤌🏽 For Mains we got Baby Bach Ribs and Sizzling Steak Ala Pobre. Hubby said Steak was Good 8/10 . I loved my Baby Back Rib this melts on your mouth, The only thing I really don't like is the amount of fat that was still attached on the rib. I'm not a fan of beef fat. So this for me is 8/10. Next is the Sweet Keso Pizzadilla. This one was 100/10. I was shocked since it was served with garlic on top, but to my surprise it was not overpowering at all. Caramelized garlic was so good with cheese. This is a must try. We don't have the chance to order their pasta because we're so full. STAFF. 10/10. All of them must have been awake all night but greeted us with smiling faces. After ordering and getting our table they quickly served us service water and told us that coffee will be served in a while. I really love this place. It is peaceful. Good for serene date nights with deep talks. 👍🏻 MUST VISIT

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: We went there for a quick late lunch. We were told that our orders will be out in 20 minutes, but we waited more than the time promised. place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The place is pleasantly located in Coca-Cola Village in the bustling area of Matina. This charming bistro offers a serene escape with its beautiful garden-themed ambiance and warm, inviting atmosphere. The food is both delicious and affordable. We tried their best-selling Sweet Keso Quesadilla as our side. For our mains, we had the Sizzling Steak Ala Pobre, and Pasayan Espesyal. The Nutella Hazelnut frappe was also a nice touch of mix-and-matching two flavors that most people know and resulted in a surprisingly new flavor that I can't explain, so you should try it. Despite its low ratings, our experience at JH Garden Cafe was exceptional. The food was served promptly, and the staff was friendly and attentive. Perhaps the lack of reviews can be attributed to the fact that we visited during a less crowded time. One thing for sure though is that this place is not your typical fast-food chain where you just need to line up and have your order assembled in front of you at the counter. No, they prep your food within the required amount of time for your satisfaction so this should be a good heads up for fractious individuals not to come here. Overall, if you're looking for a peaceful place to unwind, enjoy good food, and spend quality time with loved ones, JH Garden Cafe is a highly recommended place.

The tonkatsu was ok but the sauce is like the ready-made packed sauces in the grocery. The garlic parmesan chicken had a very soft and chewy crust... probably flour and egg was used for the batter. review_text: We went to this place on a Sunday evening for dinner. The place inside (first floor) is quite small but includes very cute and aesthetic designs on the wall. We came here with a lot of expectations as we heard a lot of good reviews about the food, not just from online but from friend and colleagues as well. The food is good, but the service is so bad! They didn't even acknowledge their mistake. They heard us getting impatient, one of us went to the counter several times to follow up with the food but they just kept on saying 5 minutes. There's a lot of 5 minutes in an hour, imagine. Do better. Edit as reply to owner: Thank you for assuring us that you'll relay this concern to your staff, but I would like to reiterate that we indeed waited for over an hour, as our dishes were only served well after 9:50 AM. We arrived at approximately 8:40 AM, appreciated being accommodated and seated, and started ordering around 8:50 AM. So no, this was not just a case of "waiting feels longer when you're hungry." We kept track of the time, and your response feels dismissive and invalidating of our concern. What makes this even more frustrating is that the place was practically empty when we arrived, so the long wait is difficult to justify. It was also such a slap to see customers who arrived after us get served first. Kaos Cafe has quickly established itself as a vibrant go-to destination for anyone looking to pair a cozy atmosphere with genuinely satisfying meals. Nestled conveniently in the city, the cafe offers an inviting escape where patrons can unwind, catch up with friends, or enjoy a quiet moment. Beyond its relaxed interior and charming street-side vibes, the true highlight of the experience lies in its kitchen, which consistently turns out food that punches well above the typical cafe fare. The menu boasts a stellar lineup of comforting favorites, ranging from savory Japanese rice bowls like their crispy Chicken Katsudon to hearty breakfast classics and flavorful pasta dishes. Each plate is prepared with careful attention to taste and presentation, ensuring that every bite delivers on flavor without feeling heavy or rushed. Whether you are grabbing a quick mid-day bite or settling in for a leisurely meal, the comforting portions and well-balanced seasonings make it easy to find something you will love. Of course, no cafe trip would be complete without something to drink, and Kaos Cafe pairs its savory options with an impressive beverage selection. Their specialty iced coffees and rich lattes provide the ideal caffeinated kick, rounding out the dining experience seamlessly. Thanks to its winning combination of great food, inviting ambiance, and dependable drinks, Kaos Cafe delivers an all-around dining experience that keeps locals and visitors coming back for more.

Preferred in hot form but kept the ice because it's hot there. Once ice melts, it smells eggy when drank from cup. I guess there's a reason why straw is provided. Next is kokobop. ₱135 Kokobop with ₱25 Ube Foam was a must because it's felt centered to the cafe. But like the egg coffee, should have gotten them in takeout form for larger portions. From the moment you step into Kingdom Cafe and Bistro, you'll be greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The rustic decor, with its charming wooden furniture, soft lighting, and beautiful artwork, creates a comfortable and relaxing ambiance that's perfect for enjoying a cup of coffee or a meal. One of the highlights of Kingdom Cafe and Bistro is their exceptional coffee. The baristas are true artisans, meticulously crafting each cup of coffee with precision and care. Whether you're in the mood for a classic cappuccino, a velvety latte, or a rich pour-over, you can expect a delicious and perfectly brewed cup of coffee that will satisfy your taste buds and give you that much-needed caffeine boost. The menu at Kingdom Cafe and Bistro is equally impressive. They offer a range of breakfast and lunch options, as well as delectable pastries and desserts. Their food is made with fresh, high-quality ingredients, and their menu features a variety of options to cater to different dietary preferences, including vegetarian and vegan choices. One of their standout dishes is the avocado toast, which is piled high with creamy avocado, fresh veggies, and a tangy lemon dressing, making it a perfect choice for a healthy and satisfying meal. What sets Kingdom Cafe and Bistro apart is their exceptional service. The staff is friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about their offerings. They take the time to explain the different coffee brewing methods and make recommendations based on your preferences, ensuring that you get the perfect cup of coffee to suit your taste. The service is prompt, and the staff goes above and beyond to ensure that you have a pleasant and memorable experience. In addition to their excellent coffee and food, Kingdom Cafe and Bistro also offers a cozy outdoor seating area, which is perfect for enjoying a sunny day or people-watching. They also have free Wi-Fi, making it a great spot for remote work or catching up on emails while sipping on your favorite coffee. Overall, Kingdom Cafe and Bistro is a hidden gem that provides an exceptional coffee shop experience. From their delicious coffee and scrumptious food to their cozy ambiance and outstanding service, it's a place where you can relax, unwind, and indulge in a truly delightful coffee shop experience. Whether you're a coffee aficionado, a foodie, or simply someone who appreciates a charming atmosphere, Kingdom Cafe and Bistro is a must-visit destination.

Mind you, we were waiting for our order for almost an hour, with a dirty table. We ordered at 8:33 pm, and our orders arrived around 9:26-9:30 pm (almost an hour 😭); the ice on the matcha drinks had already melted causing the drinks to be too watery after the first sip, the seasalt caramel latte is too salty and the coconut latte tasted weird. I really love the industrial look of Kotetsu. The iron, wood, and concrete design feels warm and functional. I would never think of using I-beams as small shelving spaces. The artful pieces were so interesting too. While a bit on the expensive side, the coffee was delicious. I especially liked the oat Spanish latte. This cafe at 2nd floor fronting Nishlan (chocolate store), located inside the commercial building that is fronting Make up store (Avon).

The location of the cafe is a bit difficult to find since it's located inside a compound on the second floor at the end of the building. Upon entering the cafe, they have this brutalist design which matches perfectly with the cafes name so don't expect a cozy interior. Although, it doesn't feel like a good place to get some work done, but they didn't have WiFi when we visited so that's something to think about. At the same time, the space is a bit small, so that's something to consider if you're planning on coming as a group. As for the prices, it's pretty much the same as the prices of their sister cafe (wood and coffee) so I wouldn't say that the cafe is student friendly because of this. In terms of the food and beverages, they were pretty standard in my opinion. I'd have to go back and taste the other beverages on their menu.

I've heard they serve one of the best Matcha drinks in town, and so I finally had the chance to visit them last week. Unfortunately, their Hojicha Cacao did not meet my expectations. It was, I would say, bland in taste. For Php 235, I'd say try some of their drinks instead. However, please be aware that most of their drinks here is a bit pricier than Starbucks or other third-wave coffee shops. In terms of the ambiance/vibe, the place has a brutalist/industrial interior. I just find it funny that they turned off the A/C from where I am sitting, but was gracious enough to place an electric fan instead. And oh, do not pay via credit card. The staff did not informed me that they charge additional 5% on top of your total bill so I was shocked to see I was charged a higher amount. In addition, they will not provide you an invoice UNLESS REQUESTED. By law, merchants aren't allowed to charge customers with surcharges/terminal fee for every credit card transactions. I guess they get away with it because they label the additional 5% surcharge/terminal fee as "Service Charge" when you do not get charged a "Service Charge" if you pay by cash lol. I could report them to DTI for unfair practice but I do not have time to do so. Well at least, you've been informed ahead. Pay in cash if possible. If you're planning to work/study here, they do not have a WiFi so make sure you have reliable mobile data with you. They have charging outlets though.

I've been a regular at both Kotetsu and Wood and Coffee since 2024 because they make some of the best matcha blends in Davao. But my visit yesterday (1/17/26) might make me think twice about going back to Kotetsu. We grabbed a spot at one of the long wooden tables near the bar. The baristas were as friendly as ever, and the Okumidori and other drinks were delicious. A few hours in, though, we spotted bugs crawling across the table. At first, I thought they were just big ants, but they turned out to be bed bugs. I told one of the waiters about it and asked if they could clean the table after we left, but I know it would need stronger chemicals to get rid of them. We had to check all our clothes and belongings to make sure they didn't hitch a ride home with us. I'm writing this review so the owners can fix the problem. I really hope it gets sorted out soon because Kotetsu is one of my favorite cafes in the city.

The matcha was smooth and not too sweet, the Americano was really good, and the sandwich was noicee and filling. We stayed for a bit to get some work done, and it's actually a nice spot for that. The Wi-Fi was fast, and the music was a bit loud but still a fun vibe. The place feels cozy and makes you want to stay longer. It's a small space, but the aircon is really good, perfect for escaping the heat of the pelepens. Definitely a nice spot to hang out or get some work done while enjoying good food and drinks.
my favorite chicken egg sandwich!!! so good 5/5 !! the staffs are also nice!!

coffee shop at the corner of Mergrande. If you're coming from Mergrande or Water World and don't feel like drinking your own drink, come here and cool off with their Cold Drinks offerings.

A tiny, budget-friendly shop along the narrow Tinikling Road. The smooth taste of the Iced L Primo (Spanish Latte) was prepped and handed over to me by the nice lady. Some routine snacks and beverages similar to other coffee shops are printed on the short menu. Parking space is also limited. Will return soon….

The ambiance is refreshing, it's a small cafe but the layout with that big mirror gives an illusion that the place is big. It's instagramable worthy place with nice lighting and color scheme. I ordered there L'Primo Hot Coffee which is a Spanish Latte, it has the right balance of coffee and cream. I love there coffee mug, elegant and rustic. Though I feel that the mug is a bit small for it's serving, nevertheless it gives you that luxurious touch without breaking the bank. They have free wifi and electric sockets for your phone or laptops, so it's good for studying or some office works. I went there with a full belly so I wasn't able to order there food, but would try it on my next visit. Overall, this cafe is in my Top 10 small cafe's I've visited. Update: I just had their Taco Salad & Baked Mac and it tasted great. I love their Iced Salted Caramel Latte, the taste is just right. The Americano though felt a little light, I think it's the proportion of water and espresso or something like that. Overall, the experience was great and the food was great.

We decided to try this place because of its pretty unique concept. There's a laundry shop on one side and a coffee shop beside it. There was a power outage in our neighborhood, so my partner continued working here for a while. The staff were very attentive and nice. The only small downside was that since the place is quite small, you can really hear them talking loudly sometimes hahaha. The air conditioning was okay, just enough that you won't sweat, but it wasn't cold. As for the food and drinks, they were honestly just okay for us. Also, there were some work-related websites that my partner couldn't access while using their internet, though we're not really sure why. Overall, it's still a decent place if you just want somewhere nearby to chill or work.

The food was good and anything we ordered was available. Except of Gelato (ice cream), nothing available. Pizza is very well done in a wooden stone brick oven. First meal serving was very fast, but later the empty plates stays until the end (more than 40 minutes) on our table.

First time trying this Italian food spot. Love the ambiance of the place, calm and cozy. The food was good! Don't sleep on their roasted porchetta dish, the pork was tender and flavorful. The pesto pasta could be improved. Pizza was really fresh and light. I recommend going here on lunch time when it's less crowded.

The place exudes a warm and inviting atmosphere, making it a delightful spot to visit. Their chocolate fudge is an absolute treat, and their polvoron is simply the best you'll ever taste. It's a must-try for anyone seeking a sweet indulgence. Additionally, they have a bistro that offers a variety of dining options, making it a perfect destination for a satisfying meal.

I personally love this place because of its atmosphere and food. They serve delicious food here specially their mains and pizzas. Serving size can feed 1-2 people, their gelato flavors are very interesting, food is served in a timely manner, has reasonable prices, and the staff is also attentive. Nice place to chill with friends and loved ones.
The home away feom home. Great food. Ambiance is really cozy and Great service.

Food was good, waiters were helpful. But upon encountering a problem with our order, we were not even informed it was cancelled or that it was never coming at all. We just waited until it was time to bill out and actually billed out without it. That was not good.

Went there for a late lunch so the place is not packed. Food is nice, ambiance is nice too. Staff are friendly and attentive. Love their truffle cream pasta, reminds me of Mama Lou's but with a more subtle flavor. Serving can be good for two, had a hard time finishing a plate.

Every bite is a blissful escape into a world of exquisite flavors! Their dishes are a burst of flavors – a symphony for your taste buds they say. I could just not recommend one, because all that we tried are a must try! Love the ambiance too! They are open from 10:30 am. Lots of food to try in this gem! Though the bistro is already operating years back, finding it is like discovering a hidden treasure in the world of flavors.

We were recommend to try their pizza. We started with a salad which was amazing, and then the thin crust Chicken Alfredo Pizza (ordered extra cheese🍕) came out. WOW! Baked in a proper wood fired brick oven. The ambience and service is wonderful. Oh, they also have Gelato, Coffee, Smoothies & Shakes, and a Fudge, and sweets. You've gotta try this place!

We were sat near the brick oven, it was a nice ambiance. Place was fully packed but the staff were very attentive. Pizzas are made per order so expect there will be a bit of waiting time, but it's sooo worth it! All the food we ordered were great! We had seafood marinara, quattro formaggi, tomato and basil soup, and the hot chocolate as well. Will go back again for sure! Cheers!

This is a very cozy restaurant with an excellent view. Parking is slightly a challenge since it is limited. The waiter was excellent in letting us sit inside while it was crowded hats off for their customer service 👏 the ambiance is superb, and the cleanliness is super plus. My overall experience is one that I highly recommend for anyone who wants to have a pleasant meal and superb experience with loved ones, business partners, or friends.this is a must visit in my book, and I will surely come back.

Food was good - we especially loved the mac and cheese! Carbonara was a surprise, we are used to it being creamy but theirs was refreshing because the creaminess was not overwhelming! Not a fan of the Quatro formaggi (4 cheese something pizza) - the texture was a bit dry for me. Service was a bit disappointing, we had to followup our other orders (pizza, pasta, shake) turned out that the server forgot to take note all of them so we basically waited for nothing wondering why they only served us the salad we ordered lol Ambiance was very nice. Space inside is a bit small but there is enough room for everyone. Al fresco area is nice as well. Price reveal at the last photo! 😁

Their Porkchetta is perfect! Love their pizza too. Servers are friendly. Service is prompt. Ambiance is cozy. Editing my old review: This place is famous because they serve delicious dishes. I usually have pasta or pizza. You can have two flavors in your pizza (I think you can even have four). Their coffee is good, as well as their gelato. And yes, their staffs are accommodating as always. This is one of my go-to places here in DC, which I always recommend to my visiting friends.

Always a go-to place for pasta, pizza, and everything in between (as long as they can serve it). However, I wished their service would be better. It's okay, at best. But our server said one of our orders was quick to cook, and still took some 20 minutes to serve. I'm not complaining that much. Still, I would prefer some truth and transparency for the actual serving times.

The place offers a wide selection of Italian comfort food. Quattro formaggi - brick oven pizza with generous cheese toppings with toasty-chewy crust. Oil and cream - based pasta dishes - great texture and authentic flavors, but definitely not "for sharing" as claimed by their staff. Roasted chicken and Osso bucco - fall off the bones, flavorful to the last bite, and not greasy. Carrot walnut cake - the best I have tasted (and I have tasted a lot of carrot cakes!). The cream cheese frosting was not too sweet and not too thick (still melty). The walnut crumb coat provided excellent texture and toasty flavor. Gelatos - do not leave the place without sampling the Lean in New York Cheesecake flavor. Coffee americano - bold and not too acidic. Staff were not too attentive (maybe because there were many customers), but were nice enough not to judge us for our big appetite.

Loved all the food we ate here. We had the insalata caprese, insalata prosciutto as our appetizers and I enjoyed all the elements of our salads. I don't usually like caprese type salads but I loved it. We had frutti di mare pizza and it had generous seafood pieces which I like! Pizza is also oven baked on the spot, I love it. Wish we had more time in Davao to come eat here again.

Fabulous restaurant near the women's college in Juna subdivision. It's walking distance from MTS or even S&R. Stopped in there twice during my long vacation around Davao city. Wish they had marked motorbike parking, bec parking options are scarce. Lots of vegetarian options. Save room for dessert—their carrot walnut cake is heavenly. Will be back next year!

I love the prosciutto & aragula pizza, Manzo al Rosmarino, pears & mesclun salad, chorizo & gambas pasta. Main orders were really great, freshly cooked and smell so good. However, carrot and ube cake were a little of a disappointment. Probably it's a few days old stock and cream cheese frosting had an aftertaste. They also don't serve coffee at the moment. They have an al fresco area if you'd like to dine-in. They installed a hands-free temperature check and sanitizer. Better to call and reserve if you'd like to dine-in. There's parking in front but it can get a little crowded sometimes.
My wife and I's favorite dining place. Never disappoints.

Lara Mia has the look, feel and taste of a Bistro that could be found in Italy or some other European country. Even perhaps in the more affluent communities in the USA like Newport Beach. But Lara Mia is instead in one of the oldest communities of Davao City. Owned by 2 sisters Lara and Marie who both studied in Europe, Lara Mia offers an ecclectic menu ranging from Italian cuisine to French pastries to Filipino traditional favorites. We sampled the gelato, we also sampled their 4 cheese pizza and their prosciutto and arugula pizza as well as their cappuccno. All, without exception, we're excellent. Even the chocolate fudge that was based on a recipe that was passed down by their great grandmother was excellent. There was a constant flow of people at the Bistro but service never suffered. The bistro's decor was also well done. There simply wasn't anything to criticize.

March 2023 — It was a mistake on our part not to ask for their bestsellers, because we unfortunately did not enjoy our meal even though we finished everything. We arrived famished, having skipped both breakfast and lunch, which made the experience even more disappointing. Our order included the Beef Salpicao, Chicken Marsala, Chorizo and Gambas Pasta, Amore Pizza, and both Ube and French Vanilla milkshakes. So, what went wrong? The Beef Salpicao was quite tough and not tender at all. The Chicken Marsala felt undercooked, which was concerning. The Chorizo and Gambas Pasta was dry, and the chorizo was a letdown. Instead of the expected slices, it contained tasteless ground pork mixed with "hard bits" which I couldn't tell if they were bones or tendons, but it was unpleasant. The Amore Pizza meat and cheese were very sparse and poorly distributed. Instead of being spread evenly, the toppings were weirdly stacked on top of each other. Despite the lackluster meal, I'm still open to returning at a different time. I'll definitely skip the mains and try their famous gelato next time instead.
Still feeling the food coma but loved every single dish! Good thing you can opt for cashless payment option e.g., credit card/gcash.

The place is vibrant and very spacious. I like the pasta I ate and the foods looks delicious. This restaurant is good enough to dine and not much expensive. Good enough for families and solos. I recommend to dine for your experience.

Tucked in a quiet neighborhood, Lara Mia Cafe is such a hidden gem! 🌿✨ Who would've thought there's a charming garden cafe right in the middle of the city? Tried their Aglio Olio E Peperoncino—looks simple but WOW, the quality ingredients really shine! 🍝💛 My colleague had the truffle pasta and paired it with their Signature Hot Chocolate, which was rich and indulgent 🍫🤍 The biggest surprise? Their Cookie Butter gelato 🥹✨️ —affordable, generously served, and the perfect sweet ending to a night of chika! 🍨🫶
Delightful Tuscan style resturant with nice garden area outside seating. Food is excellent. Classic Italian style food with nominal Filipino localization. An all together delightful experience.

Great yummy food, affordable price! ❤💕 Nice ambiance and attentive servers. The osso buco and truffle cream pasta are a must-try! :) Lots of dessert to choose from in the cafe front. Outdoor seating available. …

Great for group lunch or dinner! Also for solo food trips 💯
