The dough is what make the pizza and this one of the best that I have eaten. Chewy but soft, just right charred smoked taste and just right savorly. The different combi toppings. Love the Quattro Formaggi, Marheta Caprese, Proscuitto and Arugula. Also love the Vongole and Lasagna. Plus the entrees, so rich in flavor. The meats are tendered just enough. So far, all the items already tried are all good, including their gelatos. The best!!!

Just gonna do my review in the following criteria for reference. FOOD: The food was overall a delight for us. We ordered their cold cuts and for the price, the components of the board blended well together. For the pasta, the puttanesca was good but it would've felt more complete if there's a slice or 2 of bread (I think they call this scarpetta?). But for the beef salpicao, I tried a slice of it and it was so tender, I said I wanted to go back just for it. It's much more tender than any beef salpicao I have ever tried before. Not sure why other reviewers said it's not tender. Maybe we got lucky with our batch of beef or they just have a really high standard for beef salpicao tenderness, but it was good for me. SERVICE: They catered us well. I really have no complaints for their service. The food came relatively fast. We waited for less than 30 minutes and that was lunchtime on a Sunday. This would probably vary on a different day and time, and would also depend on the number of orders. We had 2 mains, 1 appetizer, and 2 drinks. PLACE: We chose to dine outside because we wanted to be surrounded by greenery. It was nice and relaxing. It also wasn't hot at the time we dined. Otherwise, we would've stayed inside which would equally be a good experience since it's also cozy there. A suggestion would be to upgrade the tables and chairs outside. It would add more to a rustic sort of experience and elevate the atmosphere to the same level their foods have.

It took almost an hour to get a pizza because they served mine to the wrong table and only realised it when i inquired about it after 45min had passed. Then, once i paid my bill, the waiter didn't bring change and receipt, and i again had to inquire about it 20min later to see it coming. You can find a better place and better pizzas in Davao.

Such a nice place! I visited on a Monday, so it was cozy and quaint. And the best part... Their food was delish!

A place like this should elevate Davaoenos' dining experience except that the food is served bare bones - no bread, no butter and service leaves long gaps in between so that some diners are through with their dish while others are still waiting for theirs. Pastas and pizzas — delicious. Entrees are fairly savory as well. I usually just call for pick up. The service has really improved since they opened years ago. Interesting selection on the gelatos but, to my taste, a tad too sweet. Food and service was very good. We had The Elvis gelato peanut butter & jelly flavor.

food is great! we love the pizza and pasta. parking space can accommodate only around 5-6 vehicles so you may find yourself parking from a distance when the place is full.

Place is cozy. Food I would say is pretty expensive for its taste. Honestly most of the dish were kinda bland except for the dessert. They close at 9pm but last order is at 8pm. Our team had dinner here. Food and service was great. We ordered pizzas, salad, pasta, french onion soup, and others. I forgot the name of the main dish I ordered. Photo was taken using my colleagues phone so I won't be able to share any.
Pasta - aglio olio and truffle cream are soooooooooo good!!! --- hats off to the chef!!! Service - just "okay".. nothing memorable from the customer service
Great food. Great ambiance (especially their garden area). Friendly staff.
Great coffee prep selection! Oh and don't miss on trying their ube haleya!

It's a very good Italian pizza place. It's just that they don't offer wifi service anymore and the servings have tremendously changed overtime. Cozy place, though, because it's small and neat. Good place to dine with friends.

The salad is delightfully sweet with a hint of berries. Pizza was oven cooked as burn mark crisps bring it aroma, though the dough looks pre-made from the consistency of the slice thickness. Beef Salpicao was served late and this was a bit disappointing, quite dry then bathed in special soy sauce and fried garlic. T'was expecting more.
What a gem of a place. I will be back for sure!
An aswome restaurant with great food and delightful atmosphere 👌

Was in the place 3/10/24. After 30 minutes of waiting, was told that a dish ordered was not listed by the waiter and hence not prepared. Other dishes were also of small serving and not worth the price

Went here to catch up with some friends that I haven't seen in a long time. We ate here for lunch but ended up staying nearly 5 hours because we got immersed in our conversation. The staff was pretty accommodating and they never pressured us to leave even though we really didn't order anything else from the menu. Kami nalang yung nahiya kasi nag overstay na kami ng grabe and there were other customers waiting for a table. The food was good. The waiter was very helpful in helping us decide and was very patient. We ended up trying the Truffle Pasta (although it was a bit too salty for me, but still good) and had a few of their frappes and cheesecakes. The ambience was very warm and welcoming and they had clean facilities. We wanted to try their famous chocolate fudge but unfortunately they were out of stock so hopefully when we come back we can try some. Highly recommended!

Not the best customer service. We decided to leave since they forgot the pizza, but they compensated us with gelato. Sadly, we won't be recommending this place to our friends. Staff should work on smiling and greeting their customers.

They have the most reasonable price for a fancy meal. I love their salads and dishes. They also make wonderful halaya ube. You don't need to look for expensive places to find a fancy meal. Lara Mia is the best!

Their prices are worth every bite! This cozy, little café is the place to be if one is looking for a quick, hunger-satisfying food. Have tried their Three Cheese Panini, Half Roast Chicken, Caesar Salad, Callos, Osso Buco (a bit oily for me but tastes fine), Someone to Lava cake, and Creme Brulee Cheesecake..and all of these a must-try! I'm not a fan of parmesan cheese but I LOVE the caesar salad the best! :) Keep up the good work, chefs!

Had been here twice - 1st with family and 2nd time with good friends. This is a pretty new cafe/bistro in Juna Subd which is not too far from our place, about 15 minutes drive away. You wouldn't miss this yellow bldg/ structure with beautifully landscaped lawn infront and of course, their ubiquitous signage where I made that "blogger pose!" I guess this was an old, ancestral house turned to a quaint, homey resto. Wood tables & chairs, pastel-colored decors and sliding doors dominate the interiors. The curiosity in me also explored the back of the resto - vines, trees, black wrought-iron chairs and yes, would you believe -a yellow bike! There's also a side dining portion which is open and good for groups or families. Get that feeling like you're just dining in your lanai? That's it! This place is so IG-worrthy but more than that, food is yummy & very tasteful. The pizza ( 4-cheese pizza) and pasta ( truffle pasta) we tried are so good and filling. There are rice meals, too, which we can try next time. However, it is worthy to mention that the food is quite pricey and good for sharing for people whose appetite is not that big. Otherwise, you have to have that whole meal/dish to yourself. Next time, we will try to have a cup of coffee to go with their cakes, too. My TIP: Don't ever skip the desserts! My husband loves the choco molten lava! Before I forget, guess what was playing while we were eating - Mario Lanza's "opera-ish music" as per my hubby who knew him so well ( sorry millennials if you do not know him, just Google it, hehe...). This kind of music gives this place a different vibe - on a Sunday lunch at that. 😂😆 All in all, worth a visit and maybe just try to be early on weekends as place gets to be pretty full. Definitely we will be back - two-thumbs up!l

The place can get full fast. Best to call ahead to reserve a table or two. Hopefully, they don't forget to charge their phone's batteries. Food is good. We ordered pasta and beef salpicao. Pasta was al dente but the portion is not for sharing. Beef salpicao was spot on as well. Tenderloin tips were soft and chewy and the garlic bits on top of it all were a good addition.
Good pizza, but I got food poisoned with a carrot cake. Bad experience.

My first time here and will be my last time. We were dining for about 30 minutes only when a group of guests arrived and the lady server came to our table to place the RESERVED sign. After that she started clearing away the plates when we were not even done eating yet. We felt offended.

Good food. Affordable. Just keep in mind they dont have that many selections compared to other bistros (main entrèe only has like 8 selections plus pasta and pizza with around 8 each also). Seating is also a bit of concern as it can only seat at most around 30 i think

Cozy and good food, this is how I experience this restaurant. Nice place under the trees in their garden, good people and accommodating and of course who can resist their good food! Take a shot in their coffee after your meal and of course their gelato ice cream!
Their food is so good! Staffs are kind and accommodating. They just have toimprove thier service more but overall, I am satisfied 🙂❤ a go-to-place for me and perfect place to unwind ❤ …
Their carbonara is legit. It's made out of yolks, not cream. The other types pasta are very tasty as well. The restaurant has a relaxing ambience too.
The food here was great, especially their pizzas and pastas. Beef Salpicao was too salty for my taste. The place is nice and beautiful though.
Layout of the restaurant is a bit weird, but it is still splendidly designed. Outstanding food with pro-active servers. Their nero di seppia pasta and pizzas are awesome.

Great Late-Night Spot with a Cozy Vibe If you're looking for a place to grab a drink after the usual cafe hours, Lately Coffee is a solid option. Here is a breakdown of our experience: The Atmosphere: The cafe itself is a bit small, but they've made it very cozy. I really liked the seating options - they have a front area if you want to watch the world go by, and a nice al fresco back patio if you prefer a more private, outdoor dining feel. The Menu: We tried the Hojicha V2, and it was a decent cup. Definitely hit the spot if you're craving that roasted tea flavor. We also paired it with some of their cookies, though honestly, they were just average in taste. Good for a quick snack, but not necessarily a standout. The Hours: One of the best things about this place is that they close late at night. It's super convenient to have a go-to spot for late-hour caffeine or a place to wind down when everywhere else is locked up. The Service: This is where things could improve. The staff were just okay; they seemed a bit too comfortable in the space, to the point where they were distracted and forgot to attend to us properly. A little more focus on customer service would go a long way. Overall, it's a nice, chill spot for a late-night hang, especially if you snag a seat in the back patio! 🌙☕

I was glad this place was recommended to me. I was looking for good coffee with a quiet ambiance that wasn't too far from the Ateneo de Davao campus, and Lately Coffee delivered exactly that. Finding it was a bit of an adventure, though. The entrance is just a single door along the sidewalk with a small sign that's easy to miss. Behind it is a staircase leading to a beautifully designed space with warm lighting, minimalist décor, and a charming speakeasy vibe. The coffee was excellent, and the peaceful atmosphere made it an ideal place to slow down and enjoy a cup. My only minor disappointment was that the coffee was served in a take-away paper cup instead of a ceramic mug or glass, which would have made the experience feel even more special. Still, that's a small detail. I'd gladly return to explore more of their coffee offerings and try the other cookies on their menu.

Manu is a new cafe in Artiaga Street, and it's quite easy to miss because there isn't a big sign outside yet. The space itself is nice. It's modern, aesthetic, well-lit, and clean. Their coffee and matcha were good, and they offer oat milk as a substitute. They also have a small selection of finger food and pasta. I also like that they open early at 7 AM and close late at 10 PM. They don't have wifi but there are plenty of sockets around the cafe if you need to charge your devices. One downside during my visit was that there were a few flies inside the cafe. I mentioned it to the staff and they brought out a candle. It would've made the experience much better if there weren't any flies, because the place really has a lot of potential. They currently accept cash and QR payments only, and they don't have a sales invoice. Parking was a bit confusing at first. I thought it was street parking only, but apparently there's a parking lot beside the cafe. Some signage for that would help. The staff were able to assist when needed, though a bit more warmth in service would make the experience even nicer. Overall, it's a promising cafe with good drinks and a nice atmosphere. Overall, a great go-to place for coffee, work, or casual catch-ups. Would definitely come back!

Great coffee and ambience was very cozy and welcoming. We tried the signature Coco Oat. Tried the sea salt latte and Matcha as well. Everyone was nice and welcoming. Pasta serving size was also very substantial
Great interior & LOVE THE SEASALT HOJICHA. I ordered a caesar salad. It kinda disappointed me bcs it was too salty and the chicken is too small.
I don't usually finish my pasta but I was able to finish their chicken alfredo 🫶🏼 and their hojicha is a must try

Good food, Good coffee, Good service, nice ambiance. Went there around 7:30pm and it was full house. there may be slight delay of my order but it was understandable since it was peak hours and worth to wait. I will surely go back and invite some friends.

Manu Coffee Davao has quickly become one of my favorite spots in the city and I've only been twice! The ambience is cozy and well thought out, the kind of place you actually want to linger in. Their food is genuinely good too, the carbonara, bolognese, and salad all hit. I love their matcha oat, and of course, the coffee delivers. The staff are warm and organized, which really ties the whole experience together. Super quick serving too. Another thing I liked is that even tho the place is puno ng tao you wont even feel the noise. If you're in Davao, this one's worth the visit. Highly recommend! ☕✨

This is a great place to get coffee downtown. With its well-designed interior, it is a nice spot to sit down and enjoy your food and drinks. However, the staff weren't very hospitable, which negatively affected our overall experience.
Great atmosphere .Nice food. Spacious. Chicken alfredo pasta was super nice!! Don't forget their manu signature espresso & burnt caramel .

Cons: Tasted better citrus + espresso coffee from other local coffee shops. Maliit ang place so if peak hours medjo maingay. If you're planning to go solo better choose a table na good for 1 cuz chances are the staff will ask you to share the table to accommodate their other patrons. Para di ka na din ma disturbo. Pros: Marami socket. Malaki serving ng food (in case of their club house sandwich). May dedicated parking space. Yun lang ata.
Good vibe, nice coffee, new togo coffee shop

Visited MANU Coffee in Davao. I like how the cafe has a modern look and a curated menu. The coffee and food were good, the prices are reasonable, and the place has a chill atmosphere. I'd definitely come back.
matcha so good it cures hangovers

I stopped by for breakfast and had the pasta, tapa, and a matcha drink. I came early, so the café was quiet and peaceful, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The food was delicious, especially the tapa, and the matcha was smooth and flavorful without being overly sweet. The atmosphere was cozy and perfect for a relaxing morning. The prices are a bit on the higher side, but the quality of the food, drinks, and overall xperience made it worth it. The only thing I think could make the experience even better is having Wi-Fi available for customers. It would be a great addition, especially for those who want to work, study, or spend a little more time at the café. Overall, I'd definitely come back for another quiet breakfast.

5 stars for MANU Coffee. The Orange Espresso alone is worth coming back for. It's so good, really refreshing but still has that strong coffee taste. I didn't expect it to work but it does. Tried their pasta too and it didn't disappoint. Solid food and great drinks overall.

Order takes too long in this coffee shop. When my order finally arrived after over 30 minutes, it was not even what I ordered. The server didn't even apologize. Even the desserts they served us are late. The coffee shop looks decent but the service is really bad. I'm not going back here.
Interiors are nice 10/10 - a modern contemporary approach. Ordered matcha latte,spanish latte, and their pastas. Sarap nung pasta! Good for its price! Pwede sa students, madaming table and sockets.

I ordered an iced americano cost 150 pesos and gave me an over extracted coffee which was unpleasant smokey and burnt taste waited for the ice to melt but the taste was still burnt :(. Food is good but Hproper beans isnt burnt. Can't justify 150 pesos burnt.
Small Home Cafe Space, currently they only have waffles available, bet the biscoff latte and caramel latte

Ordered a customized ketogenic dirty matcha from a top-rated matcha spot here in Calinan, and it did not disappoint. Rich matcha flavor with a smooth coffee kick, plus great service. They really paid attention to what I asked for. Highly recommended! 🍵👌🏻

MATCHA YUMMYYYY!!! 😋 A very cute matcha slow bar/ shop 💚 Perfect for people who wants to do a quick stop, pick ups and take outs! I love the Matcha cheesecake, the sourness and creaminess of the cream cheese compliments the earthy flavor of the matcha. I personally dont like too sweet drinks so this was perfect for me!! Its also affordable!! Such a good deal, you get delicious matcha latte. You can opt to have ceremonial grade matcha and sub to oat milk/ non dairy 🙂 ↕️ Other drinks weve tried: Tiger Brown Matcha and Matcha Crimson Berry (Strawberry matcha)

Excellent service. Their matcha is really good, not too sweet, but if you like your drink sweet, you can ask for more sweetness I guess and knowing the price of their drinks are really budget friendly or we can say cheap since the target market are those people around their area. We were there on their first opening after renovation of their store and the place is nice and warm for customers while waiting for their orders. I highly recommend.✨
The matcha here is deep and earthy, not overly sweet that masks its true flavor. They also have some interesting matcha drink combinations that are worth trying.
Ceremonial Matcha was good!☺️ Strawberry bloom milkshake was also good!☺️ It was affordable and we recommend it!

All-time favorite tambayan. Very friendly staff! You can visit here and purchase affordable drinks and merienda. I love the atmosphere as well. We visit Matwels Coffee Station when everything feels heavy or if we have something we need to talk about.

The customer service was terrible—it took half an hour just for the cashier to take my order, and nearly an hour to get my drinks. The drinks' taste was reasonable for the price, but there are other places that offer better quality and much better service.
The foods and drinks are SO GOOD, and I'll try every single thing some time. Also I go back in there every now and then to order foods and drinks, and their customer service is good.❤️❤️❤️

You just lost a regular customer, 3rd time it happened that the food was delivered 1hr+, no advice, no chat, I'm aware that the delivery will be late. I'll reply when I follow up on the order. Please don't be late next time. Thank you!

Okay na sana we used to be their regular customer, but they always disappoint us especially in terms of customer service. I love their ceasar salad, i think i might just go here just to try it again! I also had the chance to try their experimental drink which they called their "Cacao Brew" and my feedback for it is that its good for people who dont like sweet drinks but its also not entirely bitter because it has this hint of sweetness to it, but personally, i like mine a tad bit sweeter! All in all, great place and i highly recommend!

The rice meal has decent amount of portion for its price. The appetizer, gambas, is a must try if you really like spicy food. The service is very good, they have cute employees too. The atmosphere is cozy and the place is well-lit. To add their place and food are aesthetically pleasing.

Closing Time: 2am Open Everyday A newly-opened coffee shop themed with the recent album of Taylor Swift. Its name does not disappoint as they close late and they play songs the artist has written and produced. Had their incredible hearty salad with scrumptious greens, with slices of chicken. Totally worth it for an additional P50. Recommended for Swifties and Students (even workers) alike. 🕛 Best when visited at night ❤️

Food portion is enough to fill your hunger. It's not entirely unique. Flavors may have been encountered with other restaurants but golden silverware and large serving plates are enticing. Coffee-based beverages are not sweet, so, take note.

The best food and drinks in DAVAO CITY. And I am not even exaggerating. All food and drinks is a must order in this cafe. The place is also very relaxing and calming. They don't pay influencers to be famous or hyped up. But you just have to try for yourself to know what I am talking about. Q

They have the best Ceasar salad with seared chicken. Try their Beef Kare kare and Breaded Chicken terriyaki . The Pastas are also a must try. Lastly do not forget to try thwir Caramel Machiatto its simply delish. Ambiance is divine and the staff are well trained. Kudos to the management❤️
They are on soft opening as of this writing :) tiny café with lots of wall sockets to use for your device + wifi. The food was just okay but the crew are already doing a great job!
Nice ambience and table has outlet, good for studying or work
The place is not too spacious but have a really beautiful interior. The food is legit delicious specially the cheesecake and the coffee. I highly recommend this café.
Love the ambience. Ate here cos Roxas Night Market is still closed so I had to look for a place to eat. Then I found this! Food is good and portions served are just enough.

The place is cozy. Food is mediocre. When we ordered, the shake and take away food was served first rather than the food that has to be eaten there. Also, there was a customer lying on one of the benches near to where we are eating. with the feet facing our way. So unhygienic. Not worth the Php700 at all.

Just saw a vid on tiktok and decided to try it with a friend. Went there around 9pm ata and it was during weekdays so we didn't have any idea that it was such a pack considering it was behind ADDU. So lots of students mostly law students I guess because we can hear them studying and discussing about cases. And since we had no idea that it was students people hanging around there we just stayed and ate tapos silent chicka because we didn't want to disturb them, tho there were chairs outside because it was too noisy that night so we decided to sit inside with aircon. We ordered their rice bowl ata to and it was great. We didn't even take pictures because both of my friends were too awkward. Their coffees also looked like I had latte then my friend ordered a strawberry drink and it was super delicious. I also wanna add their biscoff cookie super delicious too.
This is the cafe I keep coming back to because their food and drinks are delicious, plus the place is very cozy. They even have Biscoff cheesecake 😍

This is my current favorite cafe in our area. They are open until 2AM and 90% of what they play is Taylor Swift songs. It's a bit cramped inside, but the variety of chairs you can sit on inside, and outside makes it seem like there will be a place for you. The ambiance is nice, the place is well-lit, they have a nice one person cr at the back of the cafe. There was no wifi when I visited, but that's because they're still fixing it. The potato wedges I ordered here were delicious, and their Spanish latte was super duper strong, super perfect for an all-nighter HAHAHA. Oh yeah, for me, this cafe has a great view, situated in front of Ateneo Law School, you can see cars and people passing by on Jacinto Street. It's not distracting because it's far away. All in all, I'll definitely be back for a good all nighter 👍👍👍

One of the only air conditioned cafes in the area. The prices are good and the quality for the price is great. Area is small (around 3 tables and 12-14 seats total maybe) but it's quiet. No music or jazz playing so if you want to focus it's a good place. Would come back again

Visited Mine Cafe recently and tried their Iced Americano and Tiramisu Bar. The Americano was smooth and refreshing, easy to drink and well-balanced. The Tiramisu Bar, however, leans more on a brownie texture rather than the usual soft, creamy tiramisu—still enjoyable, but something to note if you're expecting the classic version. The space is decent and can comfortably accommodate around 3–4 small groups, making it a nice spot for intimate hangouts. That said, the air conditioning could be improved as it wasn't as cool as expected, and you can hear quite a bit of noise from passing cars and motorcycles outside, which slightly affects the overall ambiance. Service was good—staff were friendly and accommodating. Overall, it's still a nice café to visit, especially for a quick coffee break, but there's a bit of room for improvement in comfort and ambiance.

Mori & Mill has a cozy and elegant atmosphere that's perfect for relaxing with friends or family. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, while the drinks were equally enjoyable. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. Overall, a wonderful dining experience, and I'd definitely come back to try more of the menu. Highly recommended!

"If you're looking for good food + good feels, Mori and Mill delivers. Everything we ordered was delicious, service was quick and friendly, and the place just has that 'stay a little longer' energy. 5 stars!" ✨

I visited this cafe when it has just opened in Davao and based on my experience, the whole thing would have been nicer if there is a better parking space and the staff would have been more attentive. It was new and it was nice but it really does not give you a reason to keep coming back since the food we ordered did not really leave a mark. The owners seem pretty nice and the staff they have really tried to be more attentive but maybe it is just the busyness of the place that made it seem that they cannot accommodate us properly.

Don't get scammed by the advertisement of this restaurant you'll definitely get disappointed. Aesthetics of the restaurant is the total opposite of service and food. We dined last night. We have lots of left over food, we didn't opted to take it home since the food was undercooked. Service is very poor and toilet room is disgustingly untidy. We definitely regret bringing our Non Davao friends here. Experience was embarassing. I almost forgot, their FB page sends you a link to their website to book a reservation. Upon arrival on the resto, staff says they didn't get our reservation.

I had high expectations for Mori & Mill, but unfortunately it didn't live up to them. The food was just so-so, especially considering the price point—I expected much better quality and flavors. The biggest disappointment was the ube gelato. It seemed to contain an excessive amount of food coloring, and even several days later, my lips are still stained purple. I hope they can improve both the food quality and the ingredients they use.
While the staff was incredibly accommodating, the overall experience (food espcially) felt overpriced and a bit overhyped

A True Taste of Manila Quality! The food here is absolutely magnificent...honestly, nothing like I've ever tasted before. If you've been searching for that high-caliber, vibrant dining experience you usually only find in Manila's top food spots, Mori and Mill is exactly where you need to be. Beyond the incredible menu, the vibe and atmosphere are unmatched. It's the perfect all-rounder spot whether you're bringing family, catching up with friends, or hosting colleagues. It genuinely feels like a place where you can pause, take a breath, and just slow down to enjoy a spectacular meal with the people who matter most. Highly, highly recommended!
one of the best salmons ive tasted here in davao!!! also their dubai chewy had chocolate mousse in it so it also had a unique flavor that everyone cant miss out on 💯💯
The place was packed because it's newly opened. The food was decent, but I found it a bit pricey for the amount of food served. Overall, it was okay.

It wasn't good, it's ordinary and overpriced. Servers are all over the place and very slow. It is very inconvenient to order in an iPad considering they have service charge, in the end the customer do all the service. Biggest ick the bathroom, I cant even. Just a one hit wonder i won't recommend.
First of all, I'd leave 0 stars but it's not possible so here's a 1. Beef noodle soup was so salty I turned into a raisin. Mori and mill? More like less and not a good meal.
Approachable staff, good experience, very inviting and welcoming, very accommodating. Will go back again with my mom.
Good coffee and relaxing interiors, definitely would come back for another cup.
Food cold, had to ask 3 times just to get some water. Like bruh...

I really wanted to enjoy my dining experience here because the restaurant has a nice ambiance and the food is on the pricier side, so I expected good service. Unfortunately, our visit was disappointing due to several mistakes. First, I was served the wrong pasta. I had already been given my utensils and was about to take my first bite when one of the waiters approached me and informed me that the pasta served was not actually the one I had ordered. I'm glad they caught the mistake before I ate it, but it was still an avoidable error. Second, we were given the wrong bill. Our total was just a little over ₱2,000, but the first bill presented to us was around ₱3,500. Had I not checked the receipt carefully, I could have ended up paying for someone else's order. This was the most concerning part of the experience. Lastly, there was inconsistent information regarding their promotion. Upon entering, one staff member informed us that customers who spent ₱2,000 would receive a free promotional cup. Since our bill exceeded that amount, I asked to claim it after our meal. However, another staff member told me that the minimum spend was actually ₱2,500. It was disappointing to receive conflicting information from the staff. I understand that mistakes happen, but experiencing three separate issues in one visit made it difficult to overlook. For a restaurant with premium pricing, I expected better accuracy, communication, and overall service. I hope this feedback helps the team improve, because the restaurant has potential, but our experience today fell short of expectations.

Came in to order some matchas and other snacks. For my credentials, I've been to almost every major matcha cafes in town and I frequently make my own matchas at home for the past 3 years. Their matcha was disappointing to say the least. Both the matcha cloud and matcha latte were watery, pale-looking, and flavorless with very little depth. The matcha cloud in particular had a bad aftertaste from their choice of coconut water. The gelatos were also melted even while still being stored in the chiller display. For the price they are charging, you can absolutely take your money elsewhere. Don't be fooled by some of the friends and relatives leaving 5 star reviews on here to try and mask the low ratings on this place :)
Experience was decent! I suggest making reservations during lunch hours due to high demand 😵 💫 it was so cramped and seating was tight, with us nearly 10 inches from other customers.

Not worth the price. If you're a vlogger, yes the place is very nice. But if you're there to enjoy food, it's a big no How simple it is to make a carbonara and yet they found a way to ruin it. Egg tart too sweet. Side dish french fries is street vendor level fries.
The matcha's good best in davao 10/10

We ordered the truffle pasta, but it was quite bland and we could barely taste the truffle. The matcha had a strange blue layer on top that had already hardened when it was served. It made the drink difficult to stir and sip, and it also affected the taste. The shawarma nachos were not crunchy at all. They would have been much better if the chips had been fried or served fresh and crisp. Overall, there wasn't anything particularly memorable about the dish. The breaded pork was flavorful, but it came with too little sauce—just enough for a bite or two—leaving the rest of the dish dry. The "Dubai" kataifi was unfortunately very soggy instead of light and crispy, which was disappointing given the texture you'd expect from kataifi. Despite these issues, the café itself is very aesthetic though the place is a bit cramped. The coffee was also good, which helped make the overall experience better. With some improvements to the food, this place has a lot of potential. Food was definitely on the pricey side.

We ate here for my birthday lunch! The food was super good (especially the bahn mi quesadilla!). The service was good as well, the waiters are attentive and polite.

i ate lunch here with family friends a couple days ago and it wasn't really as good as i thought it would be for several reasons. food: it's a hit or miss for the meals and some dishes are a bit pricey for the serving size. i can't speak for the pastries and coffee since i didn't try them. • baked farfalle noodles were not cooked enough so it was hard. it's serving size was also small compared to other pasta dishes and their prices. baked farfalle was only ₱569 but the plate was so small compared to the prawn linguini which was bigger and for ₱559. • prawn linguini was a bit too salty. • beef shawarma vegetable was dry and had very little beef. • breakfast pork char siu genuinely looks and tastes like tocino so i don't think ₱485 was worth it. service: the waiters seemed too busy to accommodate us properly. • a waiter just handed us the tablets but they didn't even demonstrate how to navigate and order using the tablet. • we didn't have enough utensils on our table. • we had to ask for the water AND the glass. atmosphere: parking is awful. Food was not good, just average, I guess. Matcha was very disappointing, felt like 80% ice and water and just a shot of the actual drink - very watered down. Dessert was alright. I think they may have put too much resource into that gimmick rather the quality of the food. Will probably not go back here again nor recommend to friends, mostly because of the food. Ordered the Hummus, the sausage appetizer, the shawarma bowl, cold matcha drink, a tart, and the dara.

we wanted to try a new coffee place in davao and Muni Muni didn't disappoint! i ordered a sea salt latte and it was the best i've had in the city, i really recommend!!✨

Olo is one of those places that instantly puts you in a good mood. From the moment you step in, everything just feels right—the calm atmosphere, the clean and thoughtfully designed space, and that comforting café energy that makes you want to slow down and stay a little longer. The coffee is beautifully made—smooth, well-balanced, and clearly crafted with care. Whether you're here to work, catch up with someone, or just enjoy a quiet moment for yourself. Definitely one of those cafés you'll want to keep coming back to. A gem in Davao City and a must-visit for coffee lovers 🤍☕

I would say the place is definitely sensitive to the time of day you visit. My wife and I went around 5 trying to get some pictures while the sun is setting but was about to rain so took minimal pictures. The biggest draw to olo is their courtyard/patio, which seems in need of a little care, definitely not holding to the pictures you see on Google maps, but I will try going again closer to when they open. Maybe after tables are freshly cleaned and the patio is tidied up there will be the 5 star atmosphere that is seen in the pictures. We got an iced Dirty matcha and hot Spanish latte, both of which were good. The service is friendly and fast in my experience. But the bottom line is olo charges premium prices and the bar is already very high for service and food/drink quality with cafes here so my 3 star is largely attributed to the state of the patio. That being said I am excited to come back to see if I can get some nicer photos at opening and update my review.

ordered their matcha latte, was supposed to get hojicha but sadly sold out huhu. surprisingly umami despite the price and really enjoyed the nutty notes of their matcha. place was in juna subdivision, so its takes a bit of effort to go to here. we were 5 people when we went around 2pm, and medyo mainit talaga sa seats nila in the back despite the trees :,)

Visited yesterday 2/9/26📆 Ordered an iced Spanish Latte, coffee was good☕️ Service was quick, since there were only a few people🤩 Best time to visit: 11AM-1PM (not too hot out) Price Range: ₱120-₱239 The ambiance had a lot of potential, but it was honestly ruined by one barista repeatedly stepping outside the bar to gossip with her 2 friends (seated beside me), which got a bit noisy. It felt awkward asking even basic questions since it seemed like I was interrupting their conversation, while the other barista was busy clearing tables in the back. Drinks were good overall 👍🏻
Good coffee. We ordered spanish latte and salted caramel bec it's there best sellers and it's great! The place is very cutesy. Check the photos to see.

I think it should be illegal to own a café this aesthetic and serve really, really yummy baris-coffee. they offer different kinds of drinks you can get them iced or hooooooot, plus pour-overs and even matcha. the cafe personally hikes the mountains of japan just to get 4 grams of matcha per day. each coffee bean is carefully analyzed and checked before being served. you should visit Olo because their coffee and barista never disappoints. they're incredibly passionate about coffee ask the barista where coffee originated, and they'll tell you it came from ethiopia and was discovered by goats

Olo Café has a small indoor space that's not ideal for big groups, but they make up for it with a charming alfresco area that has plenty of seating. I love how cozy and calm the overall vibe is, especially in the outdoor space — it's the perfect spot to relax and unwind. Their drinks are great too! I ordered the Matcha and their chocolate-based drink (forgot the exact name), and both were really satisfying. It's a lovely spot for a quiet coffee break, especially if you enjoy peaceful corners and nature-inspired spaces.

The coffee was smooth and satisfying, though it lacked a bit of complexity as maybe I just ordered the most common - spanish latte. Though I would like to try others from their menu. It was an excellent everyday brew! Also, the ambience is relaxing - making it laid back, quiet, you can either go alone or have coffee together with friends.
Great coffee, amazing staff and ambiance —a nice place to slow down. I'd recommend the coco dream and apple pie. Already thinking when I can go back🌞
Easy 5 star coffee shop in Davao. Well calibrated espressos, consistent as always.

lovely place, and their coffee had the perfect, balanced blend. barista was also kind to walk us through their selection of beverages. their indoor place is quite small, but there are a few more seats available in their zen backyard for guests who'd love to linger on a bit. it's a whole vibe. must visit. (cute art too!)

SOO GOOD!! The baristas are so kind and welcoming and they make the drinks with so much love and perfection!! They pull the shots so perfectly and very balanced!! Definitely one of my favs here in Davao!!

My fave neighborhood coffee shop. If I need a caffeine boost, olo. If I want to socialize, olo. They got something environment most coffee shop lacks, it's hard to explain so I suggest you give olo a visit. Espresso Tonic is my go to drink. Try their burger if it's on the menu.
Really good coffee. Friendly baristas. Go to coffee shop in Davao. Hopefully there would be more seats hehe

The location is within a subdivision which makes it pretty quite from the hassle and buzzle of the city of davao. The drinks tasted refreashing with a taste of brazil the bartista where friendly and gave recommendations for drinks and pastires. Definitely recommend if you want to removed you're self from city life for a moment at less!

This place feels like a tiny escape in a busy city. The food is made by the mom. So, it's a guarantee that you're easily a homemade meal. Also, the barista will go as far as to dance for you to make you feel right at home. 😅
Tried their cold whisk and it tastes really good, not overpowering, just the right balance. Place is also definitely a vibe, lots of great spots for cute photos! ❤️

The place was cool and nice with the chairs and tables perfectly placed inside and outside the shop. It was really the experience of sitting under the big mango tree that amused me because we rarely have coffee shops in the city that prioritized the comfort of customers over aesthetics, but this one did both. A really good place to catch-up and drink good coffee with friends. The baristas were very accommodating and the price of the drinks were student friendly. I highly recommend this place for coffee drinkers and nature lovers.
Unassuming space, delicious flavors, and charming nature seating. Excellent coffee paired with a well-crafted concept. Definitely a must-visit in Davao City.

I recently visited this coffee shop with my friends, and we were disappointed with how we were treated. We were told to leave because not all of us ordered something, even though we were just sitting together quietly and not causing any trouble. I understand that every business has its policies, but the staff could have handled the situation more politely. We just wanted to spend some time together and enjoy the place, but we ended up feeling unwelcome.
The space is small yet welcoming. It's a nice place to hang out, but seats are very limited. Short orders were not available during my visit.
Great-tasting coffee, cool beverages, and cheese roll. Good time to visit: 3pm onwards when back area isn't too warm.

Olo is such a cozy and welcoming coffee spot! The drinks are always on point—smooth, flavorful, and carefully made. The vibe of the place is perfect whether you're catching up with friends, working on something, or just relaxing. The staff are really friendly and give great recommendations. Definitely one of the best coffee shops around!

This place is located inside a subdivision and if you're not familiar with the turns, you might end up getting lost. So, getting a Grab or riding a tricycle would be your best option. The day we got there, there were a few unavailable drinks 🥲 they also only have a considerable amount of snacks to eat together with the coffee. However, it didn't affect our good time here
Overall ambiance is nice, staff is great, and loved our spanish latte ❤️
Lovely quaint cafe. Coffee is good too. Can get hot outside and there might be mosquitoes. 😅 Nicer late afternoon or at night.

Olo Coffee and Concepts truly stands out as a hidden gem in Davao City, offering a perfect blend of high-quality coffee and a wonderfully calming atmosphere. Tucked away in a quiet neighborhood, this cafe is the ideal spot to escape the city's hustle and bustle.
Despite the rainy weather during our visit, we still had a great time appreciating the drinks and the cafe's serene ambiance.
Good coffee, great interior design, I enjoyed the overall outdoor vibes 😁🫶🏻

Very disappointing experience. We went to this coffee shop as a group of four and ordered two drinks, but the cashier told us we weren't allowed to dine in unless everyone ordered something. The way she said it was extremely rude and unwelcoming. It's my first time encountering a coffee shop with this kind of attitude toward customers. Definitely not coming back and wouldn't recommend it to others.
Cute coffee bar. I like their coffee. I wish there were more seats at the back then. And so we just sat at the front.
Coffee was good. I wasn't able to try any pastries, too crowded to order inside. Would go again on less crowded time. Too hot to sit outside.
open daily from 11AM to 7PM !!

Ten months ago I was here at the very early hour. Just had a Spanish Latte… (Deleted the one picture I took at the garden)… Few pastry items were the only ones available in the morning. (Yeah and it was nearing lunch time)… The cashier was already chatting with one guy which maybe was the owner or even a regular customer. Seemed annoyed when I interrupted her upon ordering, asking questions. The meager menu and the MOODY ATTITUDE of the cashier was REPELLING. NOT WORTH REVISITING! I was out the door in no time…And for anyone who was treated better, GOOD FOR YOU!
the matcha was on the pricey side i expected it to taste at least above average but sadly it did not meet my expectations for its price.
Chill place, but a bit crowded. Drinks are okay, but honestly nothing to write home about. Not suitable for large groups, tbh
Nice vibe and staff are super friendly. Great coffee and food

It didn't feel welcoming. I felt like I was an intruder staying there earlier today. Was also stuck there cuz of the rain, couldn't leave sooner. I enjoyed the architecture, not the vibe created by the people that was there today. It didn't feel friendly at all.
place is nice but coffee was watered down. consider using a smaller glass for iced drinks
Great coffee, cool place and friendly service.
I had so much fun at olo! The people look so friendly there
very cute barista
10/10 coffee
Super Cozy! Cinnamon roll is so gooood.
Great place, tried the oolong latte 💯 …
No place like home, olo
Chill place and good coffee
AWESOME BARISTA AND COFFEE
Blissful and comfortable place to enjoy coffee ☕️
Place and food is great
Good Coffee
Coffee the best! Fresh from the mountains

The coconut coffee is TOO GOOD!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ love the vibe here esp the garden

olo. is a quaint space but it's the type of neighborhood cafe that takes its craft seriously. I ordered their cold whisk matcha and parmesan ensaymada. Both were great! Baristas were nice too to set up a side table for me inside the cafe. Vibes are cool too, perfect for unwinding or just enjoying your coffee/matcha. 💯🫶
very nice
Coffee and Food are so Bangers! My favs are Apple Pie and All Day Breakfast!!!!

I really like the ambiance and all. No wonder their drinks are always sold out. Especially the matcha drinks 😅🤩🤩. I will be back soon and I will make sure to taste one of their Matcha drinks. The place especially the one outside is really gives you peace of mind. Then the staff is soo kind.. 🤩🤩😍.. I also love the stickers 😍😍😍.. See you soon po🤗
The ambiance is super nice♥️

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: One of my favorite coffee shops in the city! I love how they are playful with their drinks and menu options, and how they are so great with making themes for their space. They are definitely one of the best dessert coffees in town. A must visit!!!

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: Yummy coffee and food! The ambiance was also great. They have different themes and open on certain dates so make sure to check their IG!

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: I found this coffee shop through a Facebook ad and decided to give it a try. So far, so good. I ordered their black lava Hawaiian sea salt-flavored coffee and coconut cream cheesecake, and both were really tasty. The flavors were unique and different from other cafes in the city. What makes this shop stand out is that it doesn't open daily. They announce their opening days on their Facebook page, which adds a bit of excitement to visiting. I really love the coffee and cake I had, and I will definitely come back to try more of their drinks and food.

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: One of the best creative cafes in Davao if you're looking for unique drinks and food. They usually have themed menu items every month, so every visit brings forth a new experience. They prepare their drinks manually, so during rush hours, your orders may take more time. If you're in a rush, I suggest coming back another time because their charm lies in the process and the vibe of just slowing down at their corner.

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: Friendly TIP: Keep your eyes peeled on their socials for the next operating hours. It just so happened that I noted their schedule last weekend. And I made sure to be there by 3 p.m. as the parking was just along the road. The Summertime Love and Korean Fried Chicken Sandwich were both filling. Love the place and what they did with the interior. The walls were high so upon entry it's like a whole different sanctuary secluded from the rest. Will surely be back!

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: This coffeeshop was recommended by Chef Jerico from Misa Dining and we have to say it was some good slow coffee. We got their Laguna Cheesecake & Their Coconut buttered Latte. It sounds heavy but everything was balanced and just the right amount of sweetness. We didn't have the chance to take photo of the food but trust us on this.

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: It's worth the price . When you'll order it will feel like you're making a mistake as it's too expensive but once the food and drinks arrive your perceptive will change . It's a bummer that they open just on weekends.

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: This coffeeshop was recommended by Chef Jerico from Misa Dining and we have to say it was some good slow coffee.

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: It was such a mesmerizing place. The ambiance, the vibe everything was awesome. I ordered Coconut Butter Latte which was by far the best coffee I've ever had in Davao City. And the Spinach Dip was also amazing. Definitely recommend you all to try it once. You'll definitely crave to go back again.

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: One of Davao's hidden gems! I was able to attend the last day of their Cinco de Mayo celebration. Im not a fan of matcha drinks but their matcha was the bomb! I highly recommend their matcha sea salt drink, sweet but you could still taste more bitterness. Their watermelon drink was very refreshing! And not to mention the fries 😍. A must try cafe!

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: All their dishes are amazing. It is worth trying! Gonna try it here again with my friends they better know this place. Lastly, I love the aroma of the coffee here.

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: All their food and drinks are a hit! My faves are the smelt sandwich and the summertime love ♥️

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: Fav coffee shop! Very cozy and their food is delicious, super worth it for its price! Must try guys!!

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: Their menu is so delicious! Recommended!!

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: The plating of the food is presentable. I LOVE THE AMBIANCE <3

place_name: One Corner Coffee Lifestyle and Beyond
review_text: Their desserts are just the right sweetness, not overpowering.

review_text: Had a great time hanging out with friends! We arrived around 9 PM and had the whole coffeeshop to ourselves, which made the vibe even better. The owner and staff were super friendly and accommodating, making us feel really welcome. The food was delicious — definitely something I'd come back for. Overall, we had such a blast and I'm already looking forward to our next visit!
Coziest coffee shop around! Had a clubhouse sandwich 10/10 A matcha latte and a machiatto 10/10 The owner is really sweet too~ Totally will come back with a book and spend my time here.
My go to place in Buhangin area. Great place to chill, work and simply have a nice coffee with friends and loved ones. They have wifi and homey ambiance!
The ambiance was nice and conducive to tasks that require focus. The staff were accommodating and nice. The coffee was just right. 10/10, would come back again.

The place is quite conducive for studying and doing other desktop work. Good music and internet connection. But one of the worst cafe americano I have tasted. It tasted very bland. It was as if it was extracted from a recycled ground beans. Come to think of it, the barista did not process the beans after ordering it. Very disappointing. Definitely won't order this one here.
Good food, greater coffee, cozy and chill ambiance at a reasonable price. 👍

Amazing!

Their place is so cozy and accessible.
I really enjoyed their pizza and matcha! Staffs are friendly and very accommodating. They also accept card payment which is very convenient.

Had one of the best experience last night. Their Strawberry Matcha is my fave! Ordered for a dine-in because I've been craving for it. Also ordered croissant and their chocolate chip cookies. There was a little delay but they go beyond and made up for it. Apologized and served the food to us, plus a discount. Sometimes the best customer service offered isn't making things perfectly and smoothly, but by making up if there are any mishaps happening. Kudos to the crew!

We passed by catalunan grande road and we saw this cafe and as a coffeecionado, we definitely approved their signatures! We were supposed to try their pizza but the cook assigned was not around that time. Will try our luck next time! But the coffees! Now we know where to grab coffee if we happen to pass on that road again. Definitely gonna try another blend.

Outlook is a delightful escape offering a cozy ambiance perfect for intimate dates or relaxing solo moments. The place has a welcoming charm that invites you to stay a while. One of Outlook's standout features is its customizable frozen yogurt bar. The freedom to choose your toppings without extra charge is a refreshing change. Their Neapolitan-style pizza is another highlight, with the open kitchen providing a fascinating glimpse into the culinary process. For beverage enthusiasts, I wholeheartedly recommend the cold-served Spanish Secret. It's a must-try! Families with kids will appreciate the spacious layout, which is ideal for little ones to burn off energy. Just keep an eye on them as the place is directly accessible from the highway, which is full of cars passing by. The frozen yogurt option also makes for a healthier treat for the kids. As night falls, Outlook transforms into an even more enchanting space. The outdoor tables are adorned with warm accent lights that mimic candlelight, creating a romantic and intimate atmosphere. Overall, Outlook is a versatile spot catering to various preferences. Whether you're seeking a quiet coffee chat, a family outing, or a casual dinner, this place has something to offer.

Good pizza, a bit salty but a nice crisp crust. A good atmosphere definitely cuter at night. Inside was full of bees, I'm not complaining, they weren't bothering anyone, but not sure if that's happening on the regular. Will still be back to try the coffee/pastry another time.
cat grande's hidden gem! we love the drinks here esp. matcha and hojicha. entire concept is so well thought out! their pizzas are always a hit! plus, i love that everything's pink, even the merch! 😄🩷

Yogurt, Drinks, & Great Pizza For Pizza orders they start taking orders at 1pm. So if you're going for the Pizza come by around Lunch or at a later time 😙 Yogurt toppings were limited but were delish anyway. I do hope for maybe more choices sa future 😫 Haven't tried their drinks yet though, will do next time. Water dispenser beside the entrance with paper cups. Indoor & Outdoor setting! Indoor space is small and has 3 tables. Feels rather cramped and only good for parties of 2 for each table. Even in the morning the outdoor view was superb. Great view, probably even more beautiful at night! (Will be back soon hopefully to experience the late night ambience)

If you want to dine here, the best time to do it is at night when the ambiance is at its finest. The atmosphere transforms with the evening lights, creating a cozy and inviting setting perfect for a memorable dining experience. The beverage selection is impressive, featuring unique options such as the White Rabbit Latte, which is a must-try for coffee enthusiasts. Additionally, the menu includes a variety of pizzas that are not only affordable but also packed with flavor, making them a great choice for any meal. For those residing in Catalunan Grande, this venue is an excellent choice for a change of scenery. If you're feeling bored at home and looking to enjoy a delightful meal in a pleasant environment, this is definitely the place to be.
Higher end coffee & matcha but the quality is there. Matcha is from Japan and the coffee is really good (spanish latte) Discovered their pizza recently, Php390 and they do not scrimp on cheese!!

Worth a visit! Things I liked: - parking available - open as early as 7am and closes at 12mn - yummy drinks (they use Good Cup coffee beans) - options: besides coffee, they have pizza and froyo as well - indoor and outdoor seating options
3rd day food is not available. Worse is they confirmed that food is available when we called but opon arrival at their place is isn't.

The café has a relaxing atmosphere, and the baristas are always kind and friendly. Great drinks, great service, and a cozy place to unwind. Definitely worth a visit! ✨😊

cozy atmosphere paired with friendly, attentive staff creates a welcoming environment. the establishment is pet-friendly, allowing customers to bring their furry companions. not only do they serve up delicious coffee and matcha, but they also offer a warmhearted pet named Coffee a.k.a "Coffee the Barkista," a cute dog that adds charm to the experience! 🥹🐶☕️

January 22, 2026. As this is Cabantian, we still trekked from Citygate. Thought we may splurge on the Blue Matcha but they didn't have it and the Mang Sticky Rice Latte. Will try to go back but it's Cabantian so yeah...

This coffee shop is my go-to spot whenever I need a little pick-me-up. The coffee is comforting, warm, and has a unique flavor that sets it apart from the rest. A cup of coffee here can be the little push you need to keep going. It's the kind of place that helps you recharge and slow down for a while.

when you have a real good coffee&matcha place near you.. to have em quick to get caffeine&matcha fix, palps is a place to go! only a good coffee drinker can say if a drink is good or nah. i dont fall for fancy coffee place but i always look for the quality drink. and this place has it! talk to the barista/owner when you get your drink 😉👍🏆

A quaint and quality coffee nook. Baristas are nice and easy to talk to. Pistachio Latte and Blue Matcha is a must-try. A bit far from downtown, but def worth traveling to. The cafe has board games and books, so whether you go alone or with friends, you will be in for a good time.

Love the atmosphere of this place! Been their customer for quite some time now~ the drinks and their desserts are so good and worth the price! And the owner is kind and accomodating as well~ thank you for existing! May your business strive more and be blessed more! 🤗✨

One of the best hidden coffee spots in Davao! I waited for my second visit before writing this to see if it was just tsamba, but they are really consistent. 1st and 2nd visit were both very smooth. Whenever I visit coffee shops, when I'm in awe of the Americano taste, I don't like it anymore. But here it's solid and smooth, you'll know it's very keen when you calibrate the espresso, no BS. The Vibe: Small slowbar setup that's very relaxing and aesthetic. Perfect spot to chill. Huge kudos to the owner, Ma'am Kiana! Super warm welcome and good luck. Top-tier customer service! Highly recommended 10/10 will keep coming back!
Their food is so delicious!! Even the spanish latte! Their carbonara is delicious!! The staff is friendly! ❤️🥹
The place is clean and easy to find. The design is modern and have good ambiance. My son loves the pizza and said that the chocolate drink is really good. I love their tea sets and the tea itself.

Though we understand that they do not allow outside food and we respect that. We were just sad that we were not able to eat the cake we brought to have a low-key celebration for a friend's birthday even though we ordered from their menu. I hope they will consider it soon.

Okay, so Paramount TP's pepperoni pizza? Seriously good. The crust was amazing, the cheese was all melty and gooey, and there was just the right amount of pepperoni. Definitely worth checking out! 😋 #ParamountTP #PizzaTime #DavaoFood #SoGood

Paramount Coffee Twinpalm has such a cozy and inviting atmosphere! The book-lined walls create a unique and charming ambiance, perfect for relaxing with a good book and a great cup of coffee. Highly recommend for a quiet escape. 📚☕️ #ParamountCoffee #Twinpalm #CoffeeShopVibes #BookLover.

Good food and coffee, good place. Not a lot of options sa menu. With parking area. Clean restrooms. Cash and gcash. Cards? Last time i remember they do not accept cards for payment. Flavors seems creamier and richer, more organic for me. Definitely love the atmosphere, lots of dining spaces, lots of parking too. Overall nice spot to stop by.
Went to get beans, unfortunately they did not a grinder available however the staff explained each variety excellently and offered personal recommendations.
Good food & ambiance! 🖤

Perfect chill ambiance. I would suggest more electric fans tho hehe

nice! bilis ng service. aesthetic is power

A good place to drink coffee with your friends or barkadas. A lot of available tables that you can stay and relax. you can also take nice and cute pictures for your social media account

The location of the coffee shop is so nice! Perfect for catch up with friends or date with your partner!! ♥️ The pizza is also delicious, but the fries is just the normal fries we can make on our own. They also make great coffees ☕️

Love it here. The place is so big its certainly nice for big gatherings. Its not crowded. A nice cafe that is mainly situated outdoors. Since there is no AC, it can be very hot. Besides this, it's a very nice place with a great atmosphere. There are many drink options and they're tasty!

It was my first time going to this place. The place was nice, neat and clean. The ambiance is perfect different gatherings. The place is safe and good place to chill out. The food is awesome. The French fries (chips) both sour cream and cheese flavour worth recommending, a must try.

A Delightful Coffee Escape at Pedal Coffee Shop! Pedal Coffee Shop is an absolute gem in the world of coffee, and I can't help but rave about my recent visit. From the moment I stepped inside, I knew I was in for a treat. The enchanting aroma of freshly brewed coffee, combined with the cozy and minimalist ambiance, instantly transported me to a tranquil corner of another country. Let's start with the star of the show—the Spanish Latte. Oh boy, it was divine! The blend of rich espresso, velvety milk, and the subtle sweetness of Spanish flavors created a symphony of taste that danced on my palate. It was the perfect balance, and I found myself savoring every sip, completely immersed in its decadence. If you're a latte lover like me, trust me, you won't find a better Spanish Latte anywhere else. But that's not all. The experience was elevated further when I paired my latte with the delightful mini bites oatmeal bar. The combination was simply magical. The oatmeal bar was moist, chewy, and packed with wholesome goodness. It provided a delectable contrast to the latte's creaminess, creating a harmonious duet of flavors. It was the kind of culinary pairing that made me appreciate the thought and attention to detail that goes into every item on their menu. Beyond the exceptional coffee and delectable bites, Pedal Coffee Shop offers a cozy haven for coffee enthusiasts. The minimalist decor, combined with warm lighting and comfortable seating, creates an atmosphere that feels like a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Whether you're seeking a quiet spot to work or a place to unwind with friends, Pedal Coffee Shop has got you covered. Moreover, the staff at Pedal Coffee Shop deserves applause for their friendly and attentive service. They genuinely care about their customers and go the extra mile to ensure everyone feels welcome and well taken care of. Their passion for coffee shines through in their knowledge and eagerness to recommend the perfect brew based on your preferences. In conclusion, Pedal Coffee Shop is a true treasure. It not only offers the best Spanish Latte I've ever had but also transports you to another world with its enchanting ambiance. The mini bites oatmeal bar is a delightful accompaniment that enhances the overall experience. Whether you're a coffee connoisseur or simply someone who appreciates a great cup of joe, Pedal Coffee Shop is a must-visit destination. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!

For me, it's the white chocolate matcha 🍵and white mocha latte☕️, while my buddy loves their refreshing fruit teas and white chocolate Matcha🍵. The café is cozy and welcoming, but what makes it truly special is the staff. They are consistently accommodating, and the manager always goes above and beyond. One time, we had a payment issue because of a network problem with the swipe machine and even their QR option couldn't process the payment. The manager kindly offered to let us send the payment to her GCash so she could hand us cash in return, since we didn't have any on hand that time after coming straight from the office. That simple act of kindness really moved me and my buddy it showed genuine care and hospitality. Since then, this branch has become our regular spot. Every visit feels more than just grabbing coffee☕️ 🍵it's about enjoying great drinks, reliable service, and the warmth of people who genuinely care. Thank you, Pick-Up Coffee - Oroderm Branch for making our coffee moments special.🫶🏻

Our go-to coffee spot and comfort place in town! The drinks are always so good and made perfectly every time. The staff are super friendly, welcoming, and accommodating, which makes the whole experience even better. The place has such a calm and cozy vibe — definitely a café we'll always keep coming back to. Highly recommended! ☕🤍
I love the baristas on duty always. They are very attentive and accommodating .

There's something special about this coffee shop the cozy atmosphere, the aroma of freshly brewed coffee, and the warmth it brings. But what makes it even better is the people behind it, serving every cup with passion and making every customer feel welcome. A place that truly turns simple coffee moments into unforgettable memories
We had a great experience dining in here. One of the best in town! Also a plus because the supervisor named Lorie was so accommodating. Kudos to this branch! 👏🏻

Great experience at PICKUP COFFEE! The staff were friendly and accommodating, and the coffee was smooth, flavorful, and freshly made. Definitely a go-to spot for a quick coffee fix. Highly recommended!

I'll be back!
