I have not tried their food yet. But I keep going back for White Peak. So good! It's not too sweet but it's so refreshing.

Dropped in here at Purge on a Saturday almost noon and several tables were full. We were greeted, led to a table and given menus. We ordered a Cookie Butter Hot Cocoa, Espresso Mule, Bacon and Egg Waffle and a Chicken Pesto and Cheese Waffle. The hot cocoa had subtle hints of butter and the cocoa was mild which was a great combination of neither overpowering the other. The espresso mule (espresso and ginger ale) was bold with the ginger ale only slightly noticeable. Both waffles were light and topped perfectly with their ingredients. The CR was clean and the place was full when we left. It's a little tight with the seating, but an overall good experience.

Good coffee and an even better waffle dessert. Whether you want savory or sweet, they have food items and dishes that go well with their extensive coffee menu. The "lava" variety is a must-try. As a bonus, this cafe has the friendliest staff. They do not mind taking your photos. They give excellent food recommendations. They greet you when you enter as if you are a regular. Restroom was clean and comfy.

Go to Purge Coffee if you are looking for a coffee shop that offers great coffee, tasty pasta, delicious waffles, friendly service, and a convenient location. Considering all of these factors, I'd rate this coffee shop as a solid 4.5 out of 5. It seems to meet most, if not all, of your expectations. However, keep in mind that personal experiences can vary, so it's always a good idea to try it out yourself if possible! The price is not that scary too!

Coffee has the power to change everything. I can feel that the owner truly loves coffee and has created an experience where customers can feel that passion too. I don't usually patronize coffee shops, but this café really hit the spot and made a heartfelt connection with me.

Spotted Purge Coffee Roaster on Google and decided to take a little detour—Oh boy, the Grab ride was SO worth it! 🚗💨 Craving something light, I got the Banana Walnut Waffle, expecting a single serving like in Manila… but WOW, the portion was so generous! 🧇🍌 Plus, the flavors were on point, especially with the ice cream on the side. 🤤 My officemate had a Spanish Latte and was seriously impressed—her exact words: "Oh wow, they really know how to make good quality coffee." ☕👌 She also enjoyed a generous serving of Apple Cinnamon 🍏✨ The best part? The throwback OG hits playing in the background—such a good vibe for chill convos, quality drinks, and great food. 🎶💛

Super friendly staff!!! 100/10 CUSTOMER SERVICE NO BIAS!!! Delicious food at an affordable price. Mum's spaghetti and their waffle selections are superb. Food are served in generous serving portions. My fave caffeine booze is the Spanish latte. I don't even drink coffee that much but this is an exception. Lami gyud, one of the best in Davao!

My sister-in-law is a frequent customer and always brings beans and bottled cold brew coffee home. I love the rich texture of their coffees. The snack menu is only a handful but they go well with their wonderful brews. The baristas are friendly and accommodating, and the location is clean, accessible, and inviting.

Second time in Davao and it was also my second time here. Still love the coffee and also the food. Service is awesome, barista is awesome and knowledgeable. Just not giving it a perfect 5 because I was hoping to see more selection of beans like before but they only have a few when I went.

It was my first time tasting such a wonderful latte! Very unique taste and it's incredibly delicious!!!! Also, the waffles are great! I really had a good time especially that their staffs are friendly..

The coffees served were exceptional; I tried both the Espresso Mule and a Pour-over, and both were outstanding. The Pour-over, in particular, stood out with its delicious flavor profile, and the tasting notes were spot on. The staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating, taking the time to explain the beans used for their coffee, which added to the overall enjoyment of the visit. Although the ambiance of the place feels a little dated, it contributes to its charm, creating a cozy atmosphere.

-great place for specialty coffee -Tried their own roasted coffee ethiopia. They brew in 1:13 ratio with bypass. It had strong body because of the lower ratio. -they also have kenyan, apo, and bukidnon beans -Their coffee machine is Sanremo -They sell variety of hot and cold drinks -i felt warmth and homey when drinking the nice cup of coffee -i recommend this coffeeshop to enthusiasts who appreciate specialty coffee. -finally, they greet you when coming in and thank you after.

So good! I ordered the Espresso Mule; it's honestly not for everyone but I've always loved the bitter and earthy taste of the espresso, so mixing it with ginger ale is refreshing and really woke me up. Hehehehe My friends also said that their savory waffles are a must, so I tried the lean chicken pesto and cheese. It's sooo good! I did enjoy the banana muffin (it's that and the carrot muffin that's current on display) and it was okay. Not too sweet but very filling; it goes well with my Espresso Mule. I ordered the Bacon and Egg Waffles to go and enjoyed it at home. It's just as good as the lean chicken and pesto but I might be bias because I love pesto so much. 😆

We only tried their drinks—the Dirty Matcha, Affogato, White Peak, and Mocha Lava. I was expecting their coffee to be really good since many people recommended the place, and it didn't disappoint. The drinks we tried were slightly on the stronger side, even the Dirty Matcha. The place isn't that spacious, but it's good enough. It's a conducive spot, not for studying, but for hanging out and spacing out, haha. Dirty Matcha – I've tried better. The coffee overpowered the matcha. White Peak and Affogato – Good coffee. I would recommend these. Mocha Lava – Highly recommended, even for non-coffee drinkers, since you can customize it. You can ask for a light espresso shot or even none at all. The service was good. The staff were approachable and really nice.
One of the best Spanish Latte I have ever tried!!

Finally got the chance to check this place out with limited parking. Around 9:30 a.m. kind staff greeted me. Late 80's music playing. Was directed to the extension room for more seating. The bitterness and sweetness of the Mocha Lava was superior. Perfect start with the light Purge Salad. (Don't you just love a salad with no protein?). The Waldorf Sandwich, a softly-toasted bread with thinly-sliced chicken wasn't what I expected to enjoy. But this brunch was just appropriate (with errands and an appointment in between) till my next chow at 4:30 p.m. Saw some nominally-priced food worthy of a second trip. Management should check the validity of the OR's they issue….

From all the beans I have bought, including international ones, Purge has the best coffee beans for me so far. I also enjoyed their made coffee in the store. Food is so so but it's fine. Staff is super nice.
surprisingly i love the ice spanish latte. you can really taste the premium quality beans. Best Cafe in Davao so far. Perfect pair with Classic waffles.

Purge Coffee Roaster is of the newest food shops along Tulip Drive. The coffee shop is small with a relatively small menu as well. Nonetheless, the coffee is superb especially their signature cold brews. The place looks modern and cozy, perfect for small meet ups and gatherings. The staff are friendly and accommodating too. I would definitely recommended this especially for serene coffee lovers.
Nice place, not so many food choices. The flat white was okay for me but my husband found his pour over interesting. I enjoyed my waffles. These places are alway better than those coffee shop chains.
First cup - the latte didn't disappoint, it's strong and rich in flavor. Service is great, cards and GCash are accepted. I have yet to try their food, will def be coming back here!

Love the coffee and food. The place can accommodate a good amount of people. And it smells great too. Not to mention very friendly baristas and servers . Will surely come back again and recommend it to more friends.
Nice place, great coffee, i had the hot spanish latte. Also i tried their choco chip muffins, it's delicious❤️

A real third wave coffee experience in Davao operated by a passionate award winning barista. "Share Humble Experience" is apt to use as statement for this unassuming place. Just the way Coffee should be served ... with respect. More power to this cafe and this is a must for coffee lovers.

This place has a Star barista and great local blends. I kept it simple with their café mocha and it was served to perfection! Not to sweet and quite smooth just how I like it! If your looking for a great local place this is the one 🤩
Very very rude servers. Beyond mediocre coffee and food. A lot of superior cafes/restos within the vicinity. Would never be back here again.

Very nice white and black, hot and iced cofee. Delicious pancakes, cozy ambiance. Excellent service with added premium on coffee education and very accesible location. The next coffee location in Davao City.
Nice coffee... specially their blended..but some of my friends says Thier black are not that good. Over roasted beans. Love the place but it's to small.

This Dainty cafe in Tulip Drive Davao City is a good spot for food and coffee. The price is very reasonable for its serving size. It also has a feel good cozy vibe. Will surely visit this place again.
Good coffee. I ordered an espresso with mule and surprisingly the drink is good and refreshing. The Mule brings out the darker notes of the coffee. Great staff as well.
Place is quite small but cozy. Good for meetings and intimate conversations. Food and beverages are delicious at a reasonable price. Serving modified delicate coffee based on your preference.
Twas my first time at Purge cos I frequent the sister branch Stash more (#Northkidproblems). There's a reason people frequent Purge: They consistently provide good food, drinks, and experience. 💗
Great filtered coffee with options, delicious waffle! and easy parking, nice service, what else?
One of the nicest cafè I've ever tried. It's always full when I come by, The coffee was great, loved it!

Love their coffee here. This is one of my top choices when it comes to Davao coffee. If you're finding a chill place that serves good coffee, this is the perfect place for you. Parking space is limited, medyo mahihirapan ka mkapark near the shop pag peak hours

Maybe one of the best coffee in one of the cleaniest Coffeeshops in Davao. Only small snack menu, but great coffee. You can also buy (and consumate) self made cookies and Davao Coffee (beans) for your favorite coffee at home!

Very underrated café! I hope y'all consider dropping by them instead of the other high-priced, branded coffee shops nearby (SB and Bo's). They serve artisan pancakes, like the one in the picture. This is Banana-Walnut by the way. Extremely delicious without being overly sweet. Their coffee is one of the best I've ever tasted. If you're in the Matina area and are looking for a great place to unwind with a cup of coffee and pancakes, please visit Purge! You won't regret it. Ps. I forgot to mention their baristas are award-winning, literally. They know their stuff.
Amazing coffee, beans, and food!
Sarap ng dirty matcha! The service was outstanding, especially from the guy who took our order. Cute ng smile niya char haha

There was hair in my cookie but they replaced it with another batch of cookies. Yummy sweet Matcha.
I have been around Davao coffee shops but Purge is considered the best in my opinion. The ambience to the coffee is great They have fruit drinks and a well curated meal perfect for coffee meals too
The best pour over! I also highly recommend their double flight! the best!
Ordered Spanish Latte. It's really good! It's a good working space. However not all tables have sockets.

Deserving of its many awards and accolades. The espresso was robust, the beans roasted to my personal favourite somewhere between a medium and a dark, the drink was well balanced. However, the service of two of the ladies on duty left something to be desired. When asking about the products on the shelves it felt as if they couldn't be bothered or they somehow weren't enthused by my interest in their offerings. Nonetheless, a definite must try coffee spot.

I really love this place, I honestly lost count of how many times I've been here! It's always a joy to come back. I love the cozy atmosphere, the food, and of course, the coffee,my absolute favorite here. The staff are always friendly, and the place is consistently clean and well-maintained. Great job to the management and team for keeping the quality so consistent. Looking forward to my next visit.🥰

The coffee here is superb. This is definitely my go-to coffee shop in Juna. The place is a bit small, but that's part of its charm. It doesn't feel commercialized, which I really appreciate. I just wish they offered more food options.
Delicious espresso, fast and warm service from staff
Their coffee is really great (and strong)! Food is fine too
Good coffee, good food. No rice menu though
Perfect cold coffee. Very interesting taste of the carbonated espresso.

Where roasted beans, a fragrant dark delight, Purge Coffee brews, banishing morning's night. A cozy haven, with a unique embrace, Crafted cups served, within this warm space. Though whispers warn, the coffee's spirit flows, A bold brew served, where passion brightly glows.

White peak & iced matcha will always be my go-tos.
Coffee is not bad, but not as great as people say it is. I guess my expectations were too high. Though customer service is commendable.
I love the coffee and the food. The best coffee shop in town 🤍 …

I was looking for a roaster in Davao who had local coffee beans and I found Purge. I drank their Black River iced coffee and it was absolutely delicious. Also bought 2 bags of coffee beans (Bukidnon and Mt Apo) to take home. The Bukidnon beans were good, but the coffee I made with the Mt Apo beans was just delicious. Can't wait to be in Davao again
Great place to hang out and study. Their coffee is great as well

Purge is definitely one of the best cafes in Davao! ☕️ I had the pleasure of trying their Spanish Latte and Dirty Matcha, which were both amazing. 📍 The café is located in a very convenient spot in Tulip Drive and they are true to their brand of selling the best coffees made from freshly roasted beans. 👨🏻 🍳 The staff was also incredibly friendly. ✍🏻 Even though it's a bit out of the way for me, I always make a point to drop by whenever I'm in the area because the drinks are just that good.
Excellent! My go to place with my boyfriend and friends!

Love love love purge. My go to coffee place and pasta!!! Been going to the same place for almost 2 years, to the fact that they know me na(😭) and I must say their coffee is truly remarkable. Plus their staff is so friendly and truly puts their heart into anything they do.🫡
A wonderful café spot in Davao with a cozy and modern vibe.

The coffee was good, not overly sweet and you can tell it was freshly made inside the shop. The shop itself smells like roasted coffee which makes the whole place aromatic. The stafff were very nice and accommodating, they even said good night after leaving the shop. My experience in this shop was over all a 10/10.

A pet-friendly cafe. Last night, we brought along with us our Golden Retriever to buy our coffee bean stash. To my surprise, they allowed us to bring our dog inside the cafe. The staff were so warm and friendly towards our dog and even the guests were happy to play with him. This makes us appreciate Purge Cafe more and more. We always come to Purge to get our coffee bean supplies. And occasionally we dine here with friends, especially those who are not from Davao. This is the first time we brought along our Furbaby.

I like the friendly ambiance. They got the best coffee in town and you can tell the barista how you want your coffee to be. The cookies and the waffles are not sweet, a perfect combination for your hot brew. I will definitely go back.

Coffee's taste was really good and they have good variety of imported coffee but they served on small coffee cups( could have been better if they have option for mugs). Coffee was not very hot. We prefer real hot coffee. Only choice of sweets to pick that time was banana bread which was dry. Will still try to go there next time.
Serves one of the best coffee drinks in Davao! Peaceful environment and serves delicious meals. Perfect study place for students. May get crowded sometimes, but food and coffee are worth the money.

Best coffee in town. Stepping inside feels like a warm hug, from the friendly baristas, humble owners, and SUPERB coffee and waffles (now with cocktail drinks!). ☕️🧇🍸 Same as the name, they roast their own beans, from high-grade local beans to imported beans. I'm a fan of their Mt. Apo beans. It's like, if you think about "Coffee delivered in a cup of excellence", PCR would be it, and this is not an exaggeration. They aim to support the local industry and spread awareness of how we have an abundant supply of coffee beans and other products. They also supply coffee beans to a lot of coffee shops, which is superb because in case they're closed, I know which shop to go to next. They also use honey and tableya, sourced from local farms, which are both amazing. The tableya makes for a great champurrado! Verdict: ☕️My ultimate favorite and go-to drink. It's like, once you take a sip, you'll definitely get another one. White Peak is a cold brew made to perfection, with its rich and creamy taste. 🧇Classic Waffles. Everything I love in one plate: Waffles, Bananas, Vanilla Ice Cream, and Grapes! 🧇Chicken Pesto Waffle. A lovely surprise. I've always been hesitant to match waffles with meat, but they made my palate do somersaults! Absolutely delicious! 🍸Cocktails. I've never been a boozy type of person, but, I love their Midori and Rose Fizz (not sure of the name). 🍝Mom's Spaghetti. I am quite picky with spaghettis, so this makes it in my top 3 list. It is just so tasty! But what sets this place apart from all the other cafes? It's the culture. The staff make you feel like they've known you for ages, it feels like a space safe to hang out by yourself or with a group. I've always found myself bringing my family and friends here, never heard a complaint.. yet! :D There's enough parking space for cars. Hopefully, they'll have bike racks soon. Location: Tulip Dr, Matina, Davao City #purgecoffeeroasters #localcoffeeshop #davaocoffee

Nice looking place, and the staff was friendly and attentive. But I came there for coffee and that's where the problem lay. The coffee was sour, a sure sign that brew time was too short, leaving the sweet flavors not fully extracted from the bean. Hopefully, they'll improve because it would be such a shame to have such a nice, cozy coffee place but bad coffee.

As a visitor if you are a coffee geek like me I highly recommend this coffee shop, after trying many coffee shops in town, this coffee shop in Davao is the best! Educated baristas and excellent customer service!
Great coffee, good ambiance.
One of the best tasting local coffee in Davao

If you are in Davao, then I highly recommend you visit this place! • Specialty coffee • The coffee is delicious and very enjoyable - best I have tried in Davao so far. • The ambiance is very relaxing and the café design is gorgeous. • The barista was very polite and friendly, also very knowledgeable in their craft. Overall, I extremely enjoyed my visit and every Peso was worth it. If I have the time, I would love to come back for another cup of their coffee.
Banana Walnut Waffle with Mocha delicious combination.
Lovely and best filtered coffee and sandwiches.

I am a fan of this place. It's only my second time but it is quickly growing on me, and fills a much needed cafe shop void caused by Coffee For Peace's move further south to Ecoland Drive. This shop is more coffee centric, small space, intimate and modern atmosphere with friendly unassuming baristas who let their coffee nad the quality of the experience they offer speak for itself. December 2022 | This review is two years overdue, so I'm not even sure if everything still applies but I wanted to write it anyway because my experience here was genuinely memorable. I had been eyeing this shop for weeks until I eventually reached it by accident while doing my nightly walk along Don Julian Rodriguez Avenue. Two customers were just heading out as I arrived, so I ended up having the entire place to myself. I ordered a slice of cake and a cup of coffee — names I can't remember anymore but both tasted really good. The cake slice, in particular, was huge. I couldn't finish it on my own, and honestly, it's best shared between two to three people. The café is small but very cozy and warm. It feels like a quieter, more relaxed version of Green Coffee near NCCC VP Mall. Davao has plenty of coffee shops, but this one is definitely a charming little hidden gem, a true "hole-in-a-box" cutie.

For Java Chip got to Starbucks or Green Coffee For Mocha go for local specialty coffee shops For cappuccino go for local specialty coffee shops For shakes go for Krispy Kreme Strawberry Shake Heck, this branch is just across Mcdonalds. As a coffee enthusiast, I'm always eager to explore new coffee shops in the city. Recently, a new coffee haven for caffeine lovers opened in the developing Davao Global Township, located along the main McArthur Matina Road. After a long day at work, I decided to check out this new Seattle's Best Coffee and experience it firsthand. The establishment is impressive with its spacious two-story building, offering a modern and bustling atmosphere with a peaceful view of the surroundings. The parking lot is also ample. A wide variety of coffee flavors are available, along with other beverages to choose from. As always, my go-to medium-sized cappuccino, which met my expectations, made my day, especially when paired with a plate of "beyond meat." The service crew was also very helpful. I mistakenly mentioned my order, and even though it had already been punched in, the crew member took the time to ask her supervisor for a correction to the billing amount. The prices are also reasonable. I spent an hour relaxing there before heading home, and I couldn't believe how many people were coming in, filling up all the available seats. It's clear that Seattle's Best Coffee is becoming a popular spot. I highly recommend this coffee shop to my friends who are looking for a great coffee experience and a new place to relax while enjoying their beverages.

Taste the world in every sip of coffee here at Seattle's. They have become a well-loved coffee brand to other countries/cities. Known for its smooth, premium coffee blends and cozy café with an intriguing tone, it also caters to wide guests - from coffee enthusiasts to casual drinkers. Seattle's Best offers a variety of drinks, from their signature coffee's to specialty beverages like the JavaKula (blended ice drinks) and espresso-based drinks such as lattes, mochas, and cappuccinos. In addition to coffee, they serve pastries, sandwiches, and other light meals, making it a popular spot for casual dining and work or study sessions. As of the moment, they have just started building their cafés in Davao and I believe this is the first and it is being located at DGT. Seattle's Best Coffee is often seen as a more relaxed alternative to other major coffee chains, with a focus on quality and a more intimate café experience. Their seasonal drinks and promos also keep customers coming back. It can be compared to one of the well known coffee shops in the city and it's great to have it experienced! Location: 📍 Road 1, Davao Global Township(DGT), MacArthur Highway, Davao City 📆 6am to 2am daily

June 2026 – Seattle's Best Coffee is located near the entrance road leading to Davao Global Township's City Center. I have been here on several occasions, and the shop's issues have been consistent since its opening: a lack of cleanliness, and a shortage of front-desk personnel and additional POS terminals. Imagine having a long queue of customers only to be greeted by a single active register and one attending staff member, while the rest of the crew remains in the back. Cleanliness is not consistently maintained; the service crew is rarely seen clearing or wiping tables after customers leave, and the restroom is also quite dirty. Furthermore, order preparation is inconsistent. For instance, when ordering three drinks, you would expect to be given a matching number of spoons, forks, or straws, along with enough tissue to share. On the plus side, there are varied seating options available across the ground floor, the second floor, and the front alfresco area. Because it is located within the DGT development, parking is easy and readily available. However, because it sits in such an open area, mobile internet connection can also be inconsistent.

We love coming here for a quick meal! The cheesesteak is a total standout and a consistent favorite for us. We tried the pesto pasta this time too, and it was good. Friendly service and a really nice vibe inside the restaurant. A solid choice!

If you're looking for a cozy coffee shop where you can work and get fast wifi, this cafe is for you. You just have to go up to the 2nd floor, though so not recommended for PWDs Didn't try any of the sandwiches but all the drinks we ordered were spot on! Loved the biscoff latte and matcha latte. Wished they have bigger drink sizes, though. Super bitin! 😆 Will definitely come back if there's a chance.

Eyeing this for weeks already but was having multiple thoughts with curbside parking. Only chance I got was for an early carwash on the same grounds. Menu was chalked on the wall. Not a sucker for grilled cheese but it was filling. I'm thankful for the tomato salsa dip twist, drowning the oily cheesiness altogether. Café concept was charming. Kitchen would have been better located upstairs for food prep as the sight of it (food order) exposed traveling up the steps didn't sit very well with me. The wait and stay was delightful. Eager for a repeat.

Tucked inside Top Secret Auto Detailing Shop, this place has great coffee! Beans were fresh and milk was steamed to perfection (not too hot). Plant-based milk substitute available, and i love that their matcha and horchata are already oat-based. Yum also the sandwiches! Well seasoned and juicy yung chicken. Must try: Dirty Horchata and Grilled Cheese (no pic kasi naubos kaagad) ❤️ 🔥
The americano is perfect, can taste the nut and chocolate flavor of the beans, that's a good one! Sandwich is good ( a little salty), but I am willing to come back again and try other flavors

Me and my friends ordered drinks here for the night to kill time, their coffee was delicious, especially the matcha. Unfortunately, my order, the horchata, was really disappointing. I expected it to be just as good because of the great reviews, but it was foul to the point I couldn't even finish half of it. I'd say their horchata is probably a hit or miss, but aside from that, the rest of the drinks were enjoyable.

The drinks were amazing! It hits you right on the spot. The baristas are really kind too. Modern and cozy coffee spot. Theres also board/card games to keep you and your friends busy while chit chatting!
Love the vibe and the food but how are you not open 20 minutes past your opening time? As well as just letting a customer wait way longer just for a barista to even arrive.
Food is great. Great non-coffee drinks, notably the horchata. Couch comfy I sleep.
The place is cozy, very welcoming staff, and the food is great. Will recommend to my friends 😊
Always open on time! Very good service, food and atmosphere!
My go-to for much needed matcha fix 💚
Good food and coffee, ambience is superb!
Grilled cheese sandwich + matcha heaven 😮 💨
Vibes are immaculate.
I came here with a friend! The matcha latte was delicious.
The staff is friendly and the coffee is delicious, the best in Davao! <3
no

The place is nice and good. Crews are friendly and accomodating, for the food and drinks. Affordable and the food is good, we ordered nachos, burger and fries. The nachos is really good, also the burger and for the fries sakto yung pagka luto, crispy. 💚More customers and Godbless smoothside.
A very good place to chill and unwind, their coffee is delicious.
Excellent place and coffee..
The opening was delicious. My free spaghetti, and the coffee was delicious.. I asked the barista, they use pure arabica. I will be back.

The atmosphere is best here. The food is good, but not for it's price. Most probably because it's a cafe. The one on my pictures totalled 1100. It's self service for the drinks. There are also cats in the premise. Just chilling. Overall good place to boost your social climbing status lol

The place is esthetically pleasing, but the hot food option is meh. Price vs. quality of food is disappointing. I order a 220 pesos dish and its just came with 3 pieces of small pieces of meat, tomatoes and a huge portion of shredded lettuce all of that in a soft shell taco, that thing did not look like a 200pesos dish. Also, the chicken Alfredo is super thick and it is stiff like it was left on the counter for a while before it was served. Don't get me started with the bread which look sad and stale as it can get, one bite and it all crumbles. Next, the wait time is horrendously long just for 2 dish it took 1 1/2hrs like you can assemble that in less than 30. The owner and stakeholders should re-assess their menu as most of their food choices is unavailable.

I'm from Japan and had the chance to visit Davao during my vacation. I found this café and was really impressed. The food was delicious, with generous portions and great flavors, and the coffee was smooth, rich, and perfectly made. The staff were kind and attentive, and the cozy atmosphere made it a great place to relax. I truly enjoyed my visit and would gladly recommend this café to anyone visiting Davao. I hope to come back again someday!

Solace will always be my favorite cafe in the south part of Davao. It's a cozy spot with an aesthetic atmosphere, and their staff is super friendly. Having worked in the food industry myself, I completely understand that sometimes certain items on the menu might be unavailable, but that doesn't take away from how great their food is! I've visited more times than I can count.

I have visited your establishment twice, and unfortunately, both experiences were disappointing. During my first visit, I ordered a matcha drink, but the quality was below expectations. The taste did not reflect authentic matcha, and it seemed comparable to lower-cost alternatives that are more enjoyable. On my second visit, I encountered issues with customer service. The staff appeared unfriendly, and the use of a QR code system was inconvenient, especially for customers who are in a hurry. Additionally, the interaction with the staff felt unaccommodating. While the food quality showed some improvement, the serving size remained relatively small for its value. I hope you can take this feedback into consideration. Your place has great aesthetic appeal, and it would be a shame not to match it with equally good service and product quality.

One of my favorites! been here for two times now and they are really doing their best to upgrade. Food is good esp pasta. I also love their matcha but coffee is way too strong—so I really don't recommend it. The ambiance is just perfect. Half a year in their business and their impact is just awesome!🤍
This is a nice upgrade for Toril. A sweet spot for cafe and meals. The location is also good for the southside people. Go support this pretty cafe they got good vibes. ❤️🫶🏻

The place is suitable for focused work if you dine inside the cafe. The outside however is too noisy it has a lot of motorcycle sound and when I was there, there were people singing Karaoke but if that doesn't bother you, the cafe is really good place to hang out, enjoy coffee, and chill. Two drinks I've ordered, blueberry soda which tastes really good and refreshing. If they consider to lessen the amount of blueberry syrup, it would ve perfect. The second one is salted caramel latte - this one I was surprised that the taste was really good and the price is just perfect. I am inviting my friends over to try soon.

Solace truly lives up to its name, offering comfort and consolation. That was exactly what I felt during my first visit with my family. We enjoyed their delicious food, shared laughter, and felt at ease throughout our stay. Time seems to pass unnoticed because of the wonderful ambience and welcoming atmosphere. Solace is indeed a place where comfort meets cherished memories!

The place is good when we were there recently. Good thing there was a available seat for us. Their menu is digital, just scan their qr code at the counter. The coffee I ordered is good, not bad but not that exemplary. Staff were friendly. Like their outdoor seats. Hope i can try other menu items soon.

I left the restaurant feeling hungry despite spending a significant amount of money. I expected much more for the cost and based on some reviews. To my surprise, their spareribs were tough and tastes blandly. Their matcha also tastes like malunggay, it has bitter aftertaste. You can really tell that it's not a high quality or high grade matcha powder given that their matcha series are a bit pricey. Their staff were not accommodating and welcoming as well. One good thing tho, there's a free parking space but not yet cemented. Another one for the 'never again' list of cafes, just aesthetics but lacks flavor.

Opened its gate by 2 p.m. one weekday. The subtly run-down look of exterior walls added more to its allure. Tiramisu foam blend and the Seasalt cream tasted fine. Place was too hot as sun's rays streamed through the glass. Second time around cafe was on time (1 p.m.). The Almond latte and Lychee yakult was just unimpressively regular in taste. Some unavailable beverages that day too. Another was the food they unusually start serving later at 3:30. For some odd reason only hot beverages are allowed for carryout. Staff attitude wasn't even impressive to begin with during both visits. Just imagine what the mood of the next shift would be…Well, I tried and that's the last.

I really enjoyed my time in Solace. The crew was very welcoming and the service was fast. What made me love this shop was the genuine taste they had with their Matcha drinks. This is definitely my go-to coffee shop in Toril!

This is a new place around Toril. Ambiance there is just like any other cafe's with aesthetic and chill vibes. Theres so many spots where you can pose and take pictures. There are couple of tables inside and plenty outside w/ umbrellas so day heat and light rain is not a problem. Upon arrival we were greeted and servers are accommodating. Dalgona Coffee - 7/10 soso. This is not for those wants coffee on the lighter side. This taste bitter like life Aglio Olio - this is bland for me so 5/10 Nachos Overload - 10/10 i definitely had nachos with dip that taste better that this but this one's good too They serve affordable cafes and foods. We're too full we were not able to get pastries. Will be back next time 💜

It's been a while since I was thrown off by the quality of service of a cafe. The staffs were not accomodating at all. The menu is a qr code on a transparent acrylic board, it was hard to scan it considering the light above it was glaring. I asked the staff if they had a physical menu and she said none, so I asked if there's another way for me to view the menu and she just shrugged. Wow. It was infuriating considering that I travelled all the way from north for this. I managed to scan the menu after shading the qr from the light. I ordered their version of a Spanish Latte...lo and behold it was very bitter. I wish they would improve on their quality and service. If it makes it slightly better, the place is aesthetic. Just that.

You wont find solace in this cafe. The cafe music is was so loud it seems like the baristas are in their house. The baristas were busy video calling someone else. Service was really bad. The red velvet cake was very dry.

Been here three times, really hoping the coffee would level up, but it's not. I'm disappointed. The coffee are way too sweet. Every sip just gets more nauseating. Even the iced Americano is watery. The coffee is basically not there, completely overpowered by the milk. And as a matcha lover? Gotta be real, it's giving milk with a hint of green. Also, the vibe from the staff could be better. A friendly, welcoming crew makes such a difference in the overall experience, and right now, it's just not there. Really hoping you guys improve the service, fix the flavors, and bring better energy. It gives me second thoughts about coming back there.

I had a really nice experience at this coffee shop. The coffee was fresh and tasted great, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. The place felt clean and cozy, making it a perfect spot to relax. I'll definitely be coming back!

ordered the Black Pepper Beef and was impressed it tasted great and the portion size was generous. However, my girlfriend's Sweet and Sour Pork was disappointing, as it had far more pineapple than meat.

Saks lang pare, this place so legit. But on the good side, the vibe is real. But I felt different, and I agree with the people. Life's too short to be not doing something you love. Always choose yourself first over everyone. Love and Peace! Escape the matrix!
Perfect spot to chill and catch up with friends! Ambiance is relaxing and their Coffee and Pasta is great!

The vibe and aesthetic were good. They really nailed their target market with this one. Tried their cookies, coffee, and bestseller — dragonfruit yakult. Loved the drinks. I have a preference to how cookies are made but still enjoyed their product. Price of the food was like the average coffee shop which was okay. Only thing I had a problem with was the number of customers vaping in the area. I think one of the owners confronted them about it so thanks for that, so.lace crew! I could definitely get behind this cafe as a frequent customer when I need a coffee fix.
They serve great drinks and tasty food esp. the smash burger taco. Love that they are not too pricey.

Went with a friend on a Saturday afternoon around 4pm, it was difficult to identify I was at the location already because parking was full and covered the whole place 😭 If the friend I was with wasn't with me It probably would've took me 5 mins to find. Had high expectations on the drinks because of how much I saw this place being promoted by everyone but expectations stayed as expectations 😔 Drinks weren't up to my taste (tried my friend's order too). We both weren't very fond of the drink. Pastries were alright, average at most.
I had a great experience at Solace – Coffee Club. The place is cozy, the food and drinks are good, and the staff are friendly. Definitely coming back!
The place was nice but their drinks never mind nlng jud!! The food was not worthy for its price.
One of the best spot to chill and dine here in Toril! Affordable yet Coffee 5 ⭐! A must try! I Highly recommend White Mocha Oatside! 😋
Lami inyo drinks and food, but the location is tooooo noisy gyud.
The place is so spacious it feels relaxing. An excellent location for you to unwind. The Coffees are good tho 10/10✨.
100/10 😍 the place is so aesthetic and perfect for catch up moments with friends. The coffee is good ☕ loving the vibes!
Love the ambiance, coffee, and food. It's a great place to work, especially for WFH employees looking for a comfortable and productive environment.
Just opened at 1pm we arrived at 4pm and there are no food available no burgers no fries nothing Only drinks. Not recommended

matcha latte - 1 out of 10. i've always loved matcha, so nag try ko mag order sa inyo café. however, i ordered twice na tapos it tasted a bit bland and quite bitter. literally, bitter kaayo na wala ko kasabot. not sure if that's how it's supposed to be prepared ???? but i've tried matcha man from other cafés and the taste was noticeably different. hopefully, ma-improve pa ninyo ang matcha series ninyo. even my friends who ordered before had the same feedback, medyo way lami raw. huhu. that said, the food i've tried from your menu were okay man. just hoping for improvements with the matcha. thanks : D

✔ Great Coffee & Drinks – Their Spanish Latte was perfectly balanced, and the Caramel Macchiato had just the right amount of sweetness. They also offer refreshing iced drinks and non-coffee options. ✔ Cozy Atmosphere – Whether you're working, reading, or catching up with friends, the ambiance is super inviting. Soft lighting, comfy seats, and relaxing music make it a great place to stay for hours. ✔ Delicious Pastries & Food – Their pastries pair well with their coffee, and they also serve filling meals if you're looking for something more substantial. Definitely a must-visit if you're in Toril! Can't wait to come back for another cup. ☕✨ #SolaceToril #DavaoEats
Cozy, homey and aesthetic vibes! Drinks are also superb! Must try!
Staffs are very accommodating.. drinks and food are also good!! The place is so relaxing
Everything looked perfect from the outside, but it was even better inside. The drinks were excellent, and the vibes were immaculate. I love how the place brings me comfort, it truly is my solace.
The food is good and the coffee. It's the place that I like the most.
Staff are unresponsive. No initiative. Doesn't care about customer experience
Ang ganda ng place and the best ang coffee along with perfect customer service! Truly recommend this to everyone in Davao! 10 out of 10!
I asked the staff if their meals are available and he said yes. We chose what we want and he said that all of it are unavailable as of the moment LOL! WASTE OF TIME!!!
Bartenders/staff has no sense of urgency!! Need to improve your service.
The coffee was good 👍 …
Nice staff.. Chill ambiance
Nice Place!!!

FINAL DESTINATION FEELS!!! Customer safety should always be the top priority, but unfortunately, our recent experience here proved otherwise. I strongly advise management to rethink their layout and avoid placing ceiling fans so close to the sunshades. During our visit, the sunshade actually hit the spinning ceiling fan and tore off. As a result, the heavy sunshade roller fell and hit my friend. While the accident itself was a major safety hazard, the staff's reaction was just as disappointing. Not a single staff member approached us to check if my friend was okay, and we received absolutely zero apologies. It seemed like the team was completely untrained and unprepared to handle this kind of situation with basic courtesy. I hope management takes this seriously, fixes the dangerous setup, and trains their staff on how to properly handle accidents and treat their customers. Xiao
Balanced flavor, bright acidity, and a satisfying finish. I love their Tiramisu too - exactly how I want it to taste!
Unique coffee flavors!
They have one of the best coffee quality in Toril, also you can have wifi access once dine, port for charging and good for working and dine in quality time with friends or with family

One of the best places in DAVAO I've visited! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully served, while the coffee was rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the staff are friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service. Everything was worth the price, and you can tell they care about quality. I'll definitely be back and will recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and amazing coffee!

We visited your store last night because it was recommended by a friend of my husband one of your workers. We saw your shop and the ambiance is very comfy we love the ambiance But I was disappointed because of the staff and my husband ordered some of your café drinks. One of the drinks I noticed is the cappuccino, which is not standard po nia I don't know if my wrong Ok lang sana, so I went to the cashier and asked the barista if the cappuccino didn't have chocolate powder. They said there was none, but if I wanted it I could add it but there was an additional charge. Which is, I don't know what standard cappuccino is. Literally just make milk foam then pour the coffee on top, then mix it and it's like a café latte. My husband chatted with his friend and explained our experience. Then your barista said that customers don't like cocoa powder on top because it's bitter, I don't know what is the exact standard of the cold cappuccino but based on my experience at barista abroad we put chocolate powder to balance the bitterness and sweetness while sipping the coffee. We understand that not all customers like cocoa powder, but hopefully they don't do it all because customers have different preferences and one thing missing is the customer service with a genuine smile 😊 Btw only I will rate your mango yacult 9/10. We have our own small coffee shop, and we love to explore other cafés to learn and get some ideas to apply in our coffee shop. We came all the way from Kidapawan just to visit your shop, so we were a little disappointed with the experience, especially with the barista who served us. We visited around 8:42 PM. We hope this feedback helps po 🙏🏻 our coffee shop MK ROLLINGS FLAVOR CAFE

I didnt have high expectation for this cafe but it still disappoint me a lot. Ive been here 3 times as I try to give it a chance but it's really bad. *QR menu isnt convenient *food are bland and expensive, small portion, so it's not really worth it. *Imagine travelling all the way to south only to find no available food except their fake tiramisu? *coffee's are not high quality, don mach seems better for 39 pesos *songs are too loud and not vibe. Staff trip *staffs are rude. There is an attitude that *if you don't like it, leave* ambiance is nice but the music is really loud it's very hot in the afternoon, i suggest you put the blinds inside. The glare.

been here twice and disappointed twice, the coffee served warm only not the hot ones. the cold drinks are nothing special. We went there around 7 PM and the cakes we ordered were already hard so they refunded them. the staff, i agree with the other comments here, theyre not that accommodating. Last year the menu was just a QR code, this time my physical menu but the black background is so hard to read the list so we still need a flashlight to read. really overhyped, maybe because of the ambiance which is really nice. hopefully this review helps them improve because there are still a lot of sipa costumers.

Staff attitude, it seems like they haven't even been trained for customer service, serving takes a long time, not worth it, and I noticed they delated their bad reviews on their fb page, their menu setup via QR is ugly so if there is no load you can't order?

What I like the most here is that they are open until 5 am so it's perfect for VAs or those who are all nighters. It's just sad that the closed space is so small, only about 2 groups can be accommodated. My advice is also that since it's outside, be prepared for mosquitoes and other stuff. The drinks are delicious, as are the cookies.
The food is delicious and the place is beautiful ❤️

Unfortunately, the food was not okay this time. The rice was almost drowned in the amount of sauce. This wasn't our first time ordering the Pepper Beef, and it tasted and was prepared much better before. I'm not sure what happened, but it seemed like we were the ones who got their experimental batch especially the Ala King. It tasted like gata with a strange woody aftertaste. The chicken was also burnt. No matter how hungry we were, we couldn't finish it. Overall, this order was very disappointing.
Bundak plate if serving. Will not recommend

The place is good, you can sit outside and also inside but people preferably go inside since theres an AC, tried the combo platter, it was really good specially how cooked the fries were, specially the chicken i really love it, its boneless and really tasty, the drink was also good i tried the lemon but unfortunately i think they add a little to much ice, the hash brown however has a unique taste its like an original but i didnt really like it, the Environment was really good despite its cramp space being this popular to teens is really cool, specially it's close to tesda school, the service also good and the menu has many options, totally good place to chill and relax
The burger bun smells bad and the ham has a bitter taste but the staff is very attentive overall the place was good.
Cute little Cafe, yummy iced coffee, very friendly staff ...

The staff were rude and impolite. The beef rendang and Thai chicken curry were extremely spicy—so much that they were almost inedible. I have tried so many rendang from different places, it is not that spicy at all! When we approached a staff member named "Kat" about our concern, she simply agreed that their rendang is indeed spicy and immediately walked away without offering any explanation, alternative, or assistance. It was disappointing to be dismissed so casually instead of having our feedback acknowledged properly. The food and service both fell below our expectations. Poor airconditioning system! 0/10 on all aspects! When we asked for glass for the service water, it was as if she didn't even want to give me a glass and almost hesitant to give me ice when i politely asked.

This tiny cafe has a thick menu book complete with ample pictures of their appealing beverages and food items. Each food item seems good for one person. The Thai Curry bowl was a positive choice for a first-timer like me. Reasonably-priced with the size of each serving . Their best-selling Mocha frappe was super rich and thick. I took out two pasta plates which I think was overdone…. Still, will definitely visit again to try others on the menu. Staff was nice too.

What I like the most here is it's open 24/7 so anytime you're craving coffee, you can come here. Went for a breakfast run and ordered pancakes. Pancakes were okay. It's a little bit sweet for me but the whipped cream kinda balanced the flavors. Ordered the fruit cake and java chip frappe for takeout and did not disappoint. One of the best blends I have ever tasted here in Davao. You can really taste the coffee beans and the cake was heavenly. It was fluffy and the cream was not too sweet. The fruits were fresh and the flavors are well balanced. Overall, this place is highly recommended.

Limited food on menu but I've fried their Chicken mushroom and Beef rice bowl, the best! Nice drinks too. We came around 11am and the aircon is off, it's hot during our training/seminar (until 4pm) so I guess they have to improve on that but as a whole, I had a good experience. Plus it's a walking distance to SM, like literally across the road.

We checked out Space-Arabica coffee shop for a change of pace. The place was packed, but we managed to snap a pic with the friendly baristas and tried their hazelnut latte and other drink (can't remember). The atmosphere was more like a coworking space with students everywhere, but the drinks were good. The ambiance wasn't our vibe, but it's great for those looking for a quiet place to work. It wasn't the place for us, but we'd stop by again just for the drinks. An interesting experience, but not quite our scene. (As Titas)

If you are looking for a coffee shop na 24 hrs at affordable, you must visit this place! Have internet connection! Aesthetic! Sana may work station, more tables sa second floor, and air purifier or humidifier. Also, kindly check the taste of your food kasi ang matcha lasang avocado but overall, masarap!!!

Food. Coffee beverages are quality. The frappes and iced coffees and tea taste good. A little comment on the hot bevereges as they are served warm, not hot. Based on the design of the cafe, it really is meant for those who enjoys drinking coffee while doing work. The long shared tables is a lil turn off for those who wish to drink coffee casually with their friends.

It's the space of intelligent people (based on observation). The majority of the customers are there to study and talk about their field of study. The Wi-Fi is free when you purchase food or drink, but is limited to only two hours. We have to purchase another item to get another code for the Wi-Fi. Although the Wi-Fi didn't work well when we were there, it's still okay because the signal in the area is good. The hot latte is also good. Foods from outside are prohibited too (?)
This is our go-to study place with my friends. We love the food and drinks, and the staff are always kind and accommodating. The place is clean, cozy, and perfect for studying. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
its so yummmmyyyy i swear worth the priceeeee🥹🌸🌸
A place where you can work or study. Quiet atmosphere. There are rice meals, pastries, and drinks to choose from. Has free wifi but during my stay there it was slow.

Discovered this relaxing coffee space in Ecoland. Space Arabica is accessible, could easily be spotted and has a convenient parking. The interior has a very relaxing ambience with a soothing ballad music that goes with it. Their tables are arranged so it wouldn't get too crowded - spacious area. Tried their Blueberry Cream Frappe and it has the perfect taste of a frappe. Can't say more of it :). Their Chicken Mushroom is okay. It's saucy and tasty as well with a large serving of rice 🤤. Service is great. Just take a jacket with you if you tend to order an ice cold frappe. And oh, affordable food is great food😉
The best coffe shop in town, i love the ambience and their coffee and chocolates drinks. Keep it up the good service and quality space-arabica. More power and God bless
Scam! Take your money and give you something you didn't order. No working AC🙄

Ambiance is good but the arrangement of the upper floor makes every movement seem noisier than it is and disrupts other cx. Couldn't find the taste of arabica in the coffee and it's like full of ice but not bad…. had the waffle and it was so dry and hard. barely tasted the milk on it. Some cxs doesn't have their headsets on when they are on call. Service is good but misleading information for the wifi cuz it's only 2 hrs for every order.

Had the Americano and Pork Teriyaki Bowl, couldn't distinguish the Arabica taste from the coffee and the dish was just sour pork bits. Open 24 hours but Mondays thru Saturdays only. Its an 'okay' working space but bring your own wifi because they don't provide it. Seats are uncomfortable, plants in the toilet are starting to mold (health code violation waiting to happen). Outlets in corners only in the upper floor, bring a power strip in case your far from it. Acoustics of the upper floor make every movement seem noisier than it is and disrupts other patrons. Melted cheese dishes (when made and served) make the entire place smell funky. Cannot recommend going here.
Coffee did not have a distinct taste to it. Parang kalasa lang sa tig 99 na coffee lol. Price isn't worth it. Staff weren't courteous as well.

A great experience for the 1st time there. Food was good..a bit sweet..more Arabic than indian and we ordered 4 Indian dishes, but ,service was great, friendly staff. Not too long a wait.. aesthetic ambience. All in all it was worth the price...

Just had the coffee here, so I can't really judge the food. Had the iced Americano, which was pretty good enough for me to just go back for the coffee. They have enough parking in the back and have a restroom. This place is open 24 hours, which is awesome.

To all coffee lovers, I recommend visiting Space-Arabica. Their frappe is really good, and the food is definitely worth coming back for because, apart from being delicious, it is also affordable, and the ambience is very cozy. Plus, the owner is extremely pleasant and accommodating. Kudos! ♥️♥️♥️
Held a meeting here one early morning. Food is just right for our budget. Meeting went well coz place is quiet.
have lots of seats, but the place is full, especially in the afternoon and weekends. very accommodating staff.
Very clean and has high-end furnishings but good value food. Some dishes don't quite have enough aromatic flavour you expect with middle eastern food
Had a flat white, was a good coffee. Cajun chicken pasta was nice flavour too, good amount of spice
Visit my friends in Davao and we dined here for an hour. 'T'was a great experience the place is clean, baristas are friendly and foods including coffee are good.

Coffes good but there waffles is VERY DRY
An ideal place for your late night coffee runs.

Nice place to dine in!

Space Arabica is a coffee shop located on Ecoland Road in Davao City, directly across from SM City. This coffee shop has two floors with comfortable seating. Tucked inside the bustling Gaisano Mall Davao is a charming little Starbucks branch that, while modest in size, more than makes up for it with its warm and inviting vibe. Whether you're looking for a quick caffeine fix, a place to catch up on emails, or simply somewhere to unwind, this cozy café is worth checking out. From the moment you walk in, the ambiance pulls you in — soft lighting, calm energy, and a mix of seating options that cater to both solo visitors and small groups. It's a compact space, sure, but it doesn't feel cramped. The layout makes smart use of what's available, and the stylish island counter adds a modern, functional flair. For digital nomads or anyone needing to charge up, there are power outlets available, though you might need to do a little hunting to find them. Just a heads-up for persons with disabilities (PWDs): the tight layout might make navigation a bit of a challenge. Now, here's a funny little moment — the barista didn't quite catch my name when I ordered, and instead of asking again, they just made one up. So there I was, on the little corner at the back of the island counter, sipping my Caramel Macchiato and eating my Danish Cinnamon Bread as Niel. Who's Niel? Who knows? That little Starbucks trick is having a comeback, I guess. Another pleasant surprise? The restroom. Clean, well-maintained, and clearly not an afterthought — always a welcome bonus in any café setting. All in all, Starbucks Gaisano Mall Davao is a great little hideaway amidst the mall chaos. It's not the biggest or flashiest branch, but it nails the basics: comfort, good coffee, and a peaceful spot to pause your day — even if you leave with a new name.

This Starbucks branch offers a warm, dependable experience that feels both familiar and thoughtfully run. The space is clean, well-lit, and comfortable whether you are working, meeting friends, studying, or just killing time between errands. The baristas are polite, organized, and impressively efficient even during busy periods, and they manage the crowd with calm professionalism rather than stress or attitude. I especially appreciated how they prioritized my order in the queue when I mentioned that my Grab was arriving in less than five minutes; that small act of consideration genuinely saved me stress and showed real customer awareness. The drinks were consistently well made — smooth lattes, properly balanced iced beverages, and reliable flavor every time, with customization handled without hesitation. Another major plus is that the Davao Modern Bus now stops right in front of the location, making this branch extremely convenient for commuters who want a quick coffee or snack before heading home. What keeps this from a perfect score is the food selection, which I rated 4/5. While everything available tasted fresh and decent, the range felt limited; I wished for more pasta options, a wider variety of cakes, better pastries, and more creative sandwiches beyond the usual staples. Still, with great service, a pleasant atmosphere, and excellent accessibility, this Starbucks remains a solid and very practical go-to spot in Davao.

Starbucks in SM Lanang offers a refreshing break from the typical mall-based cafe experience, primarily due to its standout location. Positioned as an "island platform" within the sprawling mall, it creates a distinct, open-air feel that sets it apart from other branches. The generous seating, both indoors and out, provides ample space for solo work or group meetups, making it a comfortable spot to linger and enjoy your coffee. The cafe's offerings are what you would expect from a Starbucks—a consistent and reliable menu of beverages and pastries that align with the brand's global standards. While the location and ambiance are unique to this branch, the food and drink options are a familiar comfort for any Starbucks enthusiast. However, a notable point for anyone planning an early visit is the discrepancy in operating hours. While online listings, including Google Maps, may indicate a general opening time of 8:00 AM, the on-site staff, as experienced firsthand, confirm a different schedule. It's a bit disappointing to be shooed away, but it's an important detail to be aware of to avoid an early morning letdown. It seems this specific branch operates on a 9:00 AM schedule, aligning with the general mall hours rather than the standard Starbucks time. This is a small but crucial piece of information for anyone who relies on those early hours for their caffeine fix. Ultimately, this Starbucks is a great spot for its ambiance and location, perfect for a mid-shopping break or a relaxed meet-up. Just be sure to double-check their actual opening hours before you go!

This Starbucks branch, prominently located on the 2nd Floor of SM Lanang Premier, offers a unique and distinct experience compared to other more enclosed locations. The branch generally follows the mall's operating hours, which are typically 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily. It's best to check the mall's official schedule for any holiday or special day adjustments. Because it is an open, lay-out store, and highly visible from all sides of the mall's floors, the place feels less cozy, warm, and inviting than most traditional Starbucks branches. It lacks the intimate, tucked-away feel you might find elsewhere. The combination of the open design and the mall's glass ceiling contributes to significant natural light, making the area feel too bright and hot during peak daylight hours. The atmosphere dramatically improves in the evening, offering a much nicer, cooler, and more relaxing environment. A distinctive feature is the slightly noticeable "shaky" sensation due to the structure standing on poles, which might be disconcerting for some patrons. Since expanding their floor space, they are able to accommodate more customers but on most peak days, they need more.

So, I was next, and since only two counters were open, the line worked in an alternating manner basically, whoever was at the front of the line would go to a counter once the previous customer finished ordering. So, here's what happened: the older person behind me told me to line up behind someone else. I told her that there's only one line and the baristas hadn't even finished taking the orders of the two people ahead since the two baristas were busy preparing the previous orders. But this older person went ahead and lined up behind one customer, and the person behind her lined up behind another customer. Basically, they skipped my turn. At first, I tried to understand because maybe they were a senior, but when I looked to see if they had a senior card, they didn't. So, were they just being rude? review_text: My favorite branch in the city so far. They have two floors and such exquisite architecture and interior design. It is spacious, a lot of seats and tables, perfect to chill in a busy day. I truly had a peaceful time with my drink here while working. Unfortunately, they don't have electrical outlet. Would love to come back here time to time. Overall, Great.

"I had a great time here, especially since it was my first visit. The place is spacious and well-designed, with a second floor that adds to the overall comfort and ambiance. They also offer free Wi-Fi, which is a nice bonus while you wait or relax. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was taken care of. What really stood out was the fast serving time—everything was efficient without compromising the quality of service. Overall, it was a very pleasant experience, and I would definitely recommend this place to others. Looking forward to coming back again!"

What I love: The overall aesthetic is fantastic, projecting a sense of class, sophistication, and positive energy. The design choices are well-executed. I especially appreciate the recent update where they now use sticker labels directly on the cup instead of writing on it—a much cleaner and professional look. The service is consistently quick and very efficient. Furthermore, this is a convenient drive-thru branch with ample parking spaces. The all-glass front and side are particularly pleasing and add a beautiful ambiance, especially at night. What needs improvement: My main concern is the spatial organization and capacity of this branch. I believe the original design did not fully anticipate how popular and easily crowded this location would become, which has been my consistent experience for years. On busy nights, such as paydays or special days, the indoor area can become excessively rowdy, hot, and loud. I strongly recommend reorganizing the ground floor seating. The current lounge chairs occupy too much valuable space, often hosting only one or two people and making it difficult for others to claim the remaining empty seats. Second Floor Heat: The absence of window blinds or adequate shading in the second-floor seating area causes excessive heat, particularly from noon through the late afternoon. I truly wish the management would consider a complete reorganization of the indoor space to better handle the consistent crowd volume.

Parking in front is so difficult especially when you arrive in rush hour, this area is always in heavy traffic, I suggest you park inside the damosa it park, parking at the back is so huge. Coffee and ambiance is always great.

I had a fantastic experience at Starbucks during my recent visit. The moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt inviting and calm. The space was filled with a gentle buzz of conversation, soft music, and the kind of cozy lighting that makes you want to stay longer than you planned. It was the perfect setting to relax, focus, or just take a break. I ordered two items, the four cheese flatbread and the bacon and sausage flatbread. Both were excellent. The four cheese option had a rich flavor that was perfectly balanced without being overwhelming, while the bacon and sausage one was hearty and satisfying. Together, they felt like the perfect mix of comfort food and café dining. Starbucks isn't just about coffee. The food menu really holds its own, and these flatbreads are proof of that. The service was smooth from start to finish. The ordering process was quick, the staff were friendly, and everything came out warm and fresh. I never felt rushed, and yet everything moved along with great efficiency. The drinks, as always, were spot on. Starbucks has a way of making every sip feel consistent, whether it is a classic latte, a seasonal special, or a refreshing iced option. The balance between flavor and presentation is always reliable. What stood out most was how easy it was to simply enjoy being there. Starbucks has a way of creating a space that feels both professional and personal. You could go there to study, meet a friend, or just sit quietly with your own thoughts. If I could live in a coffee shop, this would be the one. Between the food, the drinks, the atmosphere, and the staff, Starbucks delivers a complete experience. Five out of five.

The place is along the main street, so the crowd is mixed and the area can look a little congested at times, especially with plenty of Grab drivers outside waiting for pickups. Not really a bad thing, just something you notice when you arrive. No complaints with the coffee and food — it follows the usual Starbucks franchise standards, so nothing too crazy or different, but reliable as expected. One thing I do hope they add soon is support for the international Starbucks app. It would be very convenient for travelers or customers like me who use the US Starbucks app to tap, pay, and earn or use rewards instead of being limited only to the local Philippine app. Overall, a good Starbucks branch with good service, decent parking depending on the gate situation, and the usual consistent Starbucks experience.

April 2026 — I visited around 2:00 PM after grabbing lunch at Nanyang nearby. This is the second Starbucks branch in the SM City Davao complex, located on the first level of the SM Expansion Wing (the other being the newly renovated Annex branch). The aesthetic is a beautiful take on elevated Filipino design, featuring cushioned seats, wooden tables, ample space, warm lighting, and minimalist wall decor. However, despite the inviting ambiance, nearly every spot was taken by people on laptops with notebooks, pens, and bags sprawled across the tables. I noticed a row of cushioned seats on the right where only a few people were sitting, yet the surrounding empty seats were completely covered in their personal belongings. By 3:00 PM, which is peak coffee hour, a queue had formed with nowhere for new customers to sit. It's frustrating to see tables meant for 4 to 5 people occupied by only two, with extra chairs rendered unusable because they are being used as luggage racks. I even had to ask a guy if I could use a chair he was using as a footrest. While the service was fast, only one cashier was on duty and no printed receipts were available. Starbucks is known for its "Third Place" policy, but I feel it occasionally cultivates a culture of taking up too much space without regard for others. In Bisaya, we call this behavior "dalok" which means an unwillingness to share, and in this case, chairs and tables in a communal shop.

Warm and calm <3 The seats are comfortable and it seems to be a good spot for studying as the lighting isn't too harsh and there are electrical outlets. Staff is very friendly and nice despite the early hour of the morning 😊
