Stash is one of my favorite cafés whenever I'm in Davao. It may be the only place where I've had a Spanish Latte that tastes this good. Their breakfast plate is also my usual order—hefty, satisfying, and well worth the price.
What a terrific find… A quaint, elegantly, but modernly designed cafe that delivers on task and quality. Staff were wonderful, this AirConditioned and quiet coffee shop is certainly worth a visit.

One of the better cafes in Davao City amongst the saturation of the genre. From the get go the atmosphere is comfy yet lively. Bright, lots of ample seating, and good music selection. Based on the other customers, the cafe appeals to the older demographic, think 30-50s there for work/meetings. The staff are kind and well versed in their occupational etiquette. Tables already have bottles of water and tissues before you sit down. The seating themselves are comfortable, especially the leather padded booths. Air conditioning could be stronger though. We ordered the Cookies and Cream Milkshake and Mocha Java Latte. Both were yummy. The milkshake had a bit too much chocolate powder for my tastes but it was good regardless. Surprisingly, the latte came with chocolate ice cream which was unexpected. I can't give a full opinion on the food since we did not order any, so the drinks are a solid 7.5-8/10. STASH knows the devil is in the details and they hit the mark. The large bathroom is clean, has a bidet, and a baby changing station. Furniture is constructed from good materials and so is their decorations for the Christmas season. Final Verdict: 8.5/10

STASH Coffee is located on the second floor of a business building. Might be hard to see from the street, but it is there just as Google map shows. The place was clean, nice ambiance, plenty of available seating and even a couple of tables with chairs in a little nook next to the elevator. I was greeted by the friendly staff and was brought a menu. After looking over the menu I decided on the Black Sparkle (iced espresso and tonic water) and the Big Breakfast. The Big Breakfast was really big so it is well named. The sausage was well cooked, juicy, and just enough spice so it didn't need any hot sauce. The eggs paired well with the sausage, mushrooms and the bread. Great combo! The coffee was bold and smooth and overall very refreshing. A hot coffee might have been better with the Big Breakfast, but I'm not complaining. Over a great experience! The free WiFi was good and the CR was clean.
We loved their cream pasta, flat white, and fresh apple tea. Place just feels tight though.

First floor, amazing ambience, and super attentive staff. Always smiling, and cheerful. The coffee was great, big breakfast was well worth it. We even had the pesto pasta and a Filipino dish and it was all 100% amazing.

One of the best places to dine when you are in downtown. Everything was great, from the food to the staff and the over-all ambience of the place. It was clean, cold, well-lit, played pop music in the background, and has an all-gender rest room. The only downside is the limited parking. All in all, it's a great place to dine and get caffeinated.

Dining at Stash is always such a treat! ☕️🍴 Their Spanish Latte is out of this world and the Matcha Latte is equally delicious. We tried the Creamy Bacon Mushroom with Truffle Oil and the Chicken Pesto Pasta and both were great. 📍Stash is located on the second floor, with both stairs and an elevator available for access. When you enter the building, you'll be greeted by a security guard, so make sure to greet him in return. 👨🏻 🍳 The staff greeted us warmly as soon as we walked in and promptly gave us menus after we were seated. 💵 Just a heads up, they only take Gcash and cash payments. I highly recommend giving Stash a try!

A friend recommended Stash Coffee, stating it was the best in the city, and she was right. The lemonade and iced tea were exceptional—refreshing with a hint of mint, and served like cocktails, all for a reasonable price of 110 pesos each. They were indeed a perfect remedy for the city's humidity. I also enjoyed their beef tapa. As a balikbayan on holiday, I missed the classic Filipino breakfast, and their beef tapa offered a perfect balance of sweetness, saltiness, and garlic flavour. I appreciated that it was paired with garlic-fried rice and a sunny-side-up egg; it brought back fond memories of home. One area where Stash Coffee could improve is its Pulled Pork Sandwich. While it was flavorful, it was served in large slices, which made it difficult to chew. They might consider shredding the pork to make it easier for customers to enjoy.

It was not easy locating this building. (I still do not know the name of the building). Best to be here before 12 noon. Orders are taken when you are seated. Getting the Pesto Chicken and cheese, Truffle fries and Fresh Lemonade was a good choice for late brunch….Modest prices, nice staff, and clean place. Be prepared to pay using GCash…Limited parking for the whole building. Don't be surprised if another vehicle is blocking yours upon leaving….I laud the building guard for being alert and attentive…

I'm glad I had chanced upon this coffee spot when I visited Davao. Its closed to USEP and Victoria Plaza. They have a parking space and manned by security guards which is a plus for safety. The cafe had decent space and still have lovely Christmas decors. I love the industrial feel and theme of this coffee place. I asked for reco and the barista recommended their house special, Spanish Latte. I expected it to be sweet but surprsingly wasn't which is good. I prefer less sugar and this latte was perfect. It had subtle taste of mocha and still strong for the espresso kick. I finish it after 5 pages of reading my book. I was the only customer in the place, and I want to stay but longer to finish what I'm reading and got another coffee, this time cafe americano. I can tell they have single origin coffee and was right when the barista told me that beand was from Burundi which is notably for clean, delicate and fruity flavor. I did totally enjoy every sip of it. Both staffs are friendly and I say well trained esp the lady barista. She knows her craft well. Too bad, they don't have any food offerings when I visit since it was still after NY. Another reason for a next visit.

Great spot for breakfast or coffee! My husband loved their split-shot espresso (like an espresso flight) and their big meal breakfast hotdog. I had the matcha latte and truffle bacon pasta—pasta was a bit salty for me, but everything else was flavorful. The place has a cozy vibe, and the staff are always friendly and attentive. Stash really lives up to the standards you'd expect from a Purge-owned cafe!

The coffee and food were great. However, the place was a bit hot, and it seemed like the AC wasn't working properly, which made it a little uncomfortable. Service also took a bit longer than expected, but overall, it was still a good experience. Hopefully, they can improve the cooling and speed up service next time.

Stash is owned by the same people behind Purge Coffee Roasters in Tulip Dr. Both brew the best coffees in the city. Here are my personal favorites: 1. Mocha Lava 2. Honey Lemon Tea 3. Spanish Latte 4. Matcha Latte Mocha Lava ☕️+🍨 became an instant favorite of mine from Stash and Purge. Espresso shot on ice then topped with chocolate ice cream. I usually prefer bitter-sweet coffee and the mocha lava, in particular, perfectly matched my taste. White Peak is also my favorite but for takeaway. Stash and Purge sell it in bottles. It's milky, but the caffeine remains strong. From experience, the buzz lasts for 5-6 hours. It's a must-buy. Honey Lemon Tea 🍯🍋 is always a good idea when I feel like skipping coffee. Mint leaves are added; thus, it gives off a cooling sensation even when the drink is hot. Sweet. A little kick of sourness. Minty. It's a therapeutic drink for me. They also have cakes and pastries on display although subject to availability. I had a slice of carrot cake on my very first visit and it was delightful. Pesto pasta from Stash totally clicked with my tastebuds. The pesto sauce and chicken meat were generous. Di tinipid. Sakto lang ang dami ng parmesan cheese. Overall, it was delicious and flavorful. The staffs were fun to look at. They all got along together. Moreover, they were courteous and well-trained. From time to time, they checked on the customers. Stash has a peaceful ambiance. Their regular customers usually come to order coffee and do work. Some hold small business meetings. Others spend their time to study. But Stash is also family-friendly. They got high chairs for toddlers. Stash has good parking space and tidy comfort room. Plus, dili boring ilang menu especially their drinks. They have other nice options for those who want to skip or don't drink coffee. 🙌🏻⭐️

Because #Covid happened, many small establishments were forced to close and cease operations. It was so refreshing to discover an establishment that recently opened and continued to operate. Stash Coffee Co. is your newest coffee destination to enjoy some of the best Davao coffee or find Purge Coffee's signature White Peak and even a drink or two from their off the menu specials. The baristas are very friendly and the service is excellent.

Good clean place. clean restroom. Good audio system in the cafe. Although it's not the quiet cafe. They have fast wifi too. Food is good. Though some may argue, but I think the price is justified. Apparently also famous for their good coffee though I'm not a credible judge for that. I enjoyed the experience. It's a good place to meet with friends and gave good food.
As always, food is good!! Their mushroom pasta's our favorite go to here. Also, white peak is one thing you don't miss when visiting here!
Food is impeccable. Very consistent. Coffee is great. Modern ambiance and super cozy. It's no wonder I keep going back.
Quiet, cozy cafe. Nice menu selection of coffee, tea, food, and even some cocktails. Nice teal decor. Incredibly welcoming staff. A great place to study (or chat) on a Saturday morning.
My go-to has always been this resto whenever I have a quick errand in downtown. Food & drink always hit the spot for my cravings!

Their food and drinks are quite pricy but they are delicious. I love their truffle fries and hot matcha latte. Staff are also friendly and accomodating. This is a good place to chill because place has a quiet and relaxing ambience
Best coffee in Davao. The dishes are fantastic. Really enjoyed the heavy breakfast and French toast. Salads and pastas are good choices as well.

We ordered the 'Big Breaklast', Iced Mocha, Iced Spanish Latte, and Orange Juice and everything was delicious. The place is located on the second floor of TBT building with a good amount of parking space. The building also has an elevator.

Best tasting coffee in Davao! Their White Peak is their best seller. I love how spacious their place is. Their toilet is clean and trendy as well. But what separates them from the other coffee shops is their coffee. Definitely a place to visit in Davao!

Best place to get coffee? HERE. Beans are roasted by themselves with multiple flavor profiles and types. Ambience is great and the food is well thought of and complimentary to the coffee.

I also finally had some delicious tea, and my husband had perfect matcha 🍵 Thank you so much to the chef and barista.

We came quiet late, the store is about to close but still they accommodated us and served our coffee orders and cakes to my friends. The coffee concoction is delicious and the cake is also okay. Price wise, it is value for money even though it is quite expensive. The ambience of the store is nice, much bigger than their branch PURGE Cafe along Tulip Drive which we are a fan of..Go visit!

I wanted to go here to see what all the hype was about and was immediately impressed with the matcha. I bought the volume 2 matcha and it tasted amazing. Perfect amount of sweetness, creamy, nutty, and you can really taste the matcha. Probably one of the few matcha drinks I've tasted that doesn't taste watered down.

Area was split into two— café and travel agency. Shared limited parking but I was able to drop by and grab drinks. Nice little nook that slightly reminds me of Japanese restos (small and built with a lot of wood). The wait took a while and students were slowly filling up the place. But hey, yummy drinks worth the trip and a repeat. Downside was the terrible signal inside.

One of the best matcha cafes in the city. We got their Hojicha vol. 2 and Matcha Ichigo. It's on the pricier side, but for me it's worth it because you can really taste how good and fresh the quality of their ingredients is. They also use oat milk for their drinks. The place is just cramped, there isn't really a lot of comfortable sitting areas since their place is small, but it's okay for me since I wanted my drink to-go and I didn't really intend to sit and spend time at the place. Overall, if you're coming over for a matcha or hojicha drink, this cafe won't disappoint you.

Went here December 17, 2025. Said cutoff time was 6:30pm and your order will be ready in 20 to 30 minutes. Ordered the ₱180 Tsuki (Black sesame, bolder nutty taste, rich earthiness) around 6:07pm. Yes, I jotted the description. Came back and my order is still being done. Received the drink at 6:22pm. So estimated according to their minutes to serve. The drink was nice but not an iced coffee I will order again. Would like it if there was a hot option but most likely none. They said the Tsuki is made with Brazil coffee beans. Would love to get matcha especially when I saw their whisk but no hot. You can eat outside food as I've seen. Will I go back? Unless there's errands to Marfori, no. Update: Do read the Cafe's response to this review. Thank you

One of my favorite matcha spots in Davao! I always order the Matcha Volume 2— a solid 10/10 for me. Though the space is a bit small, I appreciate how they're upfront about the waiting time for orders. Great drinks, great service — definitely worth it every time!
tried volume 1 and it was so good. one of the best matchas in davao imo. the place is very cute too

We visited Steep Kohi on a Sunday, and it can be hard to find since there's no big signage. Just look for the "Philippine Airlines" sign, and it's inside that area. The place is small and more suited for grab-and-go. The space feels cramped, dim, and could benefit from a bit more maintenance and organization to make it more inviting. We tried Matcha Volumes 1 and 2 which were both good but we preferred Volume 2 for our taste. It had a distinct matcha flavor that's not too overwhelming and sweet. They use oat milk. Volume 1 costs ₱210, Volume 2 is ₱280, and considering the premium price, it would have been nice if the cups were filled to the brim. They have a cutoff at 6:30 PM and don't have receipts. They accept cash and QR payments. Overall, one of the better matchas in the city if you can overlook the cramped space.

Tried out this small coffee shop because my classmates were craving their coffee. Since they're known for their matcha, I gave it a try, and it did not disappoint! The barista was friendly and really puts effort (and a bit of charm haha) into every drink. The place is small, cozy, and has such a nice vibe. Definitely a spot I'd love to come back to.

Dare I say "the best coffee and matcha lattes" we've ever had. Sounds extra? Maybe, but the coffee and matcha they serve are perfect imo. Just about everything can be adjusted to your liking as well. Even my fiance's cousin (a Japanese lady who's always out and about in Japan looking for hole-in-the-wall type matcha places) said their matcha is on par with what she gets in Japan. And I have not even talked about their cakes and ice creams like omg 🍰🍰🍰 Place is homey and cozy. Just find a good spot to sit on and you'll be good. Service-wise, both owners have been nothing but sweet and approachable. 10/10 would recommend to anyone Fiance's fave: Genmaicha Personal fave: Tsuki Try it if you like nutty/peanut buttery coffee! It's not made of peanuts per se but it is an experience! 🫶🏻
Always a good experience here. Haven't visited in almost a year and the menu and space have expanded. Mizuki (toasted coffee) is a new fave!
Our first stop in our Davao trip was Steep Kohi and it did not disappoint 😋 We were a bit slow but understandable since we came in as a group of 10 A must try is the Volume 2 Genmaicha 🍵!

🍵 Matcha: Ordered the Matcha Latte Vol. 2 and I'm obsessed! Earthy, bitter, and perfectly balanced. Unlike other cafés where I need to sub oat milk for the matcha flavor to stand out, this one delivered even with the default milk. The serving size was generous, and honestly, Steep Kohi in Davao serves better matcha than many places in Manila, a pleasant surprise! 🏠 Ambience: Japanese-inspired and cozy, best for takeout since seating is limited. Not study-friendly, but a great stop if you just want a really good latte. 👩 🍳 Service: Loved that they placed a sign about the 15–20 min wait time, transparent and helpful. Watching them make lattes in front was entertaining, so the wait didn't feel long. Hoping they expand soon with more space and staff. 💸 Value: Reasonable price for the quality and portion. Definitely worth it. ✨ Overall: By far the best matcha spot in the city. Will keep coming back!
Best matcha in town? Easily Steep Kohi. Still holding the top spot on my list. Friendly staff, great energy, always a vibe.

if you're on the hunt for matcha that tastes like the ones in kyoto (specifically gokago), GET VOLUME 3!!! Definitely getting it again in my next davao visit. Super cute family-run business 🤎 very limited seating but that's the charm about it !!

Steep Kohi is a hidden gem that every matcha lover should check out. Their matcha selections are one of the best in Davao City as well as their coffee. Don't skip the matcha ice cream—it's a delightful twist with your Matcha Cravings! The cozy, minimalist vibe adds to the overall charm, making it a great spot to enjoy your green tea bliss. The Baristas/Owners are knowledgeable enough to share which specialty coffee and matcha are right for you specially for a first timer. Steep Kohi is one of my go-to place whenever I need to get my Matcha and Caffeine fix through out the week.

If you're wondering why the quality of the drinks and service here has steeply declined, it's because the creative force behind this cafe's previous success has moved on. She recently opened her own spot, Sanjors. Do yourself a favor and go there instead for the experience you used to get here.

We ordered the Volume 1 Series Matcha. It was good but I wish the servings were bigger. My drink disappeared in two minutes. 😂. I will try the stronger Volume 2 Series Matcha soon! Note that the cafe is tiny and situated at the back of a travel agency called Carpenter Travel. Seems they are just starting out so it's understandable. I hope they do well and move to a bigger and better location!

I fund the concept of Matcha Shop/Travel Agency unique (It was close by the time we arrived), ordered the Hojitcha Latte, which is the best I had so far! While their double Matcha was also good 👍 😋 Hope to try their other drinks 🍵 again when I'm in Davao again 🤞 soon.

Finally got to visit this place since my little sister has always wanted to go here. I always found it difficult to locate but it turns out it was conjoined with an airlines company (correct me if im wrong) The food/drink was great. I had the Matcha Vol 2. and the Matcha Cheesecake (cause matcha is just really good). The drink was the real deal considering the matcha drinks ive tried so far were alright compared to what Steep had. The cheesecake was good as well. Will try the ube one on the next visit. The service was great as well. They were really friendly and open with the customers and it made me feel comfortable. (Nice to also know that their sink used to be a bath tub used for dogs that they had to cut off since it used to ve bigger 😅) The atmosphere was very chill and would be a good place to catch up with a friend or two or just hang by yourself to study or read something. Overall, I was more than convinced that it is a great place to have some matcha and chill with yourself or with someone. I am also looking forward to more visits considering the stamp card they gave me that gives rewards such as free drinks, etc. Will be coming back soon 🙆

One of the best quality cafés in Davao in terms of taste where you could actually taste distinct flavors for each drink. I love their matcha too. I recommend. I hope they get enough support so that they can get their own building though since the place is not exclusively for Steep Kohi so it's hard to really discover them too.

This is definitely my go-to coffee shop which is perfect for cold brew and espresso-based drinks. On days when I need a boost, I always order Kurimu and Shirou, which have a well-balanced acidity, bitterness, and sweetness. I also love their Matcha drinks, Vol. 1 & 2—they can rival the ones I've had in Japan.

Whisked automatically. I'm not sure where they sourced their matcha, but there's not much notes to taste. Expensive. Low hospitality of staff/owners also. Genmaicha was fine however, ube matcha and matcha vol. 2 are not worth the hype.

Since the Google review page for Martin Asian Cuisine appears to be unavailable, I'm leaving it here under Bloom Cafe, as they share the same space and, I think (?), the same owner, based on the heading of the sales invoice. I had high hopes for Martin Asian Cuisine after reading several positive reviews on other websites, but unfortunately, our experience fell short of expectations. The restaurant is tucked inside Bloom Cafe, which made it a bit tricky to locate at first. We visited on a Sunday lunchtime. The space was small but visually appealing, with natural light streaming in and a thoughtfully designed setup. There were only about five tables, all occupied at the time. Their menu offered a good variety of Asian dishes, which we were excited to try. There was only one waitress serving all customers, and while she was polite and upfront about the expected 30-minute wait time, our food ended up taking over an hour to be served. We only ordered three items: Tom Yum Goong, Goi Cuon, and a chicken dish. One thing to note: only sodas are available for drinks at Martin. If you want something else, you'll have to order separately at Bloom Cafe. We also encountered a minor hygiene issue. One of our bowls had a dead insect stuck to it. While the staff quickly replaced it without question, it did affect our overall impression of the kitchen's attention to cleanliness. As for the food: The Goi Cuon had an overcooked wrapper and oily vegetables, lacking the light and fresh profile we were expecting. The Tom Yum Goong had decent flavor, but it was served lukewarm and the shrimps were overcooked. The chicken dish was okay; similar to inasal with soy sauce. We paid ₱985 for the three dishes. They only accept cash or GCash, which might be inconvenient for some. On the positive side, they were able to provide a sales invoice, which we appreciated. The invoice had Bloom Cafe's name on the header, which further suggests the two businesses are connected. Overall, while the space itself is aesthetically pleasing and has potential, the long waiting time, inconsistent food quality, limited drink service, and minor hygiene concerns made the experience underwhelming. I hope improvements are made in both kitchen operations and customer communication.

Had a nice experience at Bloom Coffee. ☕️ Their coffees are surprisingly good! Tbh, we didn't have much expectations with their coffee as our main goal was to look for a place where we can work comfortably. Their Spanish Latte is great (we usually order spanish latte if it's our first time in a cafe just to have a basis of comparison 😂). Latte (or was my order flat white? Forgot) is good too, not sweet and delivers a long-lasting aftertaste. 🍴 I love their breakfast quesadilla! It was savory and the eggs in it are fluffy. 💵 Accepts cash/card 🌐 They have fast wifi. After you order, they give you a voucher you can use to access their wifi (max 4hrs) 👨 🍳 Our overall experience was good, but our order took almost 1 hour to arrive (and there wasn't even much people in the cafe). Although, It didn't create hassle for us because we were not hungry, nor in a hurry. ✍️Plenty of wall sockets. They have a functioning toilet. Has indoor and outdoor seating. Would definitely go back when in the area!

I really like the interior it was warm and comfortable and drink tasted really good. Staff that night where a little helpful compared to previous reviews so an improvement. Would definitely visit again when given an opportunity!
Pizza and Aglio Olio was superb. Their internet connection is fast. And the Americano is the best I had so far. Good place for coworking and studying.
Best place to work, study & chill out with friends and family. 💗✨ This is my go to, super convenient location and very friendly staff.
The place is good for meetings for group and companies: conference room, smart tv for presentation, fast internet though limited to few devices. The problem is just the parking space.

I love this place. It is one of the very few cafes walking distance to my own. It gets a lot of human traffic - people studying, meetings, etc. It does live up to its name of being a collaborative space. The coffee is great and has a good balance between hearty meals and pastries for its menu. They're also responsive over Facebook if you want to book for work meetings. I can't recall if they're PWD accessible, just be careful crossing in front Ecoland Drive during peak hours. And they do have parking.

I went to this coffee shop in Davao City a lot. This coffee shop holds special memories for me during my stay in Davao City for more than a year. I went there to relax with friends, watch football streaming with friends, share laughter and stories, and sometimes to work. The coffee was good, but the food was really tasty, especially the beef quesadillas. It was a great place to meet up with friends and have a nice time. The owner was very friendly, and the shop had a comfortable and cozy feeling. Hopefully they will provide smoking area in the future.

It's a great place if you have a meeting with small to medium size of 15 people team. Meals are not bad, they're designed to be comfortable and for sharing, good price. Staff are very active and nice even if there are a lot of customers. It's a very productive space

This small cafe was jam-packed one Friday evening. The variety of fair-priced and reasonably-sized beverages and food items were a big plus and the late closing hour was definitely conducive to students doing their schoolwork. The fruit tea and quesadilla were good. Nice staff but the cashier forgot to give me my change. Will surely visit again pretty soon 👍
The WIFI was reliable. Coffee was good. The service was fast. I was able to focus on what I was doing because the ambience is conducive for deep work. Lovely place!

Honest review. The ambiance was nice pero the only problem is that they served our food almost 2hrs. Imagine 6 people and we all have the same and exact orders but it them soooo long. Not sure what took them that time since they don't have that a lot of customers during our visit. Also, the food was okay but the pasta were kinda' dry not my type tho. Lastly, the workers were not sure (i guess) how the job works because when we asked for an OR with the total and they got confused on that or they just dont care about their customers? Overall, definitely will not comeback sorry.

This cozy cafe is located just across the Indonesian Consulate Office nearby Verdon Parc Condominium. Right at the corner of an intersection, they provide an outdoor setup as well as an airconditioned indoor dining area. They have a toilet inside which is a plus. They have a wide selection of food and beverages. Hot, cold, coffee, non- coffee based and the staff are very attentive and considerate. They even guided me through the menu, which gave me confidence that the dish I will order will be something I enjoy. They have fast wifi connection and just an overall complete cafe. Will definitely visit again when I'm in Davao.

Took my order 30 minutes to be served even though it's not a busy day, needed to follow up the barista about my order before she even made it. Barista is also has an attitude. I asked for a hot spanish latte and she served me cold drinks — even blamed me that it was me who was not clear with my order when in the first place i clearly mentioned to her that I want it hot — she just didn't listened. Went here because it was recommended by a friend, but ended up disappointed. My point is, customer experience is important and referrals are one of the best marketings, yet you don't seem to value.

The place is pretty nice. It has charging slots and free wifi. Your stay doesn't have a time limit. This is perfect for those who wants to study or work silently. The place has a good lighting. However, it seems to be hot that day. I am not certain if their aircon's temperature was just low or if it was under maintenance. Their staff were really nice. Second, the cashier was somewhat unprofessional for slamming my credit card and receipt. Third, my iced matcha latte had hair inside. Lastly, when I asked her before we left if she found any Uniqlo paper bag, she told me no but the other staff took the initiative to check if they had kept it. Luckily, it was given back to me and when she saw me with the paper bag, she simply ignored me. It is just disappointing how some staff treat young customers poorly compared to those that are older. review_text: Recently-opened shop in an also-new compound. Squeaky clean and interiored nicely. Available wall sockets and wifi codes (taped on the counter top) are an added convenience not found in some coffee spots. Kind staff. Affordable rates. Beverages comprise most of what's on the menu. Pastries and other items are on display. The bitter taste of the cappuccino paired well with the potato cake. Adored the silence at 10 a.m. Hope they can add quick-prep meals soon.

I love how cozy their place is! It's quite small, but they really made the most of the space with comfy chairs, tables, and accessible sockets. The free WiFi is a big plus, and their drinks are really good too — they even suggest options based on your preferences, which I appreciate. They also have desserts to pair with your drinks. I'm always here to study, and the great playlist just adds to the vibe! 🥰

I believe they just recently opened in this new place like a square or complex in Bajada. There also other coffeeshops and buffets within the vicinity. Parking space is generous. Only tried the chocolate chip blended. It's good but not mind-blowing. The place is giving. Has good looking lamps, gorgeous accent wall and an elegant shade of blue here and there. They only serve drinks and some cake as of writing. Tried the basque cream cheese and it was delicious for real. Price range is pretty average

This place was absolutely spectacular! I felt very welcomed, as soon as I stepped in I was greeted by the delightful staff and manager. The food was amazing I highly recommended getting the blueberry cheesecake. The cheesecake is not like any other cheesecake I've tasted before, the cheese was creamy and it pairs well with the subtle glaze of blueberry jam. The coffee was a little bitter but I loved it when I sip the bitter coffee, and a bite of the pastry. The bittersweet combination is to die for! The manager was very hospitable especially towards us foreigners.
Beautiful interior with very friendly staff. Free wifi is also available.
I ordered a cappuccino. I got coffee flavored milk. Please re train your staff
Delicious coffee!

Great coffee. Clean and peaceful place. Has AC ON even it's early in the morning. It's inside the carwash, you'll see the sign outside ( see the picture below 👇) We ordered Iced Americano and White hot chocolate. Also, we tried their egg tart and it was good👌
Good place to get coffee, much better experience here than KNTO CINCO nearby. Atmosphere is relaxing, staff is friendly.

It's nice to chill here in the coffee lounge while doing laundry.

Slightly hidden just along the highway. This shop was too warm inside, with a second floor and some parking. Crunchy nachos were shareably-sized for three. Latte, way too sweet. The timing was a mistake with the group of loud office employees that hour on the next table. Pleasant staff. Ample food choices that's reasonable. If I'm in the area this is on my most-likely-to-visit for snacks.

The place is strategically located in Calinan. good spot indeed for quick catch ups and affordable food. HOWEVER, service is just toooooo sloooooooow as attested by several reviews here. I arrived there at 3pm and i was alone and i had to call several times to ask if they are indeed open, and if they will ask for my order. Getting their attention to take order- 30mins Taking the order- 10mins serving the order of drinks- 30mins serving pizza- 50mins bill out- 30mins So if you want to cone here, be sure you are not too famished and you have the luxury to wait, also add patience. :)

The food & ambiance is great but the serving time is super slow. It's not a lunch out friendly for our working individuals.
We like the food. It's the service that is slow. Especially if you are a big group dining. A beautiful place to meet within Calinan
Great food and affordable prices. Had they added more seats and space at the second floor, it would be a great venue for meetings and barkada gatherings.
A must visit place for coffee lovers 💙 Unlike other coffee shops in Calinan were latte & capucinno tasted the same.
The food here was great! No—it was perfect!

Decent spot for a coffee or a cake. Not a big fan of the long lasting (sweet) milk in the cappuccino. Cakes are decent, but expensive though. Service was okay…

Everything in this place is so good. The food is excellent the desserts cakes are a must tey if you go here, the service is very good and the servers are nice, the whole atmosphere of the place is calming every inch of this place is Wonderful. I've been here several times. Good coffee, food, ambience, and location! Highly recommended!🥰🥳😇

The place looks nice on the outside, looks cozy inside but the time I went there I think the AC was off or not working because it was really hot. But the people who work there re nice and they also serve good food.
It,s great they continue run the coffee shop if we consider there location. For me I don,t expect much. It,s enough I can take lunch there. If I can,t , I need to go julibee.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The view at this spot is absolutely magnificent. The backdrop steals the show and sets a beautifully relaxing mood. It is the kind of picturesque setting where you instantly want to pull out your phone and start taking photos. What truly elevates the entire experience, however, is the staff. Every single team member we encountered was incredibly kind, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. They greeted us with warm smiles, checked in on us at the perfect moments, and went out of their way to ensure we were comfortable. Even though the meal was ordinary, the combination of the stunning view and the beautiful hospitality made it a highly enjoyable visit.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The service was amazing, the crew were really nice and attentive. Unfortunately, the food was not good. The nachos were okay, i guess. The fries were just fries (who could mess up fries? lol) and the burgers were really MID, it really didnt have any flavor aside from the sauce and the added ketchup. The view was nice as well, it was very windy as well so it wasn't hot that night. I hope they really improve the taste of the food because the concept of a sky cafe is cool and all but the food just fell flat. This is no diss to the people working inside the kitchen and are all my personal takeaways. ^^

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I went there after our Pastor at COP Davao recommended to go there after church back when I visited Davao. The choco drink is too sweet for me, but the rest are good. Portion size is really big, so I had to pack the chicken wings for takeout instead. There's a rooftop deck to get a view of Samal Island!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I'd heard some people say this place was rather overpriced for their food, but honestly, I found the value to be excellent. The food was delicious and far exceeded my expectations for the price point. Plus, with the fast service and accommodating staff, you really get your money's worth. The only downside for me is that the I can't find any electrical plugs available on the upper deck when I wanted to charge my gadget, although they have few ones on the lower deck tables facing their counter but it doesn't have the view. But still, a very chill and great experience!"

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe is one of those places in Davao that feels like it has its own personality. Every time I go there, it gives me this casual, late-night, comfort-food kind of vibe that makes it easy to just relax and enjoy the moment. It is also 24/7. The food serving focuses on big portions and satisfying meals that actually hit the spot when you are hungry. There were times I went there expecting just a quick bite, but ended up surprisingly full and satisfied. The atmosphere is also a big part of the experience. It has that laid-back café feel where you can either hang out with friends or just sit quietly while eating. On good days, it even feels a bit cozy, especially when it's not too crowded. It's the kind of place where time passes without you really noticing. Service-wise, sometimes they took a long time to give your order.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Great place to eat and relax! They have high-quality burger options that taste fresh and satisfying. The ambience is comfortable and welcoming, with a nice city view that makes the experience even better. The employees are also very friendly and attentive. Definitely a great spot to visit for good food and a pleasant atmosphere.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: It was a journey, but I think worth it. The staff was friendly, professional, and crazy 😁 The food was okay and the portions were healthy. We had their breakfast platters, P299. We enjoyed the drinks. We left full. 🤗 I'll bet you'll enjoy the view at night. The downsides are parking and the stairs. We had a two block walk. The elevator is out of order. It's a bit of a climb to the top floor. When we go back, we'll try the burgers. They looked 👍 good 😊

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Such a surprise hiding on the rooftop of a non-description building! Evening dining was refreshing and breezy with a great view of the city lights. You can choose to eat at the very top level with open sides with safe railings or below. Order at the counter and get a buzzer to come take your food with a tray. But the staff brought our meals to us maybe since we were a group with small children. You're met with a cheery shouted greeting and they call out a farewell also. All staff were noticeably friendly. We noticed that the catchy music playing was personalized (AI?) with the Crazy Bite name 😆. Burgers are good; different than an American burger but really tasty with soft buns. The platters are very filling even when shared. Highly recommend for a special outing or maybe to watch the sun rise!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Our dining was not bad. They offer fast food options such as burgers,fries, and rice meals. They also have several drinks such as juices and coffee. The catch in this restaurant is it is located on the rooftop wherein you can see Davao's view. The price is moderately expensive. The comfort room is not dirty.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: As you enter the establishment, the staff will welcome you with warm and lively greetings. Best time to go early in the morning and catch the sunrise because the view at the rooftop is immaculate. The food are CHEAP but QUALITY! I guess I can say the price range is affordable. It's really good and there's lots of options to choose from. The staff were also very accommodating and approachable during our time there; volunteering to even help us take our own photos. We went on a not so good day though, which was the morning before New Year 2024. Unfortunately, some options on the menu weren't available. (Context: They were about to close that early morning when we came). So yes, best to just not go during this busy time. Just a piece of advice I can give based on what I've observed so far. Nonetheless, it was a great experience for first timers like us (me and my mom). I'll be back again next year, maybe?

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The staff at Crazy Bite Co are enthusiastic and attentive, greeting you warmly upon entry. However, the food is nothing special and not worth its price.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Bad view, basically nothing. Food is.... Nothing special. Staff is very attentive but 500 pesos for 1 basic burger, fries, and 3 wings is wild in thee Philippines. There's so many place I will go before I go here again. Krispy Kreme burger was gross, I've had them many times in America but for some reason the donuts here were COLD and HARD.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I can't deny that the Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe has been my safe place for a year and five months, and I hope we'll be together for many more years. This cafe is a 100/10, and it could be your escape and go-to place whenever you don't want to go home. On top of that, I love their food! *chef kiss! 😚* . Surely everyone knows that their food is one of the reasons why people keep coming back. Also, the people who run this cafe are very passionate. This establishment should be kept secret yet Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe deserves to be proud of and recommended to everyone. Long live the Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe! You will always be in my heart! 🫀

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We been here during dinner time and the place is crowded since food is great and now we are trying it for breakfast since we are in the city. All I can say that the reviews speaks loud for itself. Just be careful ⚠️in bringing your food to the top floor when its windy you might FALL in the wrong person eme... 😁 Hope you enjoy your days with the friends and the people you love...

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I went for an early morning walk, and to my pleasant surprise, I stumbled upon this hidden gem. Nestled on the top floor of a building, the restaurant boasts breathtaking views that add to the overall charm of the place. I decided to start my day with breakfast there, and I must say, the food exceeded my expectations. It was just right, with a delectable blend of flavors that satisfied my taste buds. Additionally, their coffee was a delightful treat that perfectly complemented my meal. What impressed me even more was the restaurant's thoughtful accommodation for those seeking privacy for work or meetings. They have a separate room that provides a suitable environment for professional endeavors. This attention to detail truly sets this restaurant apart from others and caters to a diverse range of needs. Whether you're seeking a scenic spot for a leisurely meal or a productive space for work, this place has it all.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food is very flavorful, you would prefer it if you have a taste for super savory meals. We went there at lunch so it felt really hot and humid. So, i think the place is better at night where you can enjoy a Davao skyline view.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: food is alright. mid range prices. somehow they didn't have service water at the time we went. be prepared to exercise urself going upstairs if the elevator is full.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Updating review: wrong order was served. Paid 700+ for two meals but it was not worth it. Just go to jollibee, you'll get better and tastier food. For now, you're just paying for the place and the 24-hour availability. Entrance is at the right side of Maybank, you can enter through the door and there's an elevator to get you to the 5th floor. Servers will greet you upon entering. Food was yummy but I found it too pricey, plus it took a while for it to be ready. It can be very windy at the top or hot, it really depends on the weather.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: What stood out during my visit was how energetic and enthusiastic their staff was. You could tell they were having fun greeting their guests in unison. I stayed on the upper deck and all the guests on there would give out a chuckle when a new customer arrives below. As for the food, it was reasonably priced. Serving was hefty and plating, instagrammable. I, on the other hand, wasn't a fan of their coffee—it tasted watered down and too sweet ( I got a spanish latte). The 360 degree uninterrupted view of downtown Davao was amazing, too. Best place if you want to witness the sunrise. I wish they put up a sign where the exact entrance to the building is because I had some trouble looking for it (im not from Davao).

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: They weren't kidding when they named it Sky Cafe. You can dine with a decent view of Davao City. The western food they served were above average compared to what you get from other restos in the city. Would dine again on a Friday night out with friends.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We went here for a dinner. It was literally on the rooftop of the building. The staff are very accommodating and courteous even though some are self service.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food: I love how creative the food was and it's eye pleasing however need to adjust about food pairing and if the flavor or the Variety is not available need to post "not available" on the menu however the taste is just fair. Service: The Crew are build with Awesomeness and Enthusiasm had a great experience how they offer to be the photographer in every picture taken, Just add precautions how they greet the customers so other may not be startle next time. Atmosphere: Architecture and designs are great it helps the ambiance more appealing makes the consumers to want more. "It was a great expereince for me how everything works at this place and I'm sure that I will definitely comeback hungry for more"

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: My first time coming here was shocking as I didn't expect to be greeted with very welcoming staff. It has pretty much typical choices for beverages and foods for a coffee shop. Very welcoming crew and clean tables, just don't have any helmet rack to place helmets onto. Parking spaces are limited in the day time. The atmosphere is great on the top deck. And I won't know if their fan is even turned on since the wind is blowing and running the fan in circles.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I guess they deserve to have a 5 star rating. I dont see any reason to rate lower for now. Ambiance is a big check ! Food prices js a super check ! Location is a check ! Service is a check , well its a self service where you will be the one to pick up your orders from the counter, though the staffs are energetic and nice ! Taste is a check also , makes me excited to try their other foods and drinks ! Its really windy and cool upside but you can choose to position on the lower part if you dont like high views or windy places.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Only delivery burger with quality 100% beef not any fillers or pork like alot of places use. Best delivery burger in Davao easily. Fries are mid but can't complain I order here often.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I came here with my sister to have dinner, and I can definitely agree that this sky café serves delicious food 10/10. And to add to that, the atmosphere in this café is very beautiful, especially if you go there early in the morning. The strong winds and the view there are definitely worth experiencing. So if you're looking for a worthwhile place to eat with a great view, I can highly recommend The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Café. I hope I can come back here again to taste their food and see the beautiful view once more!✨

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: upon entering, youd be greeted by the most enthusiastic service crew ever that it was almost a bit overwhelming. we went there but the rooftop was already full. they did take our name for a table reservation but we alrdy finished eating and all but our name still wasnt called, so we weren't able to experience the view from the top. anyway, we still dined at their floor below (they occupy 2 floors). the price was okay bc their servings are huge! was a bit sad bc the fries are served cold. the others were good. if u rlly want to get full, opt for their supermeal w like 4 different viands, 2 (or 3?) rice and 2 eggs.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: After the first simbang gabi for 2024, I needed to get breakfast. Beshy Google was as usual helpful and gave me several recomm. Crazy Bite was listed as the second, which was weird as it was the nearest. Took a Grab ride since it was my first time. Didn't know where it actually was. The driver also didnt't know where it was. We asked an on-duty S.G. in the area where LHL Bldg was, and voila. You have to take an elevator ride to go up to the 5th floor of LHL Bldg. When you get off, you take 2 more flights of stairs to get to the 6th floor where they were located. I was in for a surprise with the staff's energetic and ''crazy' greetings. They do the same thing when you leave. I ordered chicken and a burger. Went to the 2nd level (there are 2 levels) where I waited to be buzzed for my order. I liked the 2nd level better than the 1st. You get some sights there. 👀 Nothing on the 1st level, but it was better there during that 1st visit. Here's the reason why. Two customers (friends) sat at the table beside me. They were loud with expletives to match. The other customers at the other tables (there were 3 other occupied tables) were not the loud, dirty-mouth types. These 2 were. So. I moved down to the 1st level. (I should've taken a photo of those two as a warning to you. LOL). The food? Nothing crazy about the chicken, but at least it was not bland and fried perfectly. It was the cheese burger I was crazy about. The flavor was really good and it was still pleasantly warm, given it was the second to be consumed. The staff? Let's get back to that energetic greeting. The same energy is evident in the way most of them talk to each other. Loud. 🥴 Like the person they were talking to was a mile away, but were not. Same energy in the way they serve you and speak with you: fast, clearly and with a smile. The photo of the tissue holder and the message board right on top of it tells its own story. My first visit was not totally a bad one, not totally a good one either. It's a tie? 🤪

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Was there for brunch today around 11.30, and I will tell you straight away. When the sun is up, this place is super warm as it's on rooftop. Try to come earlier in the morning or later in a day when there's no sun out. Service was quick,polite, and guys are all very friendly and welcoming. If it's your first time coming in, don't get scared when they all start screaming "Welcome to Crazy Bite" as I did not expect this, so it was a funny experience. Food I had chicken fillets, with rice and fried egg. It was alright, nothing wow. Mostly, what is wow is view and location of the place. To go up, you need to enter the door on the right from the bank on the bottom floor. Go in the elevator and go on the 5th floor and then walk up to get to the 6th floor and be ready for them screaming their welcoming greeting. All in all, nice experience and nice views. But definitely come after 4pm when sun I lower down and you will enjoy much more.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Upon arrival, staff gracefully greet us. There were plenty of options but we were crabing chicken wings for dinner, and my sister also ordered beef tapa meal. Their chicken wings were juicy, perfectly cooked and seasoned, and we chose gravy, buffalo, and teriyaki as our sauces, they also has free condiments to choose from: ketchup, hot sauce, toyomansi. We ate at the rooftop area to enjoy the Davao City ambience. We will surely dine here again to try their burgers.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I've never had such soft beef tapas in my mouth! It's not the traditional Filipino tapas but its a good kind of change. I thoroughly enjoyed my breakfast. The coffee's also good. The view here is lovely. It's a great place to escape from mundane routines of life. I hope to come back and try out the burgers next 😋

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Crazy Bite and Co is a restaurant that offers good food, a stunning city view, and a cozy atmosphere to hang out with friends and have late-night talks. The food is delicious and diverse, with something for everyone. The city view is amazing, especially at sunrise. The outdoor deck is spacious and comfortable, and the atmosphere is cozy and inviting. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the restaurant is open late on weekends. Overall, Crazy Bite and Co is a great place to have a good meal, enjoy a beautiful view, and relax with friends.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The crazy bite co. has a good view of the davao skyline. It has a new good dining experience. The food is average and good for the price, it is very affordable but the place is too crowded as of now or the tables and chairs is limited in the good spot ( the upper deck ). The waiting time of food is quiet longer maybe because there's a lot of customers.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: It's a good place to chill when it's not hot out. I would suggest going here when it is night time or at dawn. They have reasonable prices and the food is good. Coffee is good as well they are open 24 hours. Parking is a bit of a hassle when it is working hours. Fries and burger patties are great. Nachos lack mexican taste. They don't have service water.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Amazing food fair for its price. Joyful Friendly staffs and accommodating, been there twice and only tried the food and snacks, least to try their coffee but a lil bit risky to order espresso that is not well introduced. 9/10 👌

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We arrived at 1am.. place is cozy.. food has nice presentation..burger is good.. though not pure beef but its good.. you can really see davao in 360 view which is good.. we should've come here at sunset or sunrise ..its cold already without AC specially during dawn..nice place!!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Went there yesterday because of high reviews overall. Should have read the bad ones first! Food is terrible and low quality. Corned beef I'd cheapest local canned. Egg was overcooked. German sausage was terrible. Beef tapa was terrible.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The place will be packed in peak hours and you have to wait for 30min. to an hour as this situated in the 5th floor. Once you get in, you'll be amazed with the relaxing view (I suggest going here before sunset). Service is good and food is great. No hassle as they accept all types of payment method. Will be back for more as there are food items on the menu that I haven't tried due to its limited availability but so far, 👌🤌

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe one afternoon with a friend, and I wanted to share my experience with you. The atmosphere was wonderful, the food was delicious, and the service was impeccable. It was truly a memorable time.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Customer service is top tier. The food is okay and the place is very cozy.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: If you're out of places to go to past midnight, this is a really amazing spot to hang out. The place has two levels and only the top one has the overlooking view. Fortunately their staff are very quick in making sure that those who wanna sit at the top will get a spot as soon as a table gets vacant. Honestly, the food isn't the highlight of this place. Everything is cooked well but nothing stands out flavor-wise. They also do not provide service water and thus you would need to buy bottled water.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food are delicious. They are open 24/7. Most of the foods they have are burgers. They also have rice meals. I also love their breakfast meals. Very accommodating staff and good place since the restaurant is located at the rooftop, it has a nice view of the city

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Any kind of service crew asking you to move tables in a middle of a meal should be re trained. This place has shitty food and only has service and atmosphere to offer, then they immediately mess up the service. Please retrain your crew.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food is affordable, exactly priced. The serving of food takes too long, about 30 minutes. We had to wait on a long queue before we could get a seat. What's the rave about this cafe? Probably the roof deck where you'll see Davao's skyline.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: OPEN 24 HOURS! The staff is super energetic and welcoming. Even if you decide to eat here at 1 AM, it is bright and lively. Food choices in the menu were interesting, and looked appetizing (In-photo: Chicken Teriyaki Meal, Beef Tapa Meal, and KK Burger). I was really impressed with their donut burger, it was something new to me and it tastes really great. Great casual place to hangout at late at night or early morning!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: First time here and was welcomed with a nice good afternoon. The waitress at the register was very rude and food way overpriced ,quality poor. The view is obstructed by fencing all around the dining area. For the money so many other nice restraunts in Davao City will be the first and last time for us....It actually reminds me of McDonald's but with double the price.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We had an amazing breakfast here. Staffs were friendly and it feels very unique to dine here since the cafe is located on a rooftop 🤘🤘

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I absolutely adored how welcoming and accommodating their store was – entering and leaving was a breeze! The food was fantastic and absolutely worth the price; we weren't disappointed at all! Although it was a little hot inside at the time.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Crazy how amazing their view and service is considering we as a group were 20+ and had our orders served on time (6am at that). Recommended for group gatherings and eat outs! 🔥🔥🔥

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: It was a rainy day when I visited so the view wasn't really spectacular. But I guess with better weather the view would also be great. The cafe is located on the 6th floor. The food is okay. I ordered big breakfast A. The serving was fair with the price, not overwhelming. The corned beef was too salty for me. I liked the sweetness of the beef tapa.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Good food, strategic location, and nice ambiance. However, it is not accessible for people with disabilities because the elevators are only available from the 2nd to 5th floor. You have to take the stairs up to the 2nd floor, then take the elevator up to the 5th floor, and finally take the stairs up to the 6th floor/roof deck where the sky cafe is located.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: In my opinion, everything is a 5 star. Food: Delicious and well seasoned food. There are a lot of food choices that you can choose from. Prices are reasonable and expect value for money. Service: It was definitely my first time from a restaurant or cafeteria that they greeted us enthusiastically. "CRAAZYY MORNING, WELCOME TO CRAZY BITE, ENJOY YOUR MEAL!" and they do this in unison and to most of the customers. The enthusiasm and upbeat is contagious. Atmosphere: I like the vibe, color combination, and their displays of ornaments. I was able to read their history board, they had really humbling beginnings, kudos to the proprietor(s). It is located on top of the building, 5th floor so you can expect a high view. Our group visited during breakfast but were still amazed by the breeze at the top. Hopefully I will be able to visit there again in Davao and definitely go to this place for dinner and enjoy the city lights. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this place.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The place was great and the staff were very nice and welcoming, the view from the top was amazing! You can see a large part of the city there. The lobby like part of the establishment has a backyard party vibe in it, which was a nice touch. place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Very friendly staff, and every single guest is greeted loudly. The food was also very good fast food. A word of warning for those unfamiliar with flavored fries – they're really tossed in the flavoring. We underestimated how intense the cheese fries could taste! :D Hygiene standards are good, by Filipino standards! There's even a private room that can be booked – unfortunately, I don't know how to do that.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The location is pretty nice, if you're looking for a cozy place to eat while enjoying the city view. Food servings are generous. Service crews are nice and welcoming. It's a decent place to eat and chill, the music is not too loud. The restrooms are clean. They only have limited tables and chairs so you might have to wait a few minutes before you can secure a table, the staff is also accommodating, they will seat you right away if there are customers waiting to dine. So far, it has been a good experience. Their poppers are delicious because they are made out of chicken breast meat, their iced choco is delicious (not sure if they call it iced choco as long as it's in the non-coffee section) I like it because it's not too sweet and chocolatey, it's not like an instant choco drink. Their meal set B (2nd photo) is good for 2, you can order additional rice if you like rice ☺️. A few burgers are filling, the patty is big (I'm not a fan of the taste & texture) but maybe your taste buds will like it 😉

Definite must-tries are Monte Cristo sandwich and Croffle Set (with Hungarian sausage and scrambled egg).

I had a good experience at Limestone Brew in Samal Island. The food was definitely enjoyable—everything we ordered tasted fresh and well-prepared, and you can tell they put effort into the quality of their dishes. That said, the prices are a bit on the higher side, which might make you think twice if you're on a budget. Still, the ambiance makes up for it. It's a nice, relaxing spot to just sit back, enjoy your meal, and unwind, especially if you're looking for a chill café vibe while on the island. Overall, it's a solid place to visit if you don't mind spending a little extra for good food and a comfortable atmosphere.
